formatted_address: 100 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Allen Street Grill

reviews.text: I’ve been to Allen Street Grill multiple times now when staying at Hotel State College, and every visit has been exceptional from start to finish. The service is exactly what upscale dining should be — attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely warm without ever feeling rushed. The ambiance is inspired and historic, a true testament to the rich history of the property and the charm that fills every corner. The drinks are equally impressive, crafted with care and balance that showcase real skill behind the bar. | The bufala mozzarella appetizer is truly life-changing — as our server suggested, grab a spoon and get a little of every component in one bite; you won’t regret it. The beef carpaccio was another standout, a perfect balance of flavor and texture, with the crispy sunchoke bringing the dish together in such a refined and memorable way. | For entrées, the ribeye was everything you want it to be — rich, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The lamb shank was tender and beautifully complemented by the beans and onion jam, coming together in a way that feels almost magical. And the Cornish game hen was buttery and juicy, paired with a rich gravy and velvety mashed potatoes that made it an instant favorite. | Allen Street Grill delivers on every level — ambiance, food, drinks, and service — making it one of those rare places you can’t wait to return to again and again.

Super lovely. The food was great and the other patrons at the bar when we got a glass of wine before our reservation were so nice and friendly! They even recommended us the broiled oysters (which were fantastic). It was intimate and romantic! The perfect noise level to feel like a private conversation. We sat in the windows and it was gorgeous. I got the fish and my boyfriend got the steak and both were fantastic. The apps (broiled oysters and tiger prawns) were great as well. Our server was lovely, though I feel bad I did not catch her name! The hostess and bartenders were very kind and patient too (and very helpful with wine selection). They have a fantastic and unique wine selection (perfect for wine lovers). The perfect birthday date for my boyfriend! We cannot wait to go back

We absolutely love this restaurant and recommend it to anyone looking for a celebration or just amazing dinner spot. My husband and I have been coming here for every anniversary (plus any reason to celebrate) and have never been disappointed. Wanted to leave this review and do a shoutout to Rachel who truly made our 5 year anniversary dinner 5-Star. Thank you again to everyone at this establishment - we love each visit !

Amazing experience and very accommodating. Our waiter was super courteous and gave some very helpful tips and recommendations. One of my favorite spots in State College. And thank you again for the desserts!

Overall the experience was good, just not quite great enough for 5 stars. The service was phenomenal from both our waiter and the host. Our waiter accommodated our allergies well and suggested the best menu options. The main reason I couldn't give full stars was that the pricing just doesn't line up with the food. For as much as we spent, I expected the food to be of higher quality and quantity. The fish was bland and had too much oil on it. The pork chop was cooked too much and was chewy. It would have also been nice to have more menu options. The dessert was good and not too heavy.

formatted_address: 100 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: The Corner Room

reviews.text: Returning my son to PSU after the Thanksgiving break and we decided to stop in for brunch.  We did not have a reservation but timed it well.  We were seated in the main bar area within a few minutes of arrival.  10-15 minutes later the lobby was filled with people looking for a table.  Not sure if they were understaffed that day, we waited a bit for our waitress to take our order.  My coffee came to the table when I went to the bathroom, no creamer was left.  The food came out in a reasonable time, I had the blueberry pancakes and my son the waffle.  The food was very good, they do use real Maple Syrup which I appreciate.  The price was reasonable for the quality of food.  There is enough on the menu to satisfy most people.  I like the decor of the restaurant, they had it decorated for the holidays.

Good appetizers, entrees were OK. The steak frites was not that great. Steak was overcooked (asked for med rare vs well done in picture) and without the sauce it would be uneditable. Dry and just generally not great. The service was disappointing. Our waiter really killed the vibe at our table. Not sure why.
ASG upstairs has better food and service. Corner room is more like an Applebees
Atmosphere makes the food taste extra special.  Location, interior design, comfort, and service are the intangibles that provide an exceptional experience.

Best smoked salmon sandwich I ate in State College. Breads were very loaded with lots of cream cheese, salmon, arugula, and pickled red onion. It was normally coming with chips but I upgraded it to with salad and salad was also very nice with tasty olive oil/balsamic dressing.
My Mediterranean stomach had a real fest. Will come again soon. It was a very busy time with THON but my order still was not late.

Pretty good spot, great location, and decent food. They were kind enough to let us order off of the dinner menu even though it was before 3 which was nice. Can get busy, but no reservations are allowed. Had a large group and it wasn't a problem when they aren't busy.

formatted_address: 220 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: The Tavern

reviews.text: Went with a group of five on a Thursday night and quickly got a table. We shared the crab dip for an app. That was very good as was the bread. I had the bolognese which was also very good. Other members of our group had the salmon, chicken and tuna salad which we were a bit underwhelming especially for the price. Our server was very friendly, funny and nice which we enjoyed but I think for the upscale vibe the service could’ve been elevated a little like having servers box leftover meals up. All and all a good meal but I wouldn’t have to go back.

The salmon was too die for 👏👏👏

Madison was an amazing waitress.

The bonanza red wine was delicious.

Dinner outside, on the second floor was a great way to take in state college.

Can't wait to come back here, it's got a lot of history I'd like to take in. The food was delicious. I ordered the pub burger medium. Service was attentive and knowledgeable. I'd definitely recommend it if you're looking for a bit of a higher level sit down dinner in downtown State College.

Overall underwhelming birthday meal at The Tavern. Made a reservation for 2 about an hour ahead of time (weeknight) & noted it was a birthday celebration. Started with Surf & Turf Eggrolls, cheese overpowered the flavor of the steak & shrimp, and $20 for 2 egg rolls sliced into 4 pieces total seems a little steep. Entrees were the linguine alla vongole— pleasantly surprising amount of clams included, however the white wine garlic butter sauce left a lot to be desired. A fine dish, but certainly not wowed by the flavor profile. My date ordered the burger (not a picky eater but their offerings are not really his style) and paid $2 extra to have what appeared to be a 1/2 slice of cheese on a $22 burger (chips included as side). Server was kind but not the most attentive. Worked in the service industry in numerous settings and expected better service & more wow factor flavors for a $75 meal for two pre-tip (no alcohol— 1 app + 2 entrees). Did not ask about any birthday dessert offerings & server did not mention anything, which either they don’t do anything special or it was not communicated by the host to the server. We save nice dinners out for special occasions in our household, we could afford to go out more but choose to eat healthy & cook at home and unfortunately The Tavern will not be on the top of the list to return to any time soon.

The last time I went to the Tavern was Jan earlier this year (celebrating a friend’s bday) & we were seated in a semi-private feeling alcove with a large party (10-12) that was extremely loud. Another 2 top was seated behind us and they immediately asked to be seated elsewhere. It felt like our server forgot about us tucked away in that area and again, for the claims to be one of the nicer restaurants in town, expected more of the food & the service during that visit too.

Our family had a great dinner together at The Tavern, after a Penn State event. Service was attentive and nice. We were glad we checked out this longtime restaurant when visiting campus. Excellent bar drinks. We would return to enjoy a drink in the bar.

formatted_address: 244 W Hamilton Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Wings Over Happy Valley

reviews.text: Some of the best wings I’ve had — great flavor options, sauces that actually stick, and the wings stay crispy instead of getting soggy. Portions are solid and everything tastes fresh and well-made.Only downside is the service flow: it can take around 5–7 minutes before someone gets to you for ordering or pickup, especially during busy times. There’s also no dedicated online order rack, so pickup customers may need to wait in line or get staff attention.Overall though, the food quality makes it absolutely worth the wait and money
Consistent order issues… we haven’t ordered for a while because of a past problem. We gave it a another shot tonight and they forgot half of a 10 piece order. Uber Eats gave a $2 refund…

Great spot for chicken in Happy Valley.  I tried the 2 chicken tender sandwiches and fry. I recommend getting the tenders plain and dipping them in your preference sauce. Nonetheless, highly satisfied overall.

If you’re a local than you probably noticed the great fall of this place 6 years ago, I can happily say that after my recent 2 experiences that this place is back to its former glory.

The chicken was tender and hot, the packaging is sleek and the delivery was quick.  I can’t say how happy I am that the king is back

Wings were hot and fresh!  Great tasting and had a good amount of sauce. The pumpkin spice flavor was better than expected. Our order was ready for pickup sooner than expected. Can't wait to stop back again!

formatted_address: 100 S Burrowes St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Subway

reviews.text: Walked in on a Tuesday with a coworker to get lunch. Everything ingredient-wise looked to be fully stocked so we attempted to order turkey subs. The employee kept telling us that only tuna was available. We were just trying to order from the regular menu, not the sub/meal of the day menu. After going back and fourth trying to explain, we eventually just said “okay. no, thank you then,” and left. It was bizarre. Probably won’t go back.

Usually this subway is good quality but today I ordered a sub to find it left outside on the ground with the store completely closed. The stores hours are 9-5 and I ordered/arrived to pick up my order well before closing, to leave my sub on the ground and close early without any notification is completely unacceptable. To make it worse, my order wasn’t even put in a plastic bag; just left outside on the ground with the store fully closed. Completely unprofessional management and incredibly bad customer service.
The staff members were friendly and helpful. The sandwich was great. The price was reasonable for the set meal with the sandwich, drink, and chips.

I asked a half a foot, they gave 4".
I went to get MD from the dispenser, it was Mello yellow.
Don't leave without knowing what you got.
I also the combo meal and the cashier didn't make it as requested.
The manager is passive aggressive and made several micro aggression while and after I made my order

formatted_address: 210 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Cafe 210 West

reviews.text: I loved this place during undergrad so when I came back for Homecoming this was a guaranteed stop for me! The pitchers were just as fun as I remember and the skillet fries and wings are still a hit 🔥 This will always be a State College staple 💙

I had a very disappointing and frustrating experience at Cafe 210 that raises serious concerns about their professionalism and how they treat customers. During my visit, the bartender… an old bald man w/ glasses gave a guest the wrong drink that he did not order. Instead of taking responsibility and correcting it, the situation was handled carelessly and without accountability. Mistakes happen, but the way it was managed showed a lack of attention and respect for patrons.

It got worse when that same bartender claimed that a customer’s card had declined, even though that exact same card worked perfectly fine just moments earlier with another bartender. This created unnecessary embarrassment and confusion and it is confirmed to be an honest payment mistake on the bartenders end and like he was deliberately trying to cause a problem. There was no disruptive behavior, yet his attitude was hostile and confrontational, which made the environment uncomfortable not only for that individual but for everyone nearby.

When the situation was escalated, the manager a large old bald man did not handle it professionally. He refused to disclose his name or discuss his staffs wrongful actions which is basic transparency in any customer-facing business. Instead of stepping in to calmly resolve the issue or calmly and support customers, he kept running away to the back, unwilling to take responsibility, which only made the situation worse.

Security staff also put their hands on myself and another guest who was calm and not acting aggressively, which was completely unnecessary.
Physical contact like that violates Pennsylvania State Law(in regard to assault, battery, etc.) shows a serious disregard for customer safety and proper legal conduct.

Overall, the experience reflected very poor customer service, lack of accountability, and an unwillingness from staff and management to properly address legitimate concerns. I hope Cafe 210 takes steps to better train their staff, improve professionalism and ensure that customers are treated fairly and respectfully. This is most importantly the case, especially because the staff has been analyzed and confirmed to be 100% in the wrong by industry leaders and legal professionals.

I trust that the staff’s mis-conduct can be further reviewed on security footage and interviews.

I had a very disappointing and frustrating experience here tonight. After purchasing a drink for $10, my card initially didn’t go through with one bartender. Instead of handling it professionally, he immediately blamed my bank and said, word for word, “maybe you spent too much money tonight.”

I then went to another bartender, and the same card worked without any issue, proving it was not a bank problem. When I calmly explained this, the first bartender became aggressive and shortly after I was removed from the establishment for no legitimate reason. This was only my second drink, and I was completely respectful the entire time.

Being kicked out after paying for a drink and not even being allowed to finish it is unacceptable customer service. Staff should treat paying customers with professionalism and respect, not hostility and accusations.

I won’t be returning, and I hope management addresses how customers are treated.

Terrific spot in State College to have cheesesteaks!  We visited Cafe 210 West for the first time and the vibes are definitely college bound atmosphere.  The service was fantastic!  We ordered the mozzarella sticks for an appetizer -  which were excellent.  The cheesesteaks were really good too.  It did not have a sauce which I had to order a side of marinara to add onto the cheesesteak for an additional fee.  The location has two big rooms and is self seating.  Overall a good time with good food!

Awful experience from start to finish! I don't recommend going to this place!

We asked the bouncer if there was a happy hour since there was a cover fee, and he said, "yes." I go inside and ask the bartender for a happy hour item, and guess what? He says there's no happy hour today. That was frustrating and misleading.

Moving on, we ordered drinks, which took forever to arrive. When they finally did, they were mediocre at best. Then we ordered onion rings, and they were basically burnt. They tasted terrible, like they had been sitting in old oil for too long.

The service was incredibly slow, and the staff seemed disinterested in providing a good experience. The overall atmosphere was disappointing as well; it felt more like a poorly managed dive bar than a lively café.

Cafe210 really needs to step up their game to stay relevant in the State College area. Better communication, faster service, and higher quality food are essential. Right now, it’s just not worth the time or money.

formatted_address: 364 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: The Waffle Shop Downtown

reviews.text: The place to go before the football game! Great Saturday morning eats. Sooo good!! Our server Jasmine was amazing. Her hospitality made us feel at home. She was very knowledgeable about the menu as well. Shout out to her!! We had the pecan pancakes, the waffle and regular pancakes. All top notch!! 10 out 10. The only downside is the line and wait to get in. Waited for 45 mins but it was worth it. Check them out. Highly recommended

This review is tough for me. I love Waffle Shop. I came here a lot when my wife was in undergrad. However my experience here was mixed. We waited about 20 min which is normal for a Sunday on a parents weekend. Our server was amazing, staff were great, very attentive. However the food was less than extraordinary. Me and my wife had omelets. They were okay. What disappointed me was the pancakes. Just flat, hard, nothing to them. Toast was fine, but the honeys were just big chunks of potato and unseasoned. This is in stark contrast to just a few years ago where the food seemed much better. And the costs have gone up too. For the two of us, two drinks, omelets with pancakes and another side it was $32.08 pre tip. I remember it not costing nearly as much. I know things are more expensive now but this feels absurd for breakfast. But… with eggs being $6 a dozen I don’t think I can blame the restaurant.

Talk about nostalgia!!! I brought my family here to show them how good it was and it has not changed in quality since...well 2005 when I graduated. Kiddos loved it, we love it and the service was exceptional. Gotta love how the Happy Valley spirit never dies.

The place was SUPER busy on a Sunday, 9am. Service however, was terrific: attentive and friendly. Our coffee cups were refilled upon the last sip, our requests (milk instead of half & half) easily filled, food arrived in light speed, and prices are great. I had the California Eggs Benedict, which replace the meat with avocado. The breakfast burritos, omelette, and club sandwich were also excellent!

We waited 10 minutes for seating but it was a busy morning for the restaurant. The staff kept us informed on wait times. Our waitress was very nice and attentive. The food was great, I go the meaty omelette and potatoes and it came out hot and delicious 😋

formatted_address: 116 Hiester St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Chipotle Mexican Grill

reviews.text:
Portions keep getting smaller. The server actually shook the spoon to knock chicken off of it before putting it in my burrito. Like Thomas' review, when I asked if I could get a full scoop, someone else jumped in and said well you can charge you extra for double. The pictures don't lie. Go get more value supporting a local business.
I'm sure management looks at these reviews occasionally; It'd be great to see a response.
Addendum- "please contact..." response gets you in a continuous "we'd like more information" lop with 'customer service'.

This location was out of several items and did not explain before ordering and no substitute items suggested. There was very little chicken, absolutely no fajita veggies or veggies at all, and our bowls were woefully small despite trying to fill them up with what was available. It was the middle of the day, only 2 other customers besides me, and I'm just not sure what happened. Additionally, I ordered guacamole on my veggie (without veggies) bowl and did not receive any. Should've gotten a better angle on the photo, but in my hometown a Chipotle bowl is full and brimming over as you open the lid. This was not anything close. They still charged for chips and a tortilla which were ordered in desperation to think of things that would help fill up hungry college kids moving in.

Asked for a little more chicken because I received the smallest scoop I have ever seen (and I go to other chipotles a lot), and then a different employee jumped in and replied that they’d given me a scoop so they’d charge me if I would like more. Would definitely recommend trying a different location before this one. Pics are not great but are of what is supposedly “double chicken”.

This Chipotle, located near Penn State University, was one of the best I have ever visited and here is why. The location is spacious and eve though there was a long line it did go fast.  We ordered two chicken burritos and the worker who adds the sour cream and cheese was over the top friendly even asking how our day was.  The chicken in the chicken burrito was the tastiest I have ever had.  Maybe it had more seasoning, but, whoever ever cooked it made it perfect 👍🏼. The only downfall of this location was the stale chips.  Other than that, I highly recommend it and well worth the wait next time you are visiting Penn State.

From the second you step in it smells amazing, you can tell it’s a popular place, thought there were some opens tables for lunch. The staff were really nice, efficient and gracious with their service. The chicken is great!

formatted_address: 232 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Cozy Thai Bistro

reviews.text:
Food was Great, my Server was amazing. Absolutely loved the Prik Pow and Tom Kha. Soo Glad I Went.

Only complaint is I left a $20 on the table as a Tip, wrote it on the receipt, but they charged the $20 to my card, overpaying my meal by $40. I'm not mad, but accidents happen.

All in All, Would Recommend. 4 Star
The food here is out of this world!! The Pad Thai and curry I got at Arts Festival were amazing, and the people who work there are super kind! I would definitely recommend this place!
Found this spot on the way to Ohio. The food is good and service was nice. We tried Tom Kha veg soup, Papaya salad, Green curry, Red curry and Cozy Thai Fried rice.
Thai hot drunken noodle never misses! Though legend says that you can accidentally end up with something very spicy on occasion

I have an allergy to gluten and this restaurant had always been accommodating to it.

The last time I went there, I had a few bites of my pad Thai and began coughing from an itch in my throat. I asked the server if there was a mistake but she kindly insisted my food was gluten free.
She left to triple check with the kitchen and by the time she got back we were desperately asking for the check. I was struggling to breathe, eyes watering, face burning, needing medical attention.
I was treated for a severe allergic reaction after l left.

That reaction scared me enough to not go back since this happened a year ago. I'm posting now because I see other people saying similar things making it clear it's a pattern of serious health and safety violations - extremely disappointing because I loved their food.

formatted_address: 131 W Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Green Bowl

reviews.text: Really authentic hand pulled Chinese noodle restaurant. Very reasonably priced with generous portion. I got the four in one that has four kinds of toppings. You can also choose your own protein which i chose braised pork. I also upgraded with one extra dollar to update into knife cut noodles which is totally worth it. It tasted with more texture. Also got an order of sweet rice cake with red date sauce. However the service is really chaotic. They sent my order of dessert to another table and I had to remind them to give me another serving. The boy server seemed really lost. I had to tell him what I ordered again to get my noodle dish. There’s a discount if you pay with cash.

Been thinking about my bowl for days… large portion size and the beef was super tender. The spicy bowl was the right about of spicy and was offset nicely by scallion and cabbage. Definitely coming back.

My husband went to PSU for a work trip and I found this place on the maps. ( I lived in Xi’an for 5 years and I love Shannxi food. )My husband went here, ordered food for me, and asked if they could pack the soup and noodles separately, the bun and the meat separately, because he had to drive 7 hours to bring it home to me.
The owner’s service was above and beyond, he packed everything perfectly and everything tasted great when they got here, he even gave instructions on how to heat them up too. The portion was big, the flavor was authentic and great, and mostly it brought back memories from my college years. And so much meat for each肉夹馍 we got😆
Will definitely go there next time in person if possible. Great place!
The noodles is handmade everyday and in the best of conditions, every time I enter I just had to grab a bite. What I love favorite is the beef over rice. But also their rice noodles!! Recommend!

It’s worth it if everything were $5 cheaper. It’s a good option if you’re craving a heavier beef noodle bowl. The Chinese chili sauce is unique, and the noodles are chewy with a variety of meat options. However, I find the pricing a bit unreasonable, especially since most people can’t finish the entire bowl.

formatted_address: 111 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Phyrst

reviews.text: Great college bar with live entertainment.  Visited early on a Friday afternoon was was please to see live entertainment.  Plenty of drink specials and super friendly employees.  Love the layout of party tables.  Beer was cold and shots were flowing.  Didn’t eat here but they had a lot of food specials.  Any they still do the 21st birthday hats!
bouncer was racist and wouldn’t let my friend in because he was “too drunk” even tho me and my other friend (white) were equally tipsy. don’t go here they hire racist bigoted people.

My neice and a friend were both roofied in this bar by an employee or someone acting as an employee, found at the wee hours of the morning unconscious in the bathroom and taken to the hospital! Also with the possibility of them being raped while unconscious! Multiple phone calls have been made to this establishment during open business hours with no one answering! DO NOT RECOMMEND this bar!!!!

Last night, I came here to watch live music. Luckily, it wasn't too crowded, so I could enjoy the music while ordering "The Karen" for my drink. It tasted great and refreshing. I also ordered some snacks, which were delicious as well. The service was good, and overall, this place is worth the visit.
Obviously a State College staple & it is a good time, but this place stinks, is sticky & the bathrooms are beyond gross. Bartenders are great. Bouncers are rude. Food is good. Drinks are cheap.

formatted_address: 133 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Webster's Bookstore Cafe

reviews.text:
Lovely atmosphere to sit and study in or to listen to some live music on Sundays. Nice place for events and community based things but, at least for me, not so good on the food.

I'm vegetarian and I do appreciate their fully vegan menu but often I think their food is very dry and not so tasty, especially the baked goods which are 100% gluten free and often not so good. I would like for them to have both gluten free options and normal ones, because the atmosphere is lovely and the staff as well is very kind and welcoming. The drinks are good though, I like their tea selection!

Can I please move in? This place is enchanting! There are books, coffee, food, clothes and some antiques, what else can I ask for? Loved the tables in little nooks where one can study, read or hide from the world:))). We accidentally got here, right after we have already had lunch, so we didn’t get a chance to try the goods, but this is the first place on our list for our next visit to State College

Jazz Brunch Webster's Bookstore & Cafe was delightful this past Sunday.  There was a nice assortment of brunch foods, the stars for me being the roasted potatoes, probably the best I’ve had while dining out and the fresh fruit.  The pancake texture was a little off for me, but Hubby said a little extra syrup did the trick for him.  Kudos to Webster’s for serving organic maple syrup, I hate when the only option at a restaurant is “pancake syrup” whatever all that concoction is…. The background live music was lovely and just the right volume so table conversation could still be enjoyed.  Cool place to browse, too!

I was looking for a unique spot to get some work done during my visit to State College & this fit the bill wonderfully! Great vibes amongst books & vintage shop, but slow service in the cafe due to being ran by students. They were out of both things I ordered & didn’t let me know, but when my snacks never came, the manager acted quickly to find a solution. - also great prices; there are many options $7 and under

My daughter and I discovered this bookstore hidden in State College today. We are always trying to find places that remind us of the PNW vibe where we grew up, and this is definitely it!! Vegan & GF food, good music, coffee, old books and even a cute little vintage store. We highly recommend checking this place out. The staff there are super friendly too!

formatted_address: 222 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: India Pavilion

reviews.text: My family’s favorite restaurant in State College for almost 30 years!  The lunch buffet(pictured) is delicious and always has great vegetarian food.  The owner Sohan and his family are very kind and always greet our family when we eat here. Dinner is delicious too. Prices are affordable and portion sizes are good.

Went to the India Pavilion yesterday for the first time and was absolutely pleased. Everything was fresh and delicious, the staff was hospitable and so attentive. A family member that brought me there is Vegan and it’s one of her favorite places. I will definitely return!

The food was delicious but too spicy for me.
Loved the dessert part.
They bring you some fresh Naan.
Nice hot experience!!
The thali was a great way to try everything! Spice levels were nice and not overwhelming

15/p for the buffet.

Enjoy my lunch here,
Amazing food and the spices/herbs.

I gave this place a three star based on how I was serviced. I was sat down, but DIDN’T know it was a buffet. Must be my mistake. I just wish the waiters , would tell me.  Other than that, the FOOD was amazing and had no issues with allergies otherwise.

formatted_address: 200 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Dunkin'

reviews.text: Coffee is a little bit higher than average but donuts are not good at all. And i hate “no loitering” papers! If this is a café and there are places to sit, people can enjoy! So rude!

Ordered frozen coffee. Saw the lid off blender fall to the floor. It was picked up and put on blender before blending coffee without even rinsing it off! When I picked up the drink I asked if that happened. The one who made it kept her back to me and did not acknowledge the question. The manager came over when I asked a second time and asked if I would like her to remake it. I said I wanted an honest answer to my question. The girl nodded her head yes to the manager who then turned to me and asked if I wanted it remade. Really?? Your employee just acknowledged she had picked up the tip from the floor and used it! I don’t think I would have asked the question but would have just remade it! I declined and left. Should have asked for a refund first.
Wish people treated others like they cared and showed kindness.

I called because I wasn't sure about an order I got somebody else's and I just wanted to let them know in case somebody was looking for their order.... The lady who picked up the phone started screaming into the phone that I had the wrong store and hung up on me rudest service ever
People are super nice here, the music is good, and my order always comes out as fast as possible :)
very chewy donuts, good stop for winter weather lol, staff was rlly kind and patient too

formatted_address: 148 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Panera Bread

reviews.text: This place is fine. Personally, this was the worst Panera experience I’ve had, and I wouldn’t recommend this place at all. When I ordered and received my sandwich, it was cold and didn’t have any bacon or cream cheese (which was part of the sandwich at default and was basically half the meal without it).

Great place to get coffee. However, it is not a great place to do work. There are so many nice spaces and tables but the music is so loud it pounds my head and even with noise canceling headphones I can hear the music because it's so loud. I have no idea how anyone can stand being in that type of environment for more than 5 minutes without getting a headache. It's unfortunate because it would be a great place to work otherwise.

Family fest menu from Panera!

The veggie sandwich and the greek salad were good.

The french baguette not so much (really hard for a baguette). The tomato soup was a little to strong so we mixed it with milk to get a lighter flavor.

It's a Panera. No different than any other I've been to, except they have kiosks to order at. The food is good-to-great, service time is reasonable, and their bagel/pastry offerings are pretty solid too.

Panera's are the same everywhere you go. And I suspect it's this familiarity that brings people back. That's why I come back...I can count on great quality every time. What makes this store stand out is the friendly service...and the energetic atmosphere from all the PSU students. Soup, sandwiches, salads, pastries, coffee and tea. You'll find something that satisfies you. Stop in.

formatted_address: 456 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Subway

reviews.text:
Yooo 🤘 cleanest subway I've ever seen 👌
Great service 💗 I will be back!
Good experience. Always fast and have everything ready. No complaints
Indian employee  cussed me in his own language because I was looking at the calories for too long Monday 20 October 6:22 pm
The manager knocked my cup on the ground and then got mad at me when i asked for a new one. And all of his workers are visibly scared of him. Do not go here.

Passing through the area we randomly arrived at this Subway. Didn't realize that it would be right across the street from the university. We were a bit pensive that Subway would be packed with students, but at 2 o'clock I guess they were still in their classrooms because the restaurant was almost empty. Walking in we noticed how clean/spotless this place was. Kudos to the staff for that. We ordered our favorite sandwiches and sat down to eat. While we were eating, one of the employees stopped by our table and asked if everything was good and if we need anything else. That NEVER happens in any of the other Subways in which we've eaten from coast to coast. We did get a good chuckle when he commented that we were the oldest people he's seen inside this Subway in a looooooong time 8-)  I would estimate that my wife and I have eaten at Subway across the US north to south and east to west well over 200 times during our travels, and we really love the consistency of quality, ambiance and taste at every Subway except for one that we have been to. Can't say that about any other chain food establishment. That's why we always seek out mom & pop places for breakfast and dinner, but head to Subway if we decide we need a sandwich in the middle of the day.

formatted_address: 401 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: D.P. Dough

reviews.text: I waited for 15 minutes for some soggy, cold dippers and “garlic parm stick” which were nothing more than a bread calzone with grated Parmesan desperately sprinkled on top. This place isn’t worth the price, and it definitely won’t satisfy your hunger for late night grub at 2am. Better off going to McDonald’s

I came with another person, had to wait 10 minutes just to order, and the guy left right after I ordered and didnt come back to take her order. The one calzone I had ordered took 20 minutes even though there was no one in the store. Also one calzone and a soda costs $12.67.

i have genuinely never had worse customer serve at ANY restaurant before. the person who took my order acted annoyed that i was even ordering, then when i was served my food, it was shoved into me. i will never come here again the workers are entitled and mean

Very good VEGAN options. They have 3-4 different vegan calzones and if you state, they also make the cheese sticks vegan! They probably had more vegan options but we did not check actually cause we wanted to try calzones anyways. Their marinara and garlic sauces are vegan too and they give them for free! I think I would appreciate more if they had vegan meat options too (they have vegan cheese in their calzones, and different veggies/mushroom depending on your choice). Overall good. Cheese sticks are even better than calzones 😄
Good food, loved the fact they were open so late with having to work an odd shift.

formatted_address: 232 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Starbucks Coffee Company

reviews.text: During the heavy snow today, the store manager helped me carry my items, and walked all the long way to my car through the deep snow. Your kindness in the cold weather truly warmed my day. It’s this exceptional level of service that makes this location stand out. Thank you sooooo much!

I had a wonderful time at this Starbucks location, and was impressed by the quality of services and the cleanliness of the facility. It’s in a great place for studying as well given its proximity to the campus - which I’m sure many students appreciate.

I also LOVED the calendar in the back that denoted Taylor Swift’s birthday - what a nice touch that adds some personal flare to the cafe.

Always fast, excellent service.  Daughter was a regular here throughout attending college, & we'd stop in when I'd go visit her.
I feel this location's commitment to accessibility in their providing readily accessible straws deserves it's own special thanks. Disabled customers like me greatly appreciate it!!
Crazy you guys let a guy film a video in your store making fun of a handicapped person
Give veterans and cops free or discounted coffee and confections

formatted_address: 1229 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Faccia Luna Pizzeria

reviews.text:
After hearing how “excellent” this place was for 2 years, my husband and I finally decided to give it a try. BIG mistake!
We experienced soggy bruschetta, a undercooked cheese pizza disguised as a margarita pizza over powered by garlic, a server who cared so little she didn’t even ask how our food was and forgot to take our beverage order. We were also seated in the heated outdoor patio, on a tilting table, next to a drafty window sealed with black duct tape. Don’t even get me started on the bathrooms! I can’t imagine what the kitchen looks like. Will NOT be back!

DO NOT GET THE GARLIC AND BASIL LINGUINE. IT IS AS THICK AS A STRAW AND HORRIBLY UNDERCOOKED. The kitchen CANNOT cook it any longer due to it being homemade. Avoid at all costs. Pizza is good and so is chicken ravioli, but bolognese sauce lacks flavor and meat and looks slightly like throw up. It is not visually appealing in the slightest.

Great place pizza was fire like its the best rated pizza in state college thats why i ate here and it lives up to their name from what i assume they hand made every ingredient service was slow but it was buzy night my pizza was made in 12 minutes 38 seconds yes I timed it im a local guide for a friday night thats the best time and place to get a wood fired pizza

While I did not eat inside, I did order take away while in the area. I had their potato pizza. When I tell you, I cannot stop thinking about this pizza days later. It was so delicious, crust cooked to perfection, flavors were there. I could eat here again and again. I hope you get the chance to give this place a try.

The food is so good. No reservations so get there early is you don’t want to wait. Ive only had the pasta because it is perfect.  The creamy pepper Parmesan dressing for the salad was so good and the pastas come with a salad and bread.

formatted_address: 616 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Monte Pizza & Wings

reviews.text:
If you can’t afford insulated bags for your own orders, you deal with the complaints.

If your food keeps coming out cold, that’s a failure on your end —blaming drivers for cold food just shows you don’t understand your own operation.

Cold food reflects poor equipment and low-quality prep management — exactly what you’d expect given the kitchen environment.

I feel like Monte Carlos is not talked about enough and highly underrated. I’ve had a variety of different items from pizza, wings and subs, which are all very good. I love it because they don’t do much with their restaurant and put all their effort into their food. I love the Super Italian cold sub because the bread is spot on and super crispy.
Excellent pizza, tasty @ good price.
Best pizza in state college + they have halal pepperoni but chicken isn’t halal

This is MY favorite pizza in state college.  It's so good. Any time I've gotten it I have never been disappointed -  The sauce has flavor! Great pepperonis too!

Easy easy parking - and it's free.

They're also open super late.

My only complaint is EVERY time I want them it's on the day they're scheduled to be closed! I have to wait a whole day for the pizza then!

Reasonably priced as well.
By far my favorite pizza in the area!!

formatted_address: 146 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Pho 11 Vietnamese Restaurant

reviews.text: It was pretty empty when we visited. I think most folks get takeout. I have not tried other pho restaurants in the area but this restaurant compares favorably to other places where I've eaten. We had the tofu and the chicken pho and we're very satisfied. I would definitely
Ordered vermicelli noodles and shrimp Pho and the broth was very flavorful! On a side note- my take out order had no cilantro.

The restaurant is very clean, you can order through the kiosk either on the table or when you enter on the left hand side. The food is simple but delicious. I didn’t taste the monosodium glutamate from my fish ball noodle soup. Mom is vegetarian and she order a tofu noodle soup which is great, too. She likes it a lot.

I have to be honest I was very disappointed with the experience here. If you are looking for a dine-in experience this is not it. You will not be greeted. Everything in the establishment is automated with the use of kiosks at each table and up front. It appears you can go up to the register and order with a person but you would not know that unless you regularly come to the establishment.

We ordered spring rolls and pho. The pho dishes are fairly small compared to most pho establishments. The broth was off unfortunately. The broth tasted like a salty chicken broth. The peanut sauce for the spring rolls was very vinegary as well.

We gave this establishment a 2nd chance thinking it may have gotten better over the years being open, but sadly it has not. If you are unfamiliar with what pho should be then you may be okay with what this restaurant serves, but if you know the rich flavors that pho should and can be then you will likely be dissatisfied with the dishes here.

I ordered takeout and was very saddened. The food overall is decent but it’s lacking key elements from staple Vietnamese cooking.

I got the Pho and the meat I received was not rare it was VERY cooked. The broth needed more salt and aromatics in it. Not flavorless, but needed some TLC to really make it amazing. I also did not get any cilantro or basil for toppings as well. Including my spring rolls, they lacked the basil and cilantro inside that I look forward to so much. My Thai iced tea wasn’t as sweet as it normally is as well and wished they made it on the lighter side. Positive side is that the fried egg rolls were very crisp and delicious.

I am unsure if they did this to cater to the college student and predominantly white population in State College, but unfortunately I will not be returning here. For the price point versus what i received was overall meh.

formatted_address: 107 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Local Whiskey

reviews.text:
This is a review about the Local Whiskey lunch special. It is one of my go-to options in town.

It's hard to beat this lunch special in terms of taste and value! Admittedly it is a little crowded and you might only get a seat at the bar, but it's still a great deal!

For the lunch special you can't customize anything, so it's a little rough if you have any significant dietary restrictions. But the burger is comparable to any standard burger I've had in town, and the fries are great!

Went on Friday the weekend of Penn States Homecoming. It was super busy but the service was quick and our server was very kind. We got a large cheesesteak to split IT WAS HUGE. No one was mad about that haha. The food was amazing!

This whiskey bar is an absolute gem! The decor is stunningly beautiful, creating a warm and inviting ambiance that's perfect for unwinding. And their margaritas? Absolutely awesomeEach sip is a blend of expertly crafted flavors. Plus Lobster Roll was delicious, a fantastic food pairing to complement their top-notch drinks. Whether you're a whiskey connoisseur or just looking for a great drink and bite in a gorgeous setting, this bar ticks all the boxes. The combination of standout food, amazing drinks, and breathtaking decor makes it a must-visit spot!

The burger lunch special is the best lunch special in town. No modifications on the burger are permitted, but otherwise its awesome. Under $10 for lunch and a drink is rare anywhere these days. Their tomato soup and grilled cheese are also excellent, and Ernie's Cheesesteaks are delicious.
Honey chicken sandwich is amazing! Worth a decided trip. Friend loved the girlfriend (burger not person haha)

formatted_address: 139 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Champs Downtown

reviews.text: Had some beer and watched Eagles throw interceptions Monday Night Football.  We were clearly oldest people there.  Good crowd.  Excellent service.

Lindsey was a fantastic bartender. After what I’m sure was an insanely busy day with hockey valley, she went out of her way to help me with drinks and remembered my name and order each time I went up! Sometimes when bars get packed and the staff gets overwhelmed you can feel like you’re bothering them, but Lindsey took her time to be kind to me and it really stood out to me. I always love Champs, but last night was the best!

Champs is a statement in State College. This location gets busy but it's quite large. The 360 bar has a lot of seats and, besides the first floor, there is an elevated "half floor" and downstairs floor with pool tables and other fun stuff. They card at the entrance.
The times we've been here we sat at the tables and at the bar and service was fast and the servers and bartenders were very very nice.
They have a large selection of beers and they are cheap; you can get the 16 or 20 oz and take out crowlers.
Food is good and the portions are huge.
Everything you'd want from a sports bar although it gets very busy!

The service here was top notch. We had a large party and our server was personable on time and had a great vibe, we really felt taken care of by her and the food was made quickly and they let us use the space for a long time.

I got kicked out for no reason? Of course a “drunk” person wouldn’t be coherent enough to review, but I got escorted out for wanting to use the bathroom? I’m so confused, no one would explain and I am a person of color. I feel like a problematic person wouldVe proved a reason to get kicked out but genuinely i ordered a slice of pizza and am so confused? Not a good look honestly. There’s nothing I did wrong tonight.

formatted_address: 132 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Kondu

reviews.text: FOOD IS DIFFERENT FROM ADVERTISED! Pic 1 is the gyoza and shumai shown on their menu, pic 2 and 3 are the gyoza and shumai i got. Gyoza is not steamed like the menu pic suggests, and shumai is also a completely different kind. Look up Ajinomoto shumai. I've been eating that for years so I recognized the taste immediately. The shumai I got is literally the exact same as the Ajinomoto shumai. What's going on here, Kondu?
The food is always good and is quickly prepared.   We always order takeout so have never eaten in the restaurant.   Food is ready in 15 minutes or less once order is placed and is plentiful.

I cannot make it through a visit to State College without returning to Kondu at least once. Some of the best food and boba in town, well-priced, and at an accessible location. Highly recommend checking it out.

The sushi bowl and the sushi burritos are excellent here.  They are made with fresh ingredients and are very tasty.  They don’t fill up the bowl and burritos with a lot of rice either.  However, the udon noodles are more like the Chinese stir-fried style and we're a little too salty for my taste.  The boba tea was just ok. I highly recommend this place for their sushi bowls and burritos.

I love sushi and I love burritos. We had a great meal. Super high quality and fresh meats. The burritos use a seaweed wrap with rice and went really well with Sriracha. We had several kinds of bubble tea with tappiocca balls. My first time experience with bubble tea was great. Passion fruit rules and bubble milk tea comes in second.

formatted_address: 110 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Irvings Bagels

reviews.text: Its a nice place for quick breakfast. I got the bagel pizza and everything bagel with garlic cream cheese. They were good.

During my short time in State College, this was my go-to lunch spot. It does get extremely busy during peak lunch hours, so plan accordingly. My order was made incorrectly a few times, but the staff always fixed it promptly, and when it happened a bit much, they gave me a gift card to make up for it. Big shoutout to the staff and management for their excellent customer service. Great bagels and sandwiches all around. I still haven’t found a comparable spot. Highly recommend

A New York bagel shop just across the street from Old Main, Irvings is a great place for incredible breakfast/lunch fare while catching the Penn State vibe. Home of State College’s best and IMO only authentic bagels, they are crisp on the outside, soft on the inside, with a selection from plain to Everything. Irvings has lots of cream cheeses and sandwich selections (the Breakfast Special served all-day long), awesome bread and pastries too. Then there’s the drinks, from milkshakes to smoothies, great fresh coffee and plenty of bottled drinks. The main-stay staff knows their stuff; student staff members come and go, and seem to enjoy themselves while working which makes for a better experience. It’s my go-to spot for family breakfasts, coffee with colleagues or clients, or a quick bite with friends. I love Irvings!

Great, casual place for a quick, delicious breakfast.  It is basically counter service, and then you bring your meal to your table.  I had bacon, egg, and cheese on a poppy seed bagel. 🥯   It was fresh, filling, and very tasty.  Everything was prepared within a very reasonable time.  Place was clean and comfortable.  Highly recommend.

Great experience at Irving’s Bagels! I like the atmosphere a lot. Service was friendly and prompt. There are plenty of tables to sit and study a while, and they have additional seating downstairs too, though I believe that is temporarily closed. I had a vanilla iced coffee and an everything bagel with garlic and herb cream cheese. I don’t really like their cream cheese much but it’s okay, I’ll try a pizza bagel next. Prices and vibes are good, and the location is super convenient. I’ll be back!

formatted_address: 130 S Fraser St Suite 200, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Federal Taphouse

reviews.text: I stopped here for lunch before taking my son and his roommate home for Christmas break. The service was slow, and they put mushrooms on my first pizza despite my request not to do so because of my allergy. The waiter did realize the mistake and apologized before bringing me a second correct order, but there was no credit or discount applied to my bill. It was finals week; business was slow, but it still took close to 45 minutes from order to my first pizza. The second took another 25 minutes! While service was slow, my pizza was very tasty! I ordered the Philly Cheesesteak pie, and it was a solid choice. They used Cooper Sharp which is the modern standard for cheese on a Philly steak. The tomatoes were an odd touch since no one puts tomatoes on a steak in Philly, but they did add a tangy, sweet brightness to the pie. The dough could have been cooked a bit longer with some char to lend some smokiness to the flavor profile, but this was a delicious pizza that I'd order again. The location is central and the facilities are clean and contemporary. The prices are a bit high for the quality offered, but you are paying "college town" inflated prices pretty much anywhere in State College. While the views are nothing special, it is nice to have an elevated view of downtown with lots of bright, natural light.

So I’ve eaten here several times when visiting my son at PSU. It has always been adequate. This means that you get food that is edible for a reasonable price. A place to go in a pinch. I get it, this is elevated Applebees. Not any more. You are better off at Applebees or Texas Roadhouse. At least there corporate has control. This place stinks. We got food poisoning and I will spare you the details. Just save yourself and go elsewhere. The food stinks. I said it twice.

I will say that the wait staff is nice and deserve much better.

They do serve “creamery” ice cream and that was good.

Just go anywhere else.
Peace and Love.

Espresso martini but with only half martini lol. Never have i seen this in my life. Three of us got the same exact looking martinis half full. Plus the hummus is guacamole and didn’t mention that on menu.

The host who greeted and seated us was very nice.  Our waitress never smiled or looked at us, she just look at her pad and wrote down our order. She didn’t even say thank you when she put the final bill on the table, we tipped her good because we felt sorry for her. The manager was walking through the restaurant at times, but didn’t engage with any of the tables.
The lemon-chive chicken ($25) was overcooked and so dry. The vegetables and the potatoes were perfectly cooked. Ordered a side of fries, they were served with way too little sauce. This was stated in previous reviews. My martini had floating ice chips on top. 😐  The burgers were good, but not exceptional. It was a Saturday night and in this large restaurant only four tables were taken counting us. Yikes. There are so many better options, obviously that’s why so many tables were open.
Busy spot with tons of beer on tap. It was a 2 hour wait but we found a spot to eat at the bar. Had the steak which was good but not great. Overall a good meal though.

formatted_address: 219 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Canyon Pizza

reviews.text:
Pricing is A++;  $16.99 for a XL Pizza?! Sounds like a pretty good deal to me.
I can definitely see this as a good late night option as almost anything beats Dominios.
Pizza was pretty good, the cheese kind of peels off very easily when you bite into it. Otherwise, the sauce is very sweet (which I very much enjoyed)
The store itself was a little iffy. Overflowing trashcans, some of it was blocking the door. Kitchen looked cleaned and well kept, it was just the rest of the store that definitely need more attention. Staff was great, even though it was just one guy.

Not recommended for Wheelchair or Mobility Device Users: It is a very tight, compact space that would be hard to navigate without extra assistance.

very clean and friendly staff! very impressed for a new staff and just opening up. fresh ingredients and a great menu, made too order. not your typical fast food pizza. salads are amazing and so are the wings!
Great pizza for a late night! Nice cooks and good service. New-York style pizza with a decent crust. Their $6 combo is also great.

The pizza was delicious, but unfortunately the wrong item came out with my order. I called and emailed the restaurant but never heard back. Menufy Support said the refund has to be approved by the restaurant, so I’m still waiting for a response. Hope this can be resolved soon— the food itself was good.

This is probably the filthiest place I have ever ordered take-out from. Prior health code violations, which are publicly available proves my point. I get that its a "late-night" pizza place for student who are totally sober, but come on.

formatted_address: 206 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Tadashi Japanese Restaurant

reviews.text: Definitely a nice place to visit if you're missing and/or craving Japanese foods while you're in State College. I went with my friend and they sat us at the counter. The inside dining area was a bit cramped, with there only being a few tables and the aforementioned counter spaces, but other than that it definitely hit the spot. As a note, make sure you're heading to the right Tadashi restaurant. This one is based more around the dons/ramens whilst the other one is sushi and rolls.

Small amount of seating available here. If you go for lunch be prepared to sit at the “bar”. Otherwise this place was delicious if you’re looking for pork buns and ramen. They don’t offer sushi at this location but at the other one down the road.

Yum yum yum...those are the words you will be saying when you eat here. Everything we ordered, I would 100% eat for the rest of my life. I ordered the chicken bao bun, octopus balls, vegetable ramen ( I don't eat pork) and had the creamy mango soda. The food was so fresh and flavorful. The server was very kind and did not feel like they were rushing us out, the place became very busy while we were there. The bao buns were so light and fluffy, it was like eating a cloud. I know there is no shortage of ramen places in state college but I would definitely come back here again and again.

There are two Tadashi restaurants where one caters more to rice dishes/don (this one), while the other one serves sushi and rolls. We ended up trying both restaurants during our weekend visit to Penn State.

This location has more of a casual setting, and it was really warm inside given the lack of AC and the open kitchen setup. But the food overall was much better than the other location. I wasn’t even hungry, but I took a bite of the strip steak don and couldn’t stop eating.
No sushi on the menu. Excellent stir fried pork belly.

formatted_address: 228 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Little Szechuan

reviews.text:
I had spicy Fish and sesame chicken and sweet and sour soup,
I absolutely loved fish and soup very much and would come back for those.
People were very nice, specially the lady who was our server. My little one loved her.

This cozy, spicy Chinese restaurant has a homey feel. It's always packed. The dishes are generously portioned and cooked in authentic Chinese style, without any greasy or MSG-laden flavors. The simple, home-style cooking is delicious. Prices are very reasonable. Whether you're dining with a group, a couple, or just alone, you'll find something to please.
I always stop at Little Szechuan when I am visiting Penn State, and it never disappoints.

We had a party of ten dine in today, and the staff were very attentive in setting up our table. The tofu with vegetables, fried rice, and eggroll was my preferred choice and was very good. My PIC thoroughly enjoyed General Tso's chicken, a favorite of his, along with wonton soup. Given our large group size, the food arrived swiftly, and the generous portions allowed us to take some home. It was a very enjoyable experience.

This place is an absolute must if you are craving some delicious Chinese food! I ordered way too much food after a long day and my family ended up eating all of it. We got the chili pork dumplings, which I devoured! They were deeply flavorful and just the right amount of spicy. We also got the egg rolls, which were fried and seasoned perfectly. The beef and broccoli was outstandingly done! And the chicken lowmein was incredible. Worth a trip, don't miss this place!

formatted_address: 130 Hiester St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Primanti Bros. Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text: The food was decent but way too much bread to meat ratio. Coleslaw was good in its own way but not great. Service was outstanding. With these prices, it's a good value and worth going back.

Awesome place to watch a Penn State game. Great service for a packed restaurant. All of our food was excellent. The Crazy Big Bavarian  Pretzel with hot cheese sauce and honey mustard was awesome. The fried pickles were spears which is definitely a better way to make them.  The Original Capicola & Cheese  was the perfect sandwich made as it should be with the provolone, tomatoes, fresh-cut fries and coleslaw.

Not the best Primanti bros experience. Stopped at the door due to a “barn party” but told to wait at the red line inside like normal. Seated quickly near the door. Nice views, but took the waiter awhile to come over. Drinks were made as expected (beer and orange crush). Pizza slice came out for my wife quickly but I had to wait for over 15 minutes for my chicken sandwich. Once it got to the table the fries were Luke warm at best. Chicken was cooked and somewhat hot. Other tables seemed to have the same issue of food coming out at different times for each customer. More attention was being paid to the young women coming in to get cowboy hats and leaving not ordering anything, and setting up the barn party. We ate quickly enough and left. Next time in state college I’ll find somewhere else to eat..

Embarrassed that this location has any affiliation with Pittsburgh.   Service was Slow,  disorganized and lazy.   The only food that was decent was the onion rings and they didn’t come out until after the meal.  We will not be back.   What a shame.   There are too many other options to come here.   TV volume was over the top. Way too loud.

I attended Primanti Bros Restaurant and Bar in State College, PA, three times in the last month. Every time I attended the business, Wyatt, Ashton, and Jordan worked, and they all made me feel part of a good community.

I graduated from Penn State in the 90s, and back then, the restaurant was called the Gingerbread Man [G-Man]. It was the place for fraternities and sororities. Things have not changed, and kids who frequent the bar are cool. Wyatt is excellent, too. Every time I'm there, we talk about things happening in the world. Nice guy. Ashton, the manager, treats his customers and employers equally. He has a calm and delighted demeanor that I appreciate working for a major corporation. Wish everyone had this mindset: It would help if you treated your employees how you treat your customers. It's a cause and effect.

Finally, Jordan, the bartender, is great. She attended to me quickly, and while she may have lost her grandfather while working on a busy weekend night, she continued to serve her customers with a good attitude. Bless her. The P-Man has become one of my favorite places to get a hefty sandwich or burger and be on my way. Thanks for treating me well again, on a Monday night.

formatted_address: 28 Hub-robeson Center, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Sbarro

reviews.text: The pizza here is fine if you need to get a quick bite to eat!

I’ve loved this place, and am always craving their 4 cheese white pizza. Lines can get long around 12 till 2 though when students are on lunch break and seats fill up fast. I’d suggest ordering ahead for a particular time if you want to get the meal quickly during the time you are there for lunch.

Loved coming here frequently when I was at PSU for undergrad. Staff is very friendly and food (pizza, strombolis, ziti, sandwiches) is pretty good though I did prefer the old design/layout of the seating area from pre-Fall 2019.

My favorite food here is 'Sausage and spaghetti, with two spoons of red source, and pepper and onion'. The inflation is so bad in the past few years but the price is still very cheap. As a fast food chain, you cannot expect anything more than that.

Sbarro offers overpriced low-quality food. You pay 4 dollars for a small slice of pizza and then it's really nothing special, but average quality. The pasta is also terrible, sometimes even a bit overcooked and with almost no vegetarian options. I only come here if I really want pizza, but don't have enough time to go downtown. They do have some delicious strombolis, but nowadays they don't offer the vegetarian option anymore. Otherwise, I would have come more often, just for the stromboli.

formatted_address: 7 HUB, Hetzel Union Building, Pollock Rd, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Hibachi-San

reviews.text: I had recently taken a trip to the University of Penn State and decided to go to the hub for some nice hibachi. My son Ja’Hilton (named after place of conception) and I ordered food from a grumpy Jewish curly hair big nose Jew. I have nothing against the Jews however my service was awful. He told me that he could tell I had marriage issues (recently gone through a divorce) and made other comments to my son Ja’Hilton (polio survivor). The food was edible, the chicken was under cooked. Would not recommend.

I ate a lot of poke in my life, and this one is the worst!!!
Absolutely disgusting, inedible!
The salmon does not look fresh at all, the avocado is repulsive!
The white rice was good.

Out of all the places I have visited, this was definitely one of the worst restaurants I have been to. The portions are skimpy, the workers are rude, short-tempered, and overall angry, and the food was lousy and cheap. I would certainly not recommend eating here to anyone whatsoever.
Tasty, a lot of rice. They were out of a lot ingredients like seaweed and avocado. It was weirdly difficult to get soy sauce packets. FYI, the "kale salad" base is just cabbage, not kale.

Sorry, don't usually like to criticize locally owned places, but the poke bowl I got here was simply not very good.  The salad that came with it should have been tossed a few days ago.  Rest of the ingredients just did not look or seem fresh. Service was quick and friendly. Lots of potential - but Penn State students deserve a great poke place!

formatted_address: 28, HUB-Robeson Center, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: McAlister's Deli

reviews.text: I just loved this place when I was in Illinois living there for work. I have never seen one in Pittsburgh or the surrounding area yet. I ran into this place while here on a 2 month vacation and just had to have it. I got the large itilian and my daughter got the club and both were so good. I also recommend the Mac n cheese and sweet tea. I will definitely be visiting again before I leave.

You don’t see many McAllister’s around this area at all. It’s really nice that they have one in the Hub for in between classes. I think the quality of the product is always really good and consistent. The New Yorker is my favorite sandwich here, but you can’t go wrong with any of the combination of sandwiches, soups or salads. They also have some of the best tea.
One of wholesome meal in the HUB. Recommend The McAllister Club or Grilled Chicken Club with potato salad or fruit cup! Angus beef club was not as good even though it was a bit more expensive.
Not bad. The toppings on the potato could be a little bit more plentiful but the flavor was good

One of my favorite places in the HUB. Their unsweet tea is great (the best on campus in my opinion). I really enjoy their French Dip, Chili, and Mac and Cheese. There seems to always be a shorter line or they just move very quickly.

formatted_address: 418 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Big Bowl Noodle House

reviews.text: This is definitely 5 stars! We were craving some Chinese food and looked up what was in State College. This place had the highest reviews so we decided to give it a try. It did not disappoint. The atmosphere is nothing special, but we couldn’t care less. You order your food at the counter and they call your number when it’s ready and you go to the counter to pick it up. No big deal to us that it’s not the type of restaurant where they serve you at your table. I had the Thai chicken pho noodle dish and my husband had the general Taos chicken. Both were probably the best we’ve ever had. So, so good! We will absolutely go back

Big portions, low prices, and actually good flavor.

Came with a friend, we knew we were over-ordering, but the portions were even bigger than expected. The noodles had great texture, and the sides were solid too. We can't believe we finished them all XD

It’s also right downtown, which makes it super convenient to grab a quick, affordable meal between classes. This is the kind of place you accidentally over-order at… and don’t regret it at all. Definitely coming back.

This was my favorite place to eat during undergrad. I came back to visit this week for Homecoming and this place hasn’t lost a beat! The food was delicious as always! This is a State College hidden gem

We were recommended to this place by a local and it did not miss. Food was fresh and portions large. Service was fast and friendly. Honestly, not sure what else you could ask for. There were plenty of options to choose from. I ordered the Singapore noodles and steamed veg dumplings.
Authentic food. College student friendly.  Friendly service. Located below street level. Tip: try the fried tofu.

formatted_address: 428 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Tokyo Sushi & Hibachi

reviews.text:
Excellent sushi and excellent service! Really enjoyed all of the sushi and rolls we ordered. My dining partner really enjoyed the vegetable tempura, but I thought it was just OK. The frying oil tasted old to me. I mentioned it to the owner/manager who genuinely cared about my complaint and said she would inform the kitchen.
The restaurant was surprisingly busy for a Sunday around 6 PM - it's obviously popular!

Really enjoyed this place. The service was very nice and the server really paid attention to my requirements. Food tasted great and was very fresh. Portions were good and everything came out pretty fast. 😄Btw I strongly recommend the fashion roll, best sushi roll ever

Every semester, I come here multiple times to enjoy Japanese cuisine. The ingredients here are fresh and the dishes are diverse, such as salmon sashimi and eel sushi, all of which are very delicious. The pleasing presentation of the dishes also shows the store's attention to details. The staff's attitude is also excellent. They always ask for my opinion on the taste of the dishes and do their best to meet my requests, such as grilling the chicken skewers more tenderly and providing free refills of cola. The environment and table settings of the restaurant can also accommodate multiple people for a meal. In the future, I will bring friends here to experience it.

Just passing through the area and kids wanted hibachi. Unfortunately they do not have a hibachi “show” but the food and great service make up for that. Everything was fresh and delicious, many unique options to choose from. Waitress was wonderful. Highly recommend.
The sushi here is so fresh and well-balanced and the hot dish is very comforting, making the experience feel relaxed and welcoming.definitely a place I’ll be coming back to.

formatted_address: 215 Bigler Rd, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Pollock Commons

reviews.text:
One of the main locations for in-campus dining.

Spacious seating areas with wonderful view overlooking Pollock residence hall garden and East side of campus.

Fancy design, and most importantly healthy and fresh nutritious food served.

Deliciously prepared meats, fish and other entrees, let alone the salad bar! Vegetarian, vegan, gluten and lactose free options always available. Special varieties are also offered for Halal dining and during the months of Ramadan.

Breakfast includes the cottage cheese unavailable in other locations.

Kudos to all the hard-working staff for making the place so fabulous!
The food is absolutely amazing! The workers are very kind! And the environment is very pretty and comfortable! I absolutely love this place.
I think the picture is self-explanatory. Get the grilled chicken if you want to live like our ancestors and enjoy the raw meat 🍖
Great variety and really easy to see potential food allergies.  Good labeling.

The best place in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. Pollock Commons has a spectacular Stepmania machine, pool + ping pong + arcade games+ a piano, better food than the other dining halls, and the coziest hangout space anywhere on campus.

formatted_address: 226 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Five Guys

reviews.text: We ordered 4 sets of fries and this was all that we received. They were very small. No extra fries hidden in the bag.

I ordered two Bacon Cheeseburgers through website. However, the delivery was canceled due to the large volume of order and I did not get what I ordered at that time. The payment was still processed and it was charged to my credit card. I called the branch but the staff just repeatedly said the refund will be processed within five days, though it has been more than seven business days, and suddenly hang up the phone. This is a terrible experience. If you canceled my order, you should have processed refund from your branch.

Ordered 2 burgers through Doordash. The patties were missing in both, and one of them had bits of sharp metal in it. Bad food is one thing, this place literally tried to kill me. The delivery bag was sealed, so this issue was 100% the fault of the restaurant.

I visited here a few days ago with my husband. Since it was our first time, we were a bit confused about how to order, and we didn’t ask the staff for help. So, the burger we got was just the bun and patty, with no toppings. It was a funny experience. The plain burger, coke, and fries cost around $20, which is quite pricey, but fortunately, it was delicious.

Very pleased with this Five Guys location near Penn State University.  This was definitely a five star because of several reasons.  For one, the location is very well maintained and clean.  The staff and service were excellent.  It was the first time that I ever saw a staff member actually shape the toppings on the burger to fit the burger.  Meaning if the bacon was too long, she snapped the bacon and layer the remaining piece on top. Great attention to detail on a burger! The drink machine was good, however one machine had no ice.  There is plenty of room and spacious to dine in at a safe distance during COVID. The burger and fries completed the experience as both were made perfectly and fresh.  Congrats for a great job 👏🏼!

formatted_address: 120 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Masala Palace

reviews.text: We had their great lunch buffet. I’m grateful that even though we arrived toward the end of their lunch hour they made more chicken, lentils and vegetables for us. And… the fresh made naan that they brought out to us twice, was fresh and hot and fantastic! The service was very attentive and anticipated what we would need before we asked for it.

Nice authentic Indian cuisine.  Lunch buffet every day and supper buffet Fri-Sun.  Traditional menu also available.  Be sure to check hours as they close in mid afternoon.  No street parking on block, so a little walking is necessary.

A great place to enjoy the Indian Cuisine with all its diverse dishes and intensive use of spices. You can have a lunch buffet with your friends or family for an affordable and a reasonable price and with a large variety of delicious food. Great location, friendly staff and great service.

I was glad to find Indian food especially vegetarian in State College. Ordered vegetable makhani, roti and mango kheer. It was delicious, finger licking.
Two days later ordered malai kofta, Kashmiri naan, vegetable pakoras and the delicious mango kheer.
Large portions comes with rice, easily serves 2.   Packing is durable and food arrives hot.  Ordered on Uber Eats.
Will definitely try other vegetarian meals.

Tried the Lunch Buffet there in Apr 2018 when I was there with my team from India to participate in the E-Fest HPVC at Penn State University. The owner was really friendly, made us feel welcomed in US and congratulated us for being the only team from India in the competition. Will definitely visit again next time I'm in Pennsylvania now that I'm living and working in US.

formatted_address: 430 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Uncle Chen's

reviews.text: Called in an order for pick up it was a plain lo main and plain fried rice I asked if they’d put broccoli in both dishes tossed in the same sauce. I get there go walk to the door there’s a guy passed out in the chair the lady asked me my order I got it there was 2 soy sauce I asked for some more sauce I like it saucy if I need to pay for more I could have. She gave me 2 more soy and 2 duck meanwhile this is not just for me it’s feeding 3 everyone need at least 3 sauces for the unsauced lo main noodle I got never ever will I be going back they continue to disappoint. Honestly I’m just taking the picture the noddles look tasty it looks good but it tastes like chemicals straight up chemicals there was hard burnt pieces in my noodles I didn’t even take 3 bites  before not being able to stand it anymore.

Appears Friday night is not a good time to order delivery! The food was lukewarm upon arrival, and of poor quality. The fried rice was obviously just made and lacked body and flavor. Might have been fried for like a minute! My wife’s chicken dish had lunchmeat in it. And no fault of Uncle Chen’s but the delivery (Grubhub) was a bit late and again the driver failed to read our delivery instructions even with a 20% tip! Grubhub tipping is flawed as a tip is to reward good service but when it’s collected prior to the job being completed it’s not fair to the customer. Bad bad night!!

Very rude customer service and will hang up on you if they think they know what you’re gonna say, delivery will usually take awhile and you can’t track em because they don’t use DoorDash. Fried rice has no flavor. Def would recommend the other local Chinese spots in downtown like  lil Szechuan!! Huge portions cheap food that’s actually delicious!
