This is the worst place I have ever been to I spent over $30 on 2 orders of chicken wings one with white rice one with shrimp fried rice. The wings on the website is completely different than what I got. The picture on the website the wings look very light as why I asked for them to be well done. BURNT AND WELL DONE ARE 2 different things. My wings are burnt. I don’t know who told this  is fried rice but it clearly is not. Upon arrival when asked for a cup of ice the man was rude. I called them about my over cooked food and the woman act like she didn’t understand what I was saying the guy was rude and told me there was nothing he could do. I said I spent my money there for food to eat not waste. He asked them woman if she told me the price over the phone. She said yes he said u agreed to pay , he is sorry but there’s nothing he could do and hung up the phone. Like clearly you can make more wings. So it’s ok to take my money and try to make me eat food as if I am an ANIMAL. Definitely not ok I will never eat here again.

Worst general tso chicken I’ve ever had. Soggy, dry, bland, and some pieces tasted completely different than others. I’m surprised how high the reviews are. Clearly state college residents have no perspective of real American Chinese. $14 for a plate I can’t finish. Terrible.

formatted_address: 540 Westerly Pkwy Unit 19 Ste 19, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Domino's Pizza

reviews.text: We order from here pretty often, and the food is always as ordered with no problems and on time which is great in itself. However, what really made me want to write this review doesn't actually have anything to do with the food itself, rather with what I saw this restaurant is doing for its community. With SNAP benefits in danger with the government shutdown I saw that this restaurant is offering free pizza to anyone on SNAP benefits who needs food for the time being, no questions asked. I think this is a really beautiful gesture an indicative of what it really means to be part of this community. While this isn't something I need to take advantage of myself. I know this will help a lot of people and I really want to praise the restaurant for doing such a great thing

The things this restaurant is doing for the community and leading by example is commendable. Their stance on providing a hot pizza for people who don’t have EBT benefits this month is so selfless and shows how this world still has people who care for each other. While I was waiting for my pizza with an empty stomach, I heard how they were communicating and lifting each other up when things were running smoothly. God bless these workers and this restaurant. All glory to Him 🦆🤎🙏

For some reason this specific Dominos location stores its pizza dough in a way that greatly compacts it. The result is that a majority of the pizzas delivered from there are largely thin and flat regardless of what crust type is ordered. Worse, since the crushed pizza dough is unable to rise while baking pizzas are regularly delivered with raw dough that wasnt able to bake as a result - creating potential health and illness issues. This is the only location in town that I have this problem with and it happens regularly when the online tracker says that the manager is making it.

Of all the Dominos locations I have eaten at, this one has been consistent only in being the worst of them over the last five or so years. Unfortunately it is the one that defaults to delivery to my home location. I have filed a number of concerns in the past and the manager has never responded to them. If you want dominos, dont order from this location even if it means you have to drive to the North Atherton store instead.

Below is a picture of my most recent "deepdish pan pizza" crust from this location. The dough is raw and it isnt edible. Im not going to make myself physically ill simply because this store cant follow basic health codes.

Good pizza. We often do the $7.99 carry out special (used to be $6.99) for $8 you can feed 3+ people with a pizza. Definitely worth the price.

Sometimes the quality differs between each employee. But all the employees are nice and quick to help when customers come.
Great pizza & quick service. Love that they had seating for the kids to sit & wait for our order.  Comfortable enough they wanted to stay to eat :)

formatted_address: 320 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Yummy Cafe

reviews.text: Had a **stellar** meal here with friends. Everything was delish, but the standouts by far were the flash-fried, shell-on shrimp dusted with cornstarch and SALTY DRIED GRATED DUCK YOLK (OMFG!!!), and the chongqing chicken. Light, crispy, perfectly seasoned. Best Sichuan food in town.

I got the  cold spicy sriracha noodles, and my other half got the spicy beef with veggies. We also got dumplings. 10/10 Would get the cold noodles again. They also have this amazing green tea. Everything was chef's kiss 🤌🏻 Also I did not expect to get that much food! Other places will skimp on the food but they really over stuffed us!

Overall, this place was pretty good. I can say the  steamed pork buns were out of this world good, as well as the orange chicken. I got the dirt rubbed pork feet and I can say it was not worth the price. There wasn’t much to the meal and it was $16, plus it was absolutely caked with chili flakes and powder. It almost completely overpowered the meat itself. I would definitely come back and try something different.
Had a great meal here and service was amazing. Will definitely be back for good asian cuisine.
i love this little shop. always feel good, food tastes great, and love coming here. if youre looking for somewhere new, try yummy.

formatted_address: The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Burger King

reviews.text: Sometimes I feel shocked at how ordering one single burger could cost you wait 25 min

3 stars only because of an early closing time at 4. Like, this needs dinner time too. It’s Burger King, so what you expect from a Burger King is what you will find. I happen to like Burger King, and this one is done very well. Service is quicker than you’d think, even at a busy time. Order ahead if you are worried about lines.
Got a "Big" Fish sandwich meal about the size of a pb&j. Paid $7 dollars to be hungry 3 hours later. Nothing against this particular BK but against them in general. The workers here are nice enough.

I like Burger King much more than McDonalds, mostly because they have a good vegetarian burger. I come here every few months when I really want to have some burger with fries. They are quick and you know what to expect.
It is better than mc actually. In any case it should be better.

formatted_address: 452 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Beijing Restaurant

reviews.text: I don’t think there was anything special with this place. It wasn’t bad, but it wasn’t the best either. The meat and veggies were solid, but the rice was pretty bland and loaded with onions. There are a lot of other places in the area that are worth going to over Beijing.
Fair Chinese food here. It is not very authentic but overall is not bad. If you pass-by by any chance, you can give it a try.

Consistently provides high quality dishes at a reasonable price - we're never nervous to try something new each time we order. Even through delivery, our food arrives warm and delicious! 10/10 will do it again... and again... and again!
Decently priced, decent food. Would go again!

Best General Tso's in town! They've got the good, deep red sauce with all the flavor. Food is always super hot and comes out fast. Great fried rice, tasty egg rolls with great texture, good won ton soup. I've been going here for years, tried most places in town, and for my usual foods this place is the best hands down. Never had a bad order.

formatted_address: 238 W Hamilton Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Brother's Pizza

reviews.text: Today was my first time going, and my boyfriend and I had such a great experience! The owner was very kind, and he definitely stays busy! He takes the order then goes back and makes everything, so you know it's amazing home cooked pizza! The restaurant itself is so cozy, and there's even some personal pictures from the owner and his wife of reptiles and their dogs to add a personal feel to the place. The food was amazing, the owner was amazing, and the atmosphere was so cozy. I'll definitely be back!!!

The guy who owns this is a straight up miserable nasty person. My friend went to get one slice and they had a $8 minimum. When my friend came back without pizza and let me know, I decided I could eat too so I went in. Before entering, my friend let me know that the guy working was kind of mean. This mentally prepared me for what was going to happen next. I was going to keep it simple and get 3 cheese slices. Then I noticed there was only 2 pepperoni and 1 cheese slice available. In the time that it took me to ask my friends if they were okay with pepperoni (2 seconds) the guy threw his hands in the air and angrily said “come on what do you guys want”. I said “are you serious” and he said “yea I’m serious” and from there it escalated into a yelling argument while he was preparing three simple slices that were already made. Mind you, the restaurant was not busy and had one table. He also waited minutes to even acknowledge us which is no problem at all, but then to throw a fit because I ask my friends if pepperoni is fine? It’s clear based on the other reviews that I’m not the only person this has happened to. And to the owner reading this; I hope you can find some peace in your life and stop intentionally ruining the peace of others. Pizza was good though.

Well our pizza was supposed to be half pep and half pineapple but as you can see from the photo it must have been thrown around during delivery. The pizza had almost no sauce but the pepperoni and crust was very good. My salad was also $10 and smaller then my hand, missing the hard boiled egg that was listed as included. All in all for spending $60 on a pizza and miniature salad, this was not worth the money :( i was also supposed to have a roll come with the salad that was not included.
Hopefully i just ordered on a bad night because the pizza has great potential but delivery, price, and including everything listed needs to be improved

STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE! I Would give negative stars if possible!
Openly rude and treated poorly even after ordering! So we decided to leave. Definitely NOT GAY FRIENDLY either. Not one person was in this establishment, but the man acted too busy to take an order from us. Either the cook or owner was openly RUDE! He was the only employee in the place at that time. It was 7pm. Great way to waste your time. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!
My favorite pizza in all of State College, and the place hasn’t changed a wink in almost 30 years! Love the nostalgia, it’s th perfect pizza if you’re used to Philly/NJ pizza.

formatted_address: 334 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Pita Cabana Grill

reviews.text: Great for people with dietary restrictions, good vegetarian options, generous portion sizes all for a good price! Pictured here is a small falafel bowl with extra toppings- they didn’t charge me extra for the toppings though! The sandwich is a chicken sandwich. We were both really hungry and still both ended up with leftovers! 10/10 recommend

Definitely a great place for Mediterranean food. The quantity they give is huge. Hummus and baba ganoush exemplify the taste. We took rice bowls and felt very heavy. I think sandwich is a better option as it’s grilled and this carries heat into the food. The price is also very affordable. The bowls come in 2 sizes (regular and large). Sandwich comes only in one size though.
I would strongly recommend people to try this. If there are any vegetarians reading this, Falafels here are the best I have had!! So I recommend trying this place.

Ordered chicken shawarma plate and was so bad, it was the end of the shawarma that they have and most of the chicken I got was fat and skin which is disgusting for me.
Also ordered Falafel rice plater and it was one of the worst Falafel I’ve ever tried.
Our third order was gyro rice plater which was eatable but will never order it again.
Lady who’s taking orders doesn’t have idea about Arabic food.
I might go again to try the whole chicken with rice.

Is Pita Cabana authentic? No. I must have had hundreds of gyro/doner/shawarma in my life and have never seen shawarma served like this (meat with cheese and toasted like a quesadilla).
Ok, but is it tasty? I mean, if your definition of tasty is underseasoned fries and meat with cheese in pita with nothing fresh or bright in the vicinity, go for it. Lebanese food is served with fresh vegetables/salad to balance and brighten things, which you’d assume a “platter” would come with. Unfortunately not.
Maybe I ordered the wrong thing, but my plate had no redeeming qualities.

On the positive: The two employees were very friendly and nice.

I’ve never in my life have been so disappointed. I do not like ketchup and getting it ALL OVER my shish tawook is insane. Platters are NEVER consistent and I just want to know who thought this was ok?!!!?! Honestly, I’ve only had one good experience here, but it doesn’t deserve more than one star.

formatted_address: HUB-Robeson Center, 201 Old Main 7, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Panda Express

reviews.text: It’s Okish store for getting food. The meat tasted ok but the 1 star was given due to the reason of we were served with partially cooked rice!. The one in the pic was cooked ok but the other bundle we got is with partially cooked (we were served in a hurry to serve the crowd )

I got this crispy almond chicken breast, and I am so embarrassed with this 5 pieces…
The rice is not fully cooked. It’s like pebbles. Too hard to chew and even the sauce is not fully mixed.
The price is unreasonable for this amount.
Pretty good Chinese food for the quantity and price!
The food is good. But they use a lot of sugar in the food i think. Anyway, it can be tried.
$9 with tax for a small bowl of dry noodles and a scoop of chicken. (pic is partially eaten). price should be adjusted because this is just not it man.

formatted_address: 433 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Zen Wings and Things

reviews.text: By far the best wings in State College. This place is awesome. The boneless wings are crazy good and very reasonably priced. The service is excellent and the owners are always super nice. It is also always ready super quick. I will definitely be getting it a lot more.  HIGHLY recommend.

Holy Toledo.

Zen wings.

Thats really all i need say.  the wings here were so awesome I almost fell apart like if you kicked a bick stat of legos over.  um I ate wings here and thy were insane. .  think about your favorite wing.  like the best wing maybe from buffalow wild wings or someplace else i dson't know them all.  Zen wings is like that but on super crazy mega steroids.  This is literaly the epitome of food.  if gordon ramsay or anthony buroardain (Rest in piece) came here they would probably get on the ground and kiss the hand of the owner of zen wings

there is literally nothing in the world that brings me joy to eat after eating here.  each meal attempts to fill a hole that cannot be paved by anything but the taste of a yummer zen wing.  i eat but i don't feel.  there is an idea of food, but it doesn';t really exist.  you may enter my mouth or digest in my stomach, but there is no real fill.

if you eat send wings.  you wil have a new life and each minute spent away from zen wings will rot away your body.

It's not very often that I rate 5 stars... but this place deserves that and more. Minutes within placing my online order, they told me they were out of onion rings (which I do want to try at some point, because I have a feeling they will be bomb... but if you're out- you're out) and they gave me options of how to sub it out.  It took a while to get my order... but because they go above and beyond and do everything themselves.. it's more than worth it. It's very rare that you get this level of people service these days
And the flavor of the food on top of it all!! I can't recommend this place highly enough! Not 5 stars - 10 out of 10!!

When I say I’ve never had a more orgasmic experience from consuming food, let alone chicken wings, I have never been more correct. I ordered their dry rub jerk and spicy spicy and I was taken to nirvana. The fry is immaculate and the rub was spicy yet perfectly seasoned. I have never written a review on a place before but Zen deserves every word of praise. PLEASE give them a try!!!

I think it’s important to recognize that many of the bad reviews of this place are from years ago. If you’re expecting a standard American wing experience when you come to this place, you’re already coming in with the wrong mindset. The winds are slightly light on sauce, but still heavy on flavor thanks to a well-spiced breading. When I know I want chicken but not the typical wing experience, I order from zen wings and things. Their boneless wings are fantastic and I’ll always come back to them when I want some wings with flair.

Edit: gotta try their fried dumplings, too. They’re next level. Another combination you can’t get at your traditional wing stop!

formatted_address: 110 Sowers St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sharkies Bar & Thrifty Bottle

reviews.text:
Dear Sharkies,
This is a love letter, from an alumni:

My friends and I were brave to venture into Sharkies, always under desperate times, which included: bar crawls (mandatory stop if you want to complete it), being in the area and lazy to go anywhere else, covers everywhere else, “let’s grab a drink from their fridge, pay and leave”, lets play pool where it’s not packed (champs), let’s go for the meme, let’s go for the thrill of danger. And those occasions only.

Sharkies is the champs of the townies. It’s where you will see, in one place, all local ICE supporters at once. If you want to experience what ‘merica feels like, Sharkies might need to be on that list.

As soon as you walk in you are greeted with the warm, unwelcome, disgusted, looks of the townies sitting by the bar and by the pool tables . It’s a mutual connection, where you know you don’t belong there and so do they. But they accept you still…reluctantly.

You go up to the bar and order a ranch water so you can fit in among the folks. By the time you do so, your girl friends have already been looked up and down and hit on at least once by a white 50 year old looking male. You start to settle in and feel at home. Your American home.

Now comes the dangerous part. Playing pool. Most likely, the top floor pool tables will be under use by the regulars. Somehow they are always there, playing non stop, for hours.
I MUST WARN YOU: Do NOT play against them. You WILL get humiliated. You WILL get mocked. And you WILL want to crawl to your shower and cry. IN CASE you DO play against the townies, do NOT friendly mock them back or taunt them. I speak from personal experience. My friends wanted to kill me thinking that I was going to get us all beat up.

In case you follow my advice and you don’t play on the first floor, you then must venture into the basement. We might as well call it a bunker, bc once you do down there, you switch to survival mode.

To compare, walking down to the basement of Sharkies, is like walking into Chernobyl, you will experience radiation. Beware.

As you go down the stairs, hopeful that you will have a good time playing pool with your friends, you are flash banged with the immense smell of cigarettes. You immediately develop stage 4 lung cancer as you inhale the air of that basement.
You stumbled down the steps, waving your hands trying to disperse the heavy clouds of smoke, like as if you are in the Amazon forest jungle shaping a trail with your machete by cutting the vegetation ahead. El dorado style. There aren’t enough words to describe that floor, so I will leave you with just a simple yet beautiful comparison: Sharkies basement is like a drunk cig.

If you survive from the townies in the first floor, and from the cancer downstairs, you will find a table available at the basement, and a chance to see a band playing live too if you are lucky.

You play pool with your friends, and decide you had enough. You leave Sharkies and you find yourself changed. You have grown. Experienced. Matured. You will take this experience on, and one day, write a review about it.

Sharkies has fallen off so hard, no more parking, no basement, pool tables and cues are missing at worst; broken at best.

Used to love going here and had great interactions with staff. Nowadays I have no reason too, go to the brew or Zenos for a better establishment, see you there!

I’ve never had such a personalized experience at a bar since I met Paulie from sharkies. Although it wasn’t necessary, Paulie came over to our table when he was bartending to see if we needed anything and ask how are night was. My friends and I love that fedora wearing man!!

My overall grade for Sharkies Bar is: D

1 person to scan IDs

1 person behind the bar

Service is horrible.

Outside seating is nice, but not really a people-watching area.

Just an ok experience
Closed early for 3 day weekend and let you order drinks right before close. No care for customers

formatted_address: 134 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Fiddlehead

reviews.text: Fiddlehead is easily one of the best-rated spots in State College, and it makes sense why — the salads are genuinely fresh, high quality, and made to order with tons of topping options. Everything tastes crisp and balanced instead of heavy or processed, and portions are filling without feeling overly greasy.The consistency, ingredient quality, and fast, efficient service are what really set them apart from other places. The atmosphere is clean, relaxed, and perfect if you want something healthy that still tastes amazing.

I am constantly visiting this restaurant in State College. I don’t know any other restaurant with a salad bar better than this one. Everything they serve is healthy and fresh. They also prepare soups everyday which they advertise in the board at the end of the restaurant. Today, they offered the pepper with crab soup, and they are always having something different.
Besides those positive comments, I would like to do two suggestions:

1.	Sell smaller salads. It is true that many people like the whole container, but I find in my experience that the right size is half of the container they have now.
2.	Measure the quantity of dressing. As it is right now, you will get what the person who is preparing your salad considers it is “light, medium, or a lot” dressing.
3.	Every time I go there, I see a lot of food wasted while they are trying to move the prepared salad to the container to go. An idea I have is to move the salad over a refrigerated container and sell it as “the mixed” salad for less price. For people with no allergies, that would be an option to save a dollar and get the “salad of the day.”

If you're looking for a salad the size of your head and loaded with toppings, this is the place. You can order directly from the menu, mix up a menu item or do a 'create your own.' There are tons of options for toppings, protein and dressing. I particularly like that they ask you if you'd like light, medium or heavy dressing.

I'm particularly a fan of the las cantinas salad with crispy chicken.

There's also a selection or pre-made options if you're in a rush or want something small.
So good! Tried this place out today and got a build your own salad and I was so happy with the options for toppings and vegetables. I will definitely be back!

Yes you'll pay between $9-$12 for a salad but the salad is pretty big and the ingredients are fresh. You can choose from the preselected salads or you can make your own. The wait is semi long during lunch hours.

formatted_address: 222 W Beaver Ave Suite C-2, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Margarita's Pizzeria

reviews.text: While in town for a family trip, we decided to skip cooking and ordered pizza from Margarita's. It was really good. When I went to pick up our order, the owners were incredibly friendly and struck up a great conversation while I waited for the pizzas to be ready. Their sauce was a 10/10 – highly recommend.

I went to Penn State for 6-7 years (don't judge me) the previous decade. Margarita's was my go-to!

Embarrassingly, I really don't have much to say about their pizza, I've actually never tried it.

HOWEVER - Their baked Italian Sub is top-3 on this planet! Maybe #1 (I've tried a lot).

Perfectly toasted with right amount of dressing with premium meat/cheese. It's also ginormous so come hungry. I'd actually recommend not eating at all the day before you're planning to try one. I literally cannot order another menu item because I enjoy it so much and don't want to deviate from the script. They're not open on weekends, so I usually will take at least one Friday off a year during PSU football season to come up and get one - it's THAT important.

This may be burying the lede, but Juan and Margaret are the nicest folks. My I went in with my brother (who was also a regular) during his time at State, and Margaret remembered his exact order! After 10 years!

Anyway, Margarita's is a local treasure and you should try it out.
Great food and friendly staff.  Unfortunately since they are not open on weekends I rarely get to enjoy their pizza.  When I worked downtown I ate lunch there at least once a week

Some of the best pizza I’ve had in State College. The owners were nice and seemed like they were close with their regular customers. I had plenty of leftovers for the next few days. There is a $10 minimum for credit card so just be aware of that.

People here are super nice. Had a great conversation with one of the owners about her Italiy trip. Pizza was excellent. Solid slice. Sauce very good. Great Place. I would go again next time in Happy Valley.

formatted_address: 418 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Penn Kebab

reviews.text: It’s been almost 2 years since I graduated college and I still think about this amazing place. The food is delicious and always hot and ready. The owner is a wonderful, pleasant man happy to serve his customers. Without a doubt, the next time I’m in state college, I’m stopping by here to relive the taste of a chicken plate which kept me fed during my college years ❤️
Personally the best kebab in state college! Especially is you are used to the European style kebab rather than the American gyro.
Chicken gyro was phenomenal!!Make sure to try it if you happen to be at state college
My favorite food spot in state college. Been a fan since they opened 10+ years ago.
This is our favorite place to grab a quick bite downtown. The owner is extremely friendly and treats us like family. He puts so much care into his food. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: Pegula Ice Arena, 829 University Dr, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Subway

reviews.text: Very friendly but sometimes staff is in the back and it takes a while to get their attention

The person who was making my sub didn't clean the knife used to cut the sub before mine. So all the residue from the previous sub went onto my sub. The person ahead of me got a bunch of pickles on their sub, and when i saw pickles on my sub i knew they had to have been from the knife. I didn't order pickles, because i'm allergic. So, that left me concerned to eat the sub. I ended up throwing out the sub, so as to not risk having my throat close up. Very disappointed.

Horrible service said that they won’t toast my sub even though the toaster was clearly working and was behind the ready to be used. The person serving me the sub was unable to properly put cheese on my sandwich and the cheese ended up all over my sandwich rather then actually inside of it. Do not recommend and highly disappointed knowing that it’s at the Penn State University.

Was at the McCoy Natatorium outdoor pool for a swim meet this weekend. The host swim wasn't allowed to have concessions because of PSU rules. Your store is the closest food to the pool. Closed all weekend!  You would have made thousands of dollars each day.
Subway is awesome. Good people

formatted_address: 200 W Park Ave, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Triplett's

reviews.text: Triplett’s Bar is an awesome place to unwind at Penn State! The atmosphere is fun, relaxed, and welcoming — the perfect spot to grab a drink after a long day. Huge thanks to Michelle and Andy, the best bartenders around! Michelle is an amazing hostess who makes everyone feel right at home, and Andy mixes the most delicious Old Fashioned I’ve ever had. I have been coming back for two years now. Thank you Andy and Michelle.

Andy is a Bloody Mary genius!  A double Tito’s spicy- garnished with fresh jalapeño, olives and tajin rim. The atmosphere was especially warm and friendly- Kolby has the best personality and makes you feel at home. Kudos to this dynamic team.

Drinks, food, and service were amazing! We had chocolate and espresso martinis with some appetizers. Hannah was extremely attentive and a lovely server! Absolutely delicious and would return again with this amazing staff.

Food was amazing, I ordered the Caesar salad with shrimp scampi. The shrimp were cooked perfectly! Perfect texture.
I ordered my Old Fashioned with Angle Envy. I was thinking it would be stronger but the taste was there.
Over all, place is clean, quiet and roomy with valet parking.
My old issue was my waitress/bar tender left once I received my drink and never returned.

A little noisy but then it is a bar . Good variety of flavorful food. The wings are a “must try”…tasty, moist and meaty. Have had all the menu items. All great. Nevertheless, it is the alcoholic beverages that they are most proficient. Just enjoy.

formatted_address: 450 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Osaka

reviews.text: We really enjoyed the sushi we got on Valentine’s Day.  Very fresh and quick preparation.    Delivery was very fast.    Restaurant does their own delivery and the delivery driver was courteous.   We will order sushi from the restaurant again.   My son got Katsu and he ate it all.   We also got the Miso soup and it was tasty.   We are very happy with our dinner.   Thank you Osaka.

I only order here because Uber Eats hada promo of buy one get one free. I ordered this and they only gave me one item. When I confronted them about it, the manager tried to gaslight me saying that is not how buy 1 get 1 for free works. He then proceeded to show me another order where they were giving two items of the thing I ordered for the same price I paid, so he was aware of the promo. Even there, they never offer to give me the extra item I was missing. Very rude and condescending, trying to blame me all the time and not offering real solutions. They even tried to convince me to order again

Ordered Uber eats, it took an hour. Crab rangoons were good, but they’re good anywhere. Ate almost all. Vegetable lo mein had about five pieces of vegetable, was bland and tasted old like someone microwaved their leftovers. Not ever ordering again.

They don't have a dining service open, only to go. We used the searing area to have our dinner. The taste was okay but too expensive considering the food quality. We ordered hibachi, but the food wasn't anything different than regular fried rice. Went there on July 4th, so I am glad that they were still open. Clean area and fast service.

Got the hibachi to go. First the guy at the front completely forgot to add my part of the order onto our tab. Then when I arrived and said we had ordered fried rice and a chicken hibachi he just flat out said no. Like not even a that’s my bad just straight up “no”. Food was mid, not that much flavor. Dumped that soy sauce. Maybe it’s just the take out but definitely not the best.

formatted_address: 111 E Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Famous Ernie's Steaks

reviews.text: Ernie’s is an absolute treat you must try at least once living in the state college area. The ribeye they use is top-quality and their bread is great. Make sure you get their cheese whiz as it’s on point and very good compared to shitty Penn steaks. I am a student here at psu originally from the Philly area and after trying so many Philadelphia cheesesteaks I can certainly say Ernies is most definitely the top of the line classic philly cheesesteak you can get here. Not only that but they are cheap, go with a friend and buy two cheesesteaks there for only $19, that’s considerably cheaper than any cheesesteak you can get in the Philadelphia area considering they’re about $14-$16 apiece.

Famous Ernie’s Steaks is a nice little spot in State College with good service and friendly staff. The place is pretty small, so you might have to wait outside during busy times, but the line moves quickly. The food is okay — nothing fancy, but it hits the spot when you’re craving a quick cheesesteak or fries. Overall, it’s a solid local stop for a simple, satisfying meal.

I love their burgers but the cheesesteak hasn’t been hitting lately. I found that the cheesesteak had too many onions that weren’t properly diced and the ratio between meat and onions was off and the cheese is just slapped on top instead of being incorporated as you would expect from cheesesteaks. The staff is nice though but I won’t be repeating the cheesesteak.
This restaurant has the best cheesesteaks in State college hands down. Penn Steaks and the other irrelevant shop next to maxxen is nothing compared to this. Go here trust
Fantastic Cheesesteaks! Always a go to spot for me when I’m back visiting Penn State! My wife is vegetarian and loves their Portobello cheesesteak too!

formatted_address: 200 W Park Ave, University Park, PA 16803, USA
name: Lionne & 1855 Lounge

reviews.text: The food was good. The sweet potato fries were delicious . We had desert. I had crab cakes with Caesar salad.

Lionne is in the Nittany Lion Inn.  We stayed there for the weekend and dined in the restaurant on three separate occasions.  We ate breakfast twice and dinner once.  Each meal we had was excellent.  The restaurant is well appointed, it has a nice comfortable vibe to it without feeling pretentious.  The breakfast menu is somewhat limited but there is enough variety for everyone.  The dinner menu was similar but again, even the picky eaters will find something to eat.  The food was very good, breakfast was "reasonable".  The dinner was a little pricier but you pay for a good meal.  The staff were friendly, they took good care of us without being a bother.  We did not need a reservation but we were staying at the hotel kind of off-season so ymmv.

The wine selection has seriously declined.

I've visited Lionne numerous times since they opened, and it’s become one of my go-to spots in State College. After returning to town for the school year, I was genuinely looking forward to dinner there again, and I wasn’t disappointed by the warm welcome. It was great to see some familiar, friendly faces like Ryan, Sophia, and even Lisa, who stopped by our table to say hello and welcome us back. That kind of personal touch is exactly why we keep coming back.

As always, the food and service were fantastic, consistently top-notch, especially the Lobster Bisque. However, there was one noticeable letdown: the wine selection has seriously declined.

We attempted to order several bottles of wine, but one after another, they were all out of stock. Our server was doing their best to help, and you could sense their frustration too, having to return to the table multiple times with bad news. In the past, we always enjoyed trying different bottles, and Lionne had a great variety to choose from. This time, it felt like a struggle just to find one that was available.

Before leaving, we peeked into the wine room and were surprised (and disappointed) to see how bare the shelves were. When we last visited in June, the racks were fully stocked, and it was such a beautiful sight. Now, many were empty, a stark contrast, and definitely not what we expected.

We’ll absolutely be back as Lionne still delivers on so many fronts; however, next time, we may opt to bring our own bottle and pay the corkage fee rather than go through the hassle of spending 30 minutes trying to find something and having to settle solely because it was available.

We made reservations with Lionne for 2025 Thanksgiving at 3pm for a party of three. Their Thanksgiving this year was an entree selection with an unlimited selection of sides and a dessert buffet.

We arrived 5 minutes early and were led to a round booth instead of a regular table. I am in a sling from recent shoulder surgery, so I need to sit at a regular dining table with chairs. This was a problem since they only wanted to seat us in a booth. The host had us wait for a bit to find a solution while we looked around. We noticed many regular, empty tables. The host came back with a chair for me to place next to the booth. As we were about to sit down, a server or other host stopped by and stated this won't work (perhaps blocks access for servers?). So we had to wait for them to come up with a different solution. The hostess led us to a counter-height table with bar stools outside the restaurant. We thought that was unusual and this should have been a red flag. We weren't exactly comfortable, as we kept sliding off the bar stools. Worse, we were far from the dessert buffer and in a common area where other people walked past. We were confused as to why we couldn't get a regular table.

We had to wait a bit for staff to get place settings and menus. Then our waiter arrived, except he identified himself as the bartender and stated up front that he might get busy tending the bar. That was the second red flag. He then explained that they were sold out of one of their five entrees thanks to the morning demand for it. They're running out of ingredients already in the afternoon? Third red flag. The waiter (bartender) took our order. Soon we had our drinks, but there was something wrong with my iced tea. It just tasted like fountain water instead of tea, even though it did have a little color to it. How do you mess up something as simple as iced tea? Forth red flag.

We waited a while without any food. Our bartender/server did stop by and apologize for the delay, stating the kitchen was preparing "19 soups" or something along that line, and that we'd get our entrees in 5-10 minutes. Half an hour later, still nothing. At about the 45 minute mark we were using our phones to look for other restaurants that might be open on Thanksgiving day. An hour after we were seated, a different waiter finally brought us soup. We asked the waiter why it's taking so long for our entrees. He apologized and stated that he'd make sure he puts our order at the front of the queue. Unfortunately the French Onion soup was cold, or lukewarm at best, with a soggy crostini on top. Perhaps this soup had been sitting forever after it was prepared and our bartender/waiter didn't serve it to us in time, and another waiter had to bring it to us after it was already cold? Fifth red flag. Then after about ten minutes, the waiter brought us a basket of cold bread. Did they forget to serve this earlier? Worse, they provided no plates for us yet in which to eat the bread. Sixth red flag.

At that point we had enough: we left and notified the hostess of the issue. It was one and a quarter hours with no entrees, seated in an awkward and uncomfortable location that should never have been offered, with a waiter that's unavailable because he's tending bar, and being served cold food much too late. We didn't even get a chance to look at the dessert buffet since we had no entrees and were seated so far away. We also didn't prepare any food at home because we had reservations and expected a proper dining table instead of this nightmare. The staff, although very friendly and courteous, seemed confused and unable to make proper decisions. The hostess was a bit shocked we waited so long without any entrees.

This had to be the worst dining experience we've had in a long time. For this Thanksgiving, we had to go "Christmas Story" style and eat at Penang Asian Fusion Cuisine, one of the few places open. Needless to say, I'd recommend avoiding the Nittany Lione Inn and Lionne: we took a chance and now regret it.

For $70-60 per person you'd expect to be treated far better.
The service and food were amazing.  Ryan was our waiter and Alyiah was his assistant.  The prime rib was delicious.

formatted_address: 147 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sichuan House

reviews.text: Good choice for Chinese food, three sides one entree for $13 and only $11 if you buy their cards. Sometime the bad thing is they will give you super small portion of side during rush hours and you have to argue!

Good taste, fast and kind service. The moment I walked into the restaurant my mouth started watering. Thick pieces of chicken and lovely long strips of beef. Veggies are fresh and the sauces are scrumptious. Fantastic price for the amount of food provided and perfect for a college students budget. I look forward to my next visit!

The Sichuan house reopened last two months or so. Still very popular and cheap. The price of the meal is 10.55 with credit card payment.
Two years ago:The waitress is really nice. And the food is quite delicious! I love it! Actually I've been there more than 10 times since I came psu.
Perfect college town Chinese lunch shop. Food is delicious and hot with generous servings. No frills! Bring cash.

I work downtown and while doing some holiday shopping on my lunch break decided to give this place a try (smelled delicious from the street). It did not disappoint and the portions were generous, fresh and employee behind the counter was very friendly :-)
The tofu and mushrooms were my personal favorite. Our daughter in law is Chinese from the Sichuan province and this tastes just like her cooking! Very authentic and I can't wait to go back!

formatted_address: 145 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sher Hot Chicken

reviews.text: Spacious, well-decorated and generally clean. We ordered fried chicken and burger. Burger was big, juicy and tasty.  Fried chicken was salty and the drumsticks were dry. A few sauces were given but none was to shout about. Fries was very good but too little. Generally, all ok.

We first found this little gem on First Night. We decided to give it a try. All of our food was hot and delicious. This past weekend, we had to run some errands, my son asked if we could come here to eat again. (He is usually picky, so take that as his 5 star review) It is a little bit of a wait for food, but everything you get is hot and fresh!

Chicken shawarma had me floating. Wife had to pull me back down to earth by the ankle. Don’t have a picture to upload because I ate it too fast. You just have to take my word for it. It’s not a weirdly made or shaped shawarma like sometimes sold around here. It’s a solid, quality, proper, and reasonably priced shawarma, especially for State College. Starting to float again.

The Waker Chicken, previously known as Koop, once offered hot fried chicken wings that my wife and I loved. However, they removed them from the menu after a short period. When I heard about this new spot, Hot Chick, I was excited but a bit wary after reading reviews about their grand opening, mentioning wrong orders and undercooked meat. Despite that, my wife and I decided to give it a try today, and we had an absolutely great experience.

The price of the fried chicken was very reasonable. We got 10 pieces of chicken for $18 and a salmon wrap for $14. Although the fried chicken took some time, it was exactly what we hoped for. When they ran out of salmon, they gave us a tilapia wrap instead. The person serving us kindly offered to compensate us with extra chicken, a drink, or fries. We chose fries, and they gave us a whole box of crispy ones.

The portions were very generous—we even had leftovers for dinner. I will definitely be coming back for more, but next time I’ll probably order online to save time.

We were passing through state college in the late afternoon. All the buffet restaurants were closed. We tried the 10 pcs chicken at 18$. It was amazing. The flavor and spices were well balanced (a little bit salty; still delicious). I would recommend everyone to stop and try their fried chicken.

formatted_address: State College, PA 16801, USA
name: OLD GOLD PIZZA

formatted_address: 134 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Brothers Bar & Grill

reviews.text: We had a great time at Brothers! We were visiting the campus for our son who is interested in Penn State and catching a game too. We decided to get some appetizers and drinks to hold us over for game time and we were very happy with everything here! Glad we stopped in and we wouldn't hesitate to go again, if we are back in town.

I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant, largely thanks to our waitress, Liv. From the moment we sat down, Liv was attentive, friendly, and incredibly helpful. She had great recommendations from the menu and was patient with our questions. Our drinks were always refilled, and she checked on us just the right amount but not too much, but enough to make sure we had everything we needed. Liv's positive attitude and excellent service truly enhanced our dining experience. I highly recommend this restaurant, and if you go, be sure to ask for Liv!

My experience at brother’s bar & grill is definitely one to write home about! Not only was I served with a smile, but also efficiency. If I had to pin one member of the staff that really enhanced my experience, there is no other answer than Marko Kosanovich! I mean this guy just simply gets it — all I hope is that if he unfortunately leaves one day, Brother’s Bar & Grill will hold the rest of their staff to this same level of excellence!

Stopped in for a late lunch...love the atmosphere! Food was super delicious and the waitress was so kind to help with menu selections! Definitely worth a try! We were here on sprung break week so there wasn't a wait time and not packed full of hungry people! Nice and clean too...friendly employees! They even have some arcade games and pool tables up on the top level so great place for the whole family!

The first girl bartender left and never came back to take our order. Then a guy came over and when I say he does not play about his job. He got to work. I never been somewhere where the drinks are $1 or $5 for so much. A pitcher for $10
5 stars

formatted_address: 1700 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Subway

reviews.text:
Update: Closed at 1130am in Saturday. No sign, no explanation.

Saturday 11:30am, I was the only customer. Nice and quiet. Staff member took my order and made it promptly. Food was great although the tomatoes were just a bit on the soggy side. No carbonated fountain drinks, only Pepsi products in bottles.

Large Subway inside with plenty of seating. There was only one worker, so it took a while to make our subs. He was efficient, though. Chips and soda fountain were right at the door to leave. One highchair is available.

This used to be a good place. But the last few months have seen it go downhill. They don’t fill our online orders. They are frequently out of various ingredients. They are sometimes just randomly closed. Go elsewhere.

My wife called on Friday to order subs for a church event on Sunday. They agreed on picking the subs up on Sunday morning at 10:15am. When we got there Sunday morning to pick up the subs, it was closed. Tried calling the store number and no one picked up. I guess we’ll try another sub place instead next time.

Drove from the Lewistown to state college for subway and this location as well as the other one downtown were both closed before the listed hours ... Kindly fix your shit ..gas isn't free or cheap to be wasting for nothing

formatted_address: 1341 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Papa Johns Pizza

reviews.text: never had issues before… waited extra  30 minutes after they said 5 minutes and forgot to make a pizza. Guy making the pizzas never washed his hands after touching money. no apology… waited for the pizzas over an hour.
Our pizza was good. I expected great from a pizza chain.
The worst pizza ever. Hugh crust, hardly any sauce, bubbles all over. Just aweful. Would rather pay full price and get a good pizza. So disappointed. Regular crust you can see thru!

Pizza keeps getting worse. How? And tonight, in addition to mediocre pizza, they threw in a few strands of hair. Someone is not doing basic kitchen hygiene.
Lots of others say the Domino's at Weis on Westerly is a lot better, and I completely agree.

I haven't been here in years, but we always swore that this Papa John's tasted better than any other we had been to. There's something about it that's different. We went here for years when visiting my grandma - it was our favorite place. There's a window on the side of the building that allows you to go outside and look in and watch them make the whole pizza every step of the way, which is pretty much the coolest thing ever as a kid, and honestly, even as an adult lol.
One time, when my brother was very young, he was playing with a toy truck at the window sill outside the restaurant as we were watching the pizza making process.
The manager/owner/maybe just an employee waved to us and smiled at us and engaged with us through the window. When we got home and ate our delicious pizza we realized my brother had left his truck on the window sill. The next day we went back to check if it was still there and the same pizza guy had it sitting on the counter waiting for us. The fact that he noticed it, went outside and retrieved it, and remembered us and had it waiting for us, was all so sweet, and above and beyond, and shows you what kind of a place this joint is.

formatted_address: 1525 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sakura

reviews.text: I've tried to sushi twice and I have not had any complaints yet. I haven't dined in but going inside to grab my food, the atmosphere is cool. It gives real low key type of vibes. A place to relax and enjoy your food. A definite recomend

Sakura is our favorite local sushi place. They are always friendly and service is fast. They are also very good with gluten-free requests. Staff can tell you exactly what is safe to eat, and most rolls can be modified to be gluten-free!

Flew into late, but Sakura was open until 2130. Pleasant staff. Good food. Sweet potato tempura was good. The steak and salmon hibachi was delicious. Spices tuna roll was good. Pumpkin cheesecake (to go) was quite good.

The food was soooo good! I ordered the teriyaki shrimp bento box, so clever! Nice atmosphere, not too busy on a Monday evening, and staff was friendly! Will definitely be back on my next visit through State College!

Excellent Japanese food in State College. We had an appetizer and a main dish each and it all came reasonably fast and it was amazing. The place is very well put together too, and the staff is nice and helpful. Would definitely recommend and come back.

formatted_address: 2167 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: McDonald's

reviews.text: I ordered the fish filet sandwiches. The current deal is 2 for $6. I am an occasional cheese eater. I usually order my sandwiches without cheese. But Mickey D's, how are you selling sandwiches with a corner of cheese? As much as people pay for their sandwiches, the least you could do is provide a $.10 piece of cheese. I was shocked and appalled to see the lack of honesty. This was truly disheartening.

Came to get French fries in the drive threw got a small fry large fry a mocha frappe with no whipped cream a fudge Sunday bbq,ranch and spicy buffalo. I got home to open my food and eat and the fry is the size of a medium maybe and the small is half full I’d say more than a kid fry but maybe by 4 fry’s. There was a lot of people in line in front of us and behind and the fry’s were cold and soggy that’s crazy honestly. Please do better it takes 3 minutes for fry’s make them fresh!

Waited 2 hours for our delivery and when we called the man who answered was so rude and sassy for no reason and did not care about the fact that we payed literally $50 for 2 grinch meals like a girl just wants a sweet treat hello. Awful service and awful people working there. Currently typing this with my roomate while on hold trying to find out when they’re delivering our nugz.

Order was delayed for two hours and my delivery person said I should try to contact the restaurant. I had no idea what was going on so I calmly contacted the restaurant about what may have happened, but the lady on the phone was insanely rude. She responded as if I said something to offend her and said "byeee" in an asinine voice while I was mid-sentence and hung up. Reading other reviews, it seems like this isn't a one time thing either. To that lady, maybe dont work in the service industry if you cant treat people with basic decency.

This McD has a couple issues. Kiosk ordering indicates that you can only pay here-credit card, but at the end, it says "cashless failed, see front counter." Table tents aren't available, but it makes you enter a number anyway. Positives: 2 soda fountains, large dining room, and outdoor seating. Outdoor chairs look quite outdated and out of place...but the bright flowers are a nice touch.

formatted_address: 1550 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Plaza Mexican Bar & Grill

reviews.text:
When you are hungry for Mexican & Margaritas this is where we go lol…

We always get table side guacamole 🥑
Queso 🫕
San jose burrito 🌯
Prickly pear 🌵
Guava

Best margaritas & Mexican hands down …

Christian the bartender is the best too…
Hector the gym is also great too…

#food #foodie #blessed #burrito #margaritas

Johnnie Ray Falls thanks for dinner my love… Plaza Mexican Bar & Grill  is amazing… we love that the manager Hector always makes sure to make us feel like family. Roland took good care of us and everything was perfect 🥰

I’m a Mexican living in the US, always looking to find a good place that takes me back to my place. I loved the food, carne asada was perfect, best guacamole I’ve tried here and the napolitana flan was awesome. Authentic Mexican place.

We love Plaza so much, it’s always an amazing time! Tonight our sever was Biniza and she did a great job. She was so attentive and kind, made the experience even better. The food was amazing as always. I HIGHLY recommend the Chipotle Pasta with chicken and Tres Leches Cake!!!

Ordered takeout and it was ready pretty fast. I got the Birria rolls and fried ice cream. The Birria rolls were full of meat and had so much flavor. The fried ice cream was great. Definitely great value overall for the price. Highly recommend this place if you’re near Penn state.
One of the best Mexican restaurants in town, the food is always good and the portions are always more than I can eat.

formatted_address: 1730 University Dr, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: The Bistro - Eat. Drink. Connect.®

reviews.text: Bean is an awesome bartender. Had alot of fun. I was just my friend and I on a girls trip. She was really sweet and funny
Limited options in terms of food and drinks. Servers are friendly.

formatted_address: 1724 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: The Honey Baked Ham Company

reviews.text: For decades, Honey Baked Ham in State College, PA, has been the favorite restaurant for my family to get a delicious meal in a welcoming atmosphere with friendly staff who know us personally and treat us like family. So when Mom turned 90, we knew that HBH would be the perfect place to hold her surprise birthday party! Manager Jasmine and chef Kelly made the entire process easy and fun. The decorations were very festive, and the food was so delicious and fresh! There was an assortment of sandwiches, salad with garden-fresh greens, a veggie tray with homemade ranch and dill dips (with dill fresh from the garden!), and a tray with sweet, perfectly-ripe fruit. Everyone commented on how tasty all of the food was, and many of the guests asked for “to go” boxes to take home the extras. The staff cut and served the cake and ice cream. There was a generous amount of food, and the price was even less than we expected. Many thanks to Jasmine, Kelly, and the staff at HBH for making Mom’s 90th birthday truly memorable and fun for everyone! There’s no better place in State College to have a delicious meal or a GREAT party!!!

Honey Baked Ham is a hidden gem of State College. Their pulled pork is amazing!! I tried the  broccoli bacon bliss for the first time and WOW it is amazing!! 10/10. The Manager Jasmine was very friendly and helpful with fixing my rewards point issue. The dining room is a nice, clean, cozy, quiet atmosphere with plenty of space. I can always find a seat to enjoy my lunch.

I've been buying half hams for several years.  Mostly for Christmas and Easter meals.  The hams never disappoint.   They are always moist, flavorful and perfectly prepared.  Pick ups are well organized with little wait.  Staff is always friendly and professional.   The South Atherton location is handy and parking is easy.  I'm anxious to try the new prime rib!  I highly recommend HBH!
Staff is incredible and the atmosphere is cozy. I got the chicken pot pie special and it tastes like I’m eating at my grandma’s house. Will definitely be back!!
The manager of this store may be the nicest person I have ever encountered. 5 stars just for her. The food is always good as well.

formatted_address: 1736 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Rothrock Coffee

reviews.text: One of my favorite weekend breakfast spots in State College. The Americano is super smooth and never tastes bitter, which I really appreciate. I usually get it with the avocado toast, and it never disappoints. The avocado is fresh, the greens add a nice peppery bite, and the toast is perfectly crisp. It is simple but really satisfying. Definitely my go-to place when I want a relaxed weekend breakfast at Rothrock Coffee
Very nice coffee shop. Very friendly staff. The coffee was slightly sour. The peach toast I got was really good. Very solid crunch on the bread. The protein smoothie was my favorite.

Food: 4.5/5 ✨ - Definitely better than your average biscuits! A little char, but we don't mind it (that's a matter of taste - I'm sure you can request a light toast to the biscuit). The lattes are nice (regular and vanilla - the vanilla latte, when paired with oat milk and 2 packets of Sugar in the Raw, tastes almost chocolatey - I definitely recommend it 😄)
Service: 5/5 ✨ - Very friendly and helpful.
Atmosphere: 5/5 ✨ - Very nice

The lady at the register was so rude. I ordered a toasted marshmallow latte and then watched the barista fill the cup up 99% full with milk. When trying it, it was ghostly white, basically just flavored milk with barely any coffee flavor or sweet flavor. Do not recommend. Cute atmosphere but don’t love the coffee.

The bad reviews on here are LIES. All the staff are incredibly nice and accommodating!! I love all their toasts and special pastries, you can tell they put a lot of thought into making the idea and actually executing it!! They are also locally owned and care a lot about coffee unlike chain coffee shops that are just there for a cash grabs. I love their matcha!! That’s probably my fav drink from there def recommend!!

formatted_address: 1311 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Dunkin'

reviews.text: They gave me a half empty iced coffee. When I asked them to fix it they just filled the cup with ice. When I asked them to remake it cause it has way more ice than a normal drink would have. When I asked for a new one they literally just gave me the same one after mixing it around a bit.

I’ve never had a drink from here be actually good.why does my chai latte taste like coffee?? The bacon egg and cheese bagel had grease dripping and then made me sick for days. Drive the extra 5 minutes and go to the next one in town
They are the best! They have wonderful staff and helped us feel welcome our entire visit. Also the food was DELICIOUS

My wife ordered a breakfast sandwich with sausage, and got bacon instead. The bacon was undercooked and floppy, not crisp at all. The hash browns were soggy and fell apart when we tried to dip them in ketchup.

The parking lot is poorly designed. If you park in the slanted spaces along the front, the drive-through line will block you from exiting to Atherton St. This added ten minutes to our time at Dunkin' Donuts this morning. It took that long for the line to progress two cars forward so we could cut through line to get out of the parking lot.

I usually don’t leave reviews, but I feel it’s important to speak up about the poor management at this location. The manager, Alexis, is consistently rude and unaccommodating toward customers. She refuses reasonable requests, such as adding extra scoops of matcha, even when the drink is clearly watered down and looks like plain milk and ice. On multiple visits, I’ve received cold hashbrowns, and when issues are brought up, Alexis shows no willingness to resolve them or provide good customer service.

What’s more concerning is that even the staff quietly admit to being frustrated with her behavior, which says a lot. A manager should set the standard by being approachable, professional, and willing to accommodate customers’ needs, especially in tough situations. Instead, Alexis comes across as stubborn and dismissive.

If this location wants to keep loyal customers, something needs to change. Other Dunkin’ stores in the area have managers who are kind, respectful, and focused on customer satisfaction — which makes the difference between a place people want to come back to and a place they avoid. Unfortunately, because of this manager, this location is losing that loyalty. Do better Alexis…

formatted_address: 100 Rolling Ridge Dr, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Taco Bell

reviews.text: honestly, not bad at all. They were clearly short-staffed but still moving fast, and my order came out hot and correct. No missing items, no sloppy mess. Lobby was clean, vibe was chill, and it didn’t feel chaotic even though it probably should have been. Solid spot when you just need something quick and reliable without the nonsense.

Waste of money, good way to lose customers in 2025, way too expensive for 1oz of beef lol. Absolutely outrageous a manager or whoever in charge let 3 tacos of this caliber leave the kitchen... Everyone has a first day, that could explain this!

Arguably the worst TB experience we've had. They shorted us a cheesy roll up. The crunchwrap supreme was cold. Two hard tacos were crushed (see photo). Two other tacos were supposed to be fresco style but were not. Literally nothing in our order was good.
serious quality control issues at this location. they mess up my order every time I go here. today my steak fries didn't have steak on them.

Not only do these people not care enough to make quality food they spray chemicals near their food. For 3 years we’ve tried to let them know that the tortilla chips and crunchy tacos sometimes have this awful smell and taste almost like burnt grease and chemicals. When we tell them they say they don’t fry their chips or their shells so it can’t be grease. That just leaves them spraying cleaning chemicals near their open products. I’ve reached out to the managers I’ve let the employees know and nothing changes it. They won’t even eat their own food or they’d know how bad it was. How can you expect people to pay for food the people making it won’t even eat? We’ve gotten decent food a few times during the day but the night shift has never produced anything serviceable and when you try to get them to replace anything. They’ve ruined it and it just causes more problems to the point you feel like you’re the scammer just trying to get a decent meal that you paid for when they’re the real scammers selling this god awful food for such high prices.

formatted_address: 2135 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Jersey Mike's Subs

reviews.text: The staff was friendly and helpful. It was my first time at a Jersey Mike's and of course they had some recommendations for me to try, I was not disappointed. I will absolutely be going back the next time I am in the area.

It's a Jersey Mike's. I would give it 5 stars but why is there no toaster?! I want my sandwiches toasted! I do also wish there was a little more customization and topping options, but overall they have good quality sandwiches, a clean facility, and good service.
Awesome staff and great quality food! Ryan the manager is an awesome guy that seems to really care about the store and his staff. Definitely recommend.
Very grateful for the gluten free roll option. The turkey and provolone Mike's way was great, plus great pickles.

Upon my arrival, I was immediately greeted with a friendly hello from an employee. I've had Jersey Mikes food in the past, but this was my first time for a dine in. To be honest, I was expecting a typical fast food experience. This was not the case. It was above and beyond. The staff were so friendly and so helpful in helping me to decide which menu item I'd enjoy.
The atmosphere was fun and joyful, even when the lunch rush arrived. The staff all just seemed to enjoy their work.
As far as cleanliness, A+.
Even the restroom was spotless. I will visit this location again and again without hesitation.
I highly recommend this location. Top notch!

formatted_address: 1450 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Celebrities

reviews.text:
Had a great time at Celebrities Bar in State College. The atmosphere was relaxed and lively, and the service was top notch. Our bartender Jen was absolutely fabulous, very attentive and friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed. I ordered the Wagyu burger sliders and they were incredible, juicy, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area. I will be back. Also Happy Hour 4-7pm
was pretty cool!

We had the burgers and pizza.  The pizza was not up to quality reflected in the price.  It reminded me of the box chef Boyardee pizza in a box.  Just didn't taste fresh at all.  The burger sliders were okay.

Ok I do like this place but their lunch buffet (which they recently started) has some hiccups.  They had tartar sauce out in  dish but not kept on ice.  I said something about that and was told it was "shelf stable".  I still suggested perhaps they could put it on thesalad bar, as most people expect amayo-based product to be kept  cold.  They need to advertise this better too.  I didn't see anything about it on their website.  It is inexpensive and I thought it was a pretty good deal.

My daughter and I tried this restaurant due to its proximity to our hotel.  We were impressed!.  Our server Tatiana was so helpful, and the food was great.  We split the shrimp over angel hair and it was fresh and delicious.  I am picky about martinis, and this one was perfect.  The restaurant was clean and well lit.  We will definitely visit again.

Bartender had some kind of vendetta against everyone who was trying to just order anything at all. Took like 10 mins to get a drink and another 10 for a menu. Waited AT LEAST 45 mins for food. Just literally go anywhere else fr lol

formatted_address: 1780 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: KFC

reviews.text: I haven’t been to a KFC in at least a decade before this visit. The food was just as I recalled. I got a 3-piece crispy chicken meal with cole slaw and a biscuit. I liked it a lot! The stores have changed a great deal since my last visit. Much more modern. Lots of photos of Colonel Sanders as a nod to history, though. The service was decent, about what one would generally get at a fast food restaurant. Overall, I’m glad I went and maybe it won’t be 10 years before I go back.

Kentucky Fried chicken has never got an order right for me. I ordered two piece chicken dinner today with coleslaw told them I wanted coleslaw no mashed potatoes and I got 2- 2piece dinners. One of them had no side in it and the other one had mashed potatoes in it. This is not acceptable. No one gives good customer service anymore or pays attention to what the customer has ordered.  Next time I have made up my mind do not leave until I check the order. Even if someone is in back at me at the drive-thru.

Yeah, it's better to get a chicken somewhere else. We made an online order about 45 minutes before closing time. When we arrived, they threw an order package on the counter. The wings themselves are stiff and tiny. They also forgot to put the sauce in

Absolutely disgusting food and service. I ordered a chicken sandwich and they put soggy chicken nuggets in the sandwich instead of what was advertised. Take a look at the picture and judge for yourself. Not my first negative experience at this location but I will be the last because I will not be back.

update：It happened again. The only way to make the restaurant better is to fire all employees except the chef.

I placed a mobile order with KFC today and drove 20 minutes to pick it up, only to be told that they were out of tenders—meaning my entire order could not be fulfilled. That was frustrating, but what truly infuriated me was what followed.

Instead of processing a refund on the spot or through the app (where I placed the order), the staff handed me a paper slip with a phone number, telling me I had to call it myself to request a refund. This is absolutely absurd. I placed the order online, you knew you couldn’t fulfill it—why not notify me through the app or cancel the order proactively?

When I expressed my frustration, the staff member told me I wasn’t being understanding. Seriously? I wasted my time, gas, and patience because of KFC’s failure, and now I’m blamed for not being “understanding”? This company is a joke. No wonder Chick-fil-A is leaving you in the dust. KFC, do better.

formatted_address: 1341 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Lychee Chinese Restaurant

reviews.text:
One of the best takeaway restaurants.
The food is fresh, tasty, the portions are big and you get great value for money.
In the picture are the chicken broccoli, chicken sesame and ma-po tofu dishes.
We couldn’t wait and tried the chicken sesame even before we took the picture (if you noticed a few missing pieces 😝).
The service is also always good 😋

Lychee used to be so good. It's gone so far downhill. They're very close to my house so I have given them several chances. Most recently I paid $22 for a seafood dish that was almost entirely broccoli. There was no lobster in it whatsoever. I was so disappointed. Almost entirely broccoli with a few pieces of shrimp thrown in. They didn't even bother to give me rice with it.

Nice and clean and mostly suitable for take out. They do have two 4 person tables there. We sat and ate as we were on the way to somewhere. Service was nice and quick. Disposable plates and cutlery is available as other asian restaurants. We ordered 1 sea food delight which came with steamed white rice. Food portion was big enough for two people. I like spicy food so it was good but now best for me. My companion enjoyed though.

Wow, Every thing on menu is top notch. Not like some places where certain things are good. I mean everything on the menu is awesome. It is a simple store front with only two tables but do not let that foul you. This place is a hidden gem, that raises the bar. Come see for your self, but bring cash, there is a discount for cash.

The food was great.   I am usually not a fan of spring rolls but these were a perfect golden brown.  I wish it was located in a different area as its heading out of town and there is only a very small seating section.  But as of now I live 2 hours away and it is my favorite Chinese restaurant.

formatted_address: 120 Southridge Plz, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sheetz

reviews.text: This location only has one air pump as far as I could find. It's poorly marked (so maybe there are others too that I just didn't see?). Otherwise a good experience, just like every other Sheetz.

Order #262 today. It was busy; I definitely get it. But I implore you to focus on quality control at this South Atherton Street location. Ordered a whole turkey sub w/ lettuce, tomatoes, cheddar, and light mayonnaise. We also ordered a side of ranch to go with fried appetizers. I opened the bag to eat half the sub on site. Onions were added to my sub. I hate onions. No big deal. I'll pick them off.

Then, the ranch dressing I ordered somehow became BBQ sauce.

Finally, I get home and unwrapped the other half of my sub to pick off the unwanted onions, but AMAZINGLY no tomatoes. The first half of my sub had tomatoes, the second half had no tomatoes. The whole thing had unwanted onions. How do you screw up 2 halves of the same sub--in different ways?

Also, raise the flags up. The mandate ended at sunset on August 31. Yesterday.
If you order online, don't. I got a drink and, over 2 hours later, it's still being made. I can't even cancel the order.
Always a wait for a cashier at this sheetz, must be too cheap to hire people. Maybe sheets should up their pay scale so customers don't have to wait when there is no line.
Went in to use the restroom and get something to eat got on a pizza and it was hard on bottom and waxey in the middle and it burnt my wife's mouth

formatted_address: 1880 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Chipotle Mexican Grill

reviews.text: Great service, super well-kept, and had everything in stock! Everyone was nice and asked all the questions they needed to. They were quick to restock low items. It’s hard learning a new position, but they’re doing great! Keep it up! I bet this will be the most reliable Chipotle in town for good food and not running out of things. Thank you!

Went for their soft open yesterday, well I didn't know it was until I arrived.  Was greeted at the door and welcomed in, such a nice experience! Food was fresh and the team working were doing great! Looks like a good environment and location was great, across the street from the hotel.

formatted_address: 2137 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Kitchen Garden

reviews.text: Everything was incredibly delicious and fresh. It had been a while since I had such a wonderful breakfast. I was thoroughly impressed with the setup and the services. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive 💐  We had one Serpme breakfast, and it was more than enough for four people. I highly recommend the Spanish Gozleme.

Kitchen Garden Restaurant is a hidden gem! The breakfast was absolutely delicious with so many fresh and tasty options. The setting is peaceful and beautifully designed, making it a wonderful place to enjoy a relaxing morning. The service was excellent – friendly, welcoming, and professional. I’d definitely come back again. Serpme Breakfast was delicious:))

Warm, Family-Friendly Spot

Loved this place! We had serpme breakfast , pistachio chocolate cookies, and tiramisu - all were great. Especially lattes has beautiful creamy taste and deserts were freshly made.

But the best part was our server, Beca. She was so warm and sweet to our 7-month-old baby. We got the baby high chair and fed our baby. Also the atmosphere was perfect, not loudly irritated music but slowly low volume clear tables and restrooms they have. Highly recommend!

We were planning to have breakfast, but it was too late ! We tried lentil soup, anatolian grilled plate for lunch. So delicious, original Turkish taste, clean, super clean which I like a lot. Highly recommend you. You should definitely try super super fresh homemade cookies with Turkish tea

We had the serpme, toast and waffle for our breakfast. Pretty generous sizes for all. Highly recommended for people who are into the Mediterranean breakfast. Besides the breakfast, I personally loved their hot latte. One of the best.

Becca the server was fantastic! Bright colors and cleanliness was at another level. Will definitely come back.

formatted_address: 2141 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Pizza Hut

reviews.text:
My order was delivered on time, hot and fresh, tasted great. One of the best Pizza Hut experiences I've had. Will definitely order from here again.
UPDATE: We've ordered from here a couple more times since the first post. Same experience. Consistently one of the best Pizza Huts I've ordered from.

Worst delivery experience in my life. My order never arrived, didn't got my money back and no body did wanna help me. That delivery was a scam, I lay in my bead with multiple broken bones and I can't get even a simple order.

I've gotta say this location is much better than the other one that closed down. I don't know if it is the same owner or not. I've ordered from here twice in the past two months and both times it tasted as close to the Pizza Hut from the 80's that I grew up on. I picked my pizza up and though they were swamped the lady behind the counter quoted my order back to me and opened the pizza box to verify. The biggest improvement is whoever is making the pizza seemed like they might have cared or been properly trained. Both times they didn't skimp on toppings and like I said earlier the pan pizza was close as I have had to the old school taste. I hadn't been to this location because I consistently had bad pizzas with the old location and just assumed that was what Pizza Hut is now. I'm glad I gave this one a shot.

Ordered today and while i'm waiting in the lobby; the delivery driver Riley or Reiley was already at my apt door. I must applaud the professional service and demeanor of this person. They were very polite and the hand-off of my order was seamless. The food arrived hot and fresh and I'm thankful for that. Riley (forgive my spelling if wrong) deserves praise. Happy New Year to all! Thanks again Riley.

The only good things I can say is that they delivered on time, the delivery driver was friendly, and, for having basically no other option for delivery, the pizza was decent. I ordered the big box with traditional wings, cheese sticks, and extra sauce cups. They forgot my extra sauce cups (which cost almost 50¢ more there than at other places), and they gave us boneless wings instead of traditional. The boneless wings also barely had any sauce on them and really only on the top.

formatted_address: 460 Westerly Pkwy, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Toasted Bagel Café

reviews.text: I love a good bagel, so I was super happy when I finally got to stop here! The service was great, and the man at the counter was very accommodating to help me find something I’d like in their overwhelmingly wide menu. I ended up with an everything bagel with cream cheese and lox, which was absolutely delicious! They really loaded it up with cream cheese, and the portion of lox was very generous as well. I also appreciated that there were plenty of tables, although the atmosphere wasn’t super calm and comforting, more of a stop in and eat instead of a hang out place.
