They also have a small parking lot, which was nice! I did not try their coffee, but it looked like they had a good selection of Torani syrups to make some fun flavored drinks.

i genuinely believe i will never have a breakfast sandwich this good. not only was the bagel freshly made, all ingredients tasted amazing, the service was so welcoming and friendly; they truly cherish their community. I’ve always been greeted with smiles and compliments when I enter and fellow customers are treated the same. With a staff full of locals, they definitely bring the hometown feeling to breakfast.

Food deserves 5 stars ⭐️
We enjoyed having our breakfast there.
Tried ( The good boy ) which taste really good with the salmon but they were out of avocado but it was delicious anyway.
As well as ( The skinny lady ) tasted good too.
It’s little expensive tho but I think it’s worth the try.
We might visit again.

I stopped in for a dozen bagels and was disappointed that there was no whole wheat or multi-grain available.  The other flavors are very good though.  The service was great however the atmosphere was anything but calm and quiet.  It is definitely a take out place.
I would suggest cleaning the bathrooms.  The women’s room was disgusting.

The Penn State reddit failed me. I took my parents here after reading good reviews about it. There was only about 10 people inside and the staff looked very frantic and turned off the kiosks as people were trying to order from them to stop people from ordering more.

One of the workers took out the trash without gloves on and then proceeded to go back and make drinks and bagels without washing hands or putting gloves on again.

When the 4 of us got our bagels, all of them were wrong. The bagel flavor were wrong, meats were missing, and all of us got random cheeses that none of us picked. Bagel not too bad though

formatted_address: 532 Westerly Pkwy, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Fatoum Bistro

reviews.text: I came here for the first time today. I ordered a cup of the seafood chowder, hummus combo, and arayes. I got the pineapple agua fresca to drink. It was good, but I wasn’t a fan of the foamy stuff on top.  The seafood chowder was delicious and came out piping hot. I forgot to take a picture of it. As far as the hummus platter goes, I absolutely loved the pesto hummus and the red pepper hummus. The regular hummus tasted like something was missing, but I’m not sure what that is yet. I’m going to try adding some lemon juice and garlic to it at home. The areyas were so good, seasoned perfectly, and came with a generous serving of fries. I couldn’t decide between two entrees, so I asked the waitress. She was very helpful and the service was excellent. There is a large parking lot, so you don’t have to worry about paying for parking. I will definitely be coming back.

The shawarma was not that great because the garlic was not fried well and why is the shawarma spherical in shape? Too many pickles and minced chicken! No smoky flavour in the chicken.

Another day, I tried the Navratan korma and it was delicious and the mutton curry was decent but didn't seem that fresh. Although, the indian dishes were definitely better.

About the service, they charged me someone else’s bill and they didn’t even realize it until I came back and asked for an explanation. Please pay attention to your customers.

The turkish coffee was awesome. Overall, this is a great restaurant to try with some room for improvement.

Stopped here for breakfast on a trip and it was so good! They have regular American breakfast food but also middle eastern food. It was new and amazing! If they were closer I'd eat there all the time!

This afternoon, I had the pleasure of dining with friends who share my passion for food at a newly opened establishment. Despite our large party of nine, the service was efficient, and our meals were served promptly and at the correct temperature. I particularly enjoyed the spicy lentil soup and the Turkish coffee, which reminded me of my travels to the Mediterranean region. My husband's Chicken Jalfrezy was also noteworthy, with its rich and vibrant flavors. The hummus with steak was a delicious appetizer. The portions were substantial, and we ended up taking half of our meals home. The service was outstanding, and the owner even took the time to visit our table. We are already looking forward to our next visit.

If you want flavor galore, you need to give this place a try. The bistro is nicely decorated, service was friendly, food cooked fresh. What else could you ask for? While I was there for dinner with some friends I had the grape leaves, mint lemonade, butter chicken, and banana pudding. Everything was 10/10 I can't stop talking about the butter chicken, it was so unbelievably good. It looks very unassuming from the outside but trust me, it's worth the visit.

formatted_address: State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Manna BBQ and Hotpot

reviews.text: Great new restaurant! The meat seemed very high-quality (and the seafood didn’t have that just-out-of-the-freezer taste/texture you see at some places), with a good variety of self-serve side options. I’ll definitely go back!

Super interactive and fun - didn’t wait long for our meat to arrive (ordered 4 sets of various meats 4 different times), did the BBQ only option! Every staff member, even the one that wasn’t our waitress was super sweet. The only critique I had was no spoon for the lil ice creams. They definitely have some background processes to work out but they literally just opened and I had no major issue. Will gladly be back!!

Honestly very disappointing experience.

We came here for hotpot, but the whole process felt extremely slow and unorganized. We had a 2-hour dining limit, yet it took about 40 minutes just to get our initial order. By the time everything came out, we had already lost a big chunk of our eating time.

What made it worse was that right when we were about to order, they suddenly told us lamb was moved to the dinner menu. This was not shown anywhere on the menu, which felt misleading and unprofessional.

When we tried to order additional items later, it took another 30 minutes to arrive. Because of the delays, we barely got to try much food at all.

The sauce bar was also poorly maintained — items were often empty and not refilled in time. Overall, the food and setup felt cheap compared to the price.

For what you pay, this place is definitely not worth it. The experience was frustrating and not enjoyable at all. Would not recommend.
I like the flavor but it took long to wait and the price was reasonable
Pretty good

formatted_address: 536 Westerly Pkwy, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: CLUCK & CATCH

reviews.text: Great spot in State College! The fish was perfectly crispy on the outside and flaky on the inside, and the fries were hot and well-seasoned. Portions were generous and everything tasted fresh. The staff was friendly and the service was quick, making it an easy go to for a casual meal. Definitely worth checking out if you’re craving classic fish and chips.

Yesterday afternoon we had some time to kill and a hole to fill.  We were attending our Granddaughter’s Basketball game at the High School and decided to grab a bite at Cluck and Catch because it was nearby.  The young man behind the counter greeted us promptly and courteously, waited patiently while we looked over the menu, this was our first visit, and answered our questions politely.  Both my Husband and I ordered the 3 piece Cluck meal.  I was pleasantly surprised that I was able to substitute the side order of white rice for the fries that came with, lol, I know, I know I am an oddball but I don’t get excited over French Fries.  Our meals came out in less than 15 minutes, piping hot, even the rice which was very welcome on the dreary damp day.  The chicken was crispy on the outside, tender and juicy breast meat on the inside.  Portion size was more than plentiful for a lunch, lightly seasoned.  Hubby really liked the CC sauce for dipping, I thought it was overpowering.  His Fries came out lightly battered.  I enjoyed my rice substitute! The tri-color coleslaw was excellent, creamy and crunchy, I would have eaten more!  Not sure about the whole serving toast with chicken thing, but if you like toast, it was good toast 😁
All in all a solid choice for a quick bite!  The signs on the wall are chuckle worthy!

Dad and I stopped on one of our daily adventures. He was hungry for fish and they had four different options. We both went with the COD. It was excellent. We got a single serving. It came with 2 sides. I got cole slaw and fries. Dad got cole slaw and mashed potatoes. It's a small place with a great place with a great atmosphere. The lady who took our order was very friendly and courteous. If you're in the area check it out.

The haddock was the star here! Strongly recommend eating there since this sort of food just doesn't travel well (I ordered there for take out and drove about 10 minutes home). I hope they have some outdoor tables in the summer. Flavors were good and loved the fries. Likely won't get the Mac and cheese again but that's fine, the fish and chips are plenty good to bring us back again. My cod sandwich was good but I don't think the drive home with it did it any favors. .

Stopped by this place for a snack.  Overall a good experience…

Pros:
Chicken tenders - cooked to order so they were hot & fresh when we received them.
Dipping sauces - nice variety
Fried haddock - good flavor without a lot of breading
Banana pudding - made with sliced bananas & Nilla wafers.  Excellent.

Cons:
The restaurant was small so they didn’t have a lot of seating.
The corn we ordered was cold.  We ended up taking it home instead of eating it there.
The Mac & cheese wasn’t good at all.  Tasted sour & spoiled.
The bathrooms are located in the restaurant next door.  The staff took us through the kitchen before going through another door to the other restaurant.  We didn’t feel comfortable going the same way back so we just went out the front door of the other restaurant then back to cluck & catch.

If I go again it would be for the chicken, fish, and banana pudding.  To go.

formatted_address: 1665 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Subway

reviews.text: Ordered a chicken sandwich but there was barely any chicken, just sauce and salad. For some mysterious reason the chicken was not on the display which I never experienced.The taste was okay though, and the atmosphere was nice. Staff were friendly and helpful.

At what I’m sure is management’s direction, the protein portions are now much smaller, to the point of too small and being unfair to the customer.
I ordered a 6-inch of the chicken salad, and there were a few chunks of chicken on the bread, but mostly sauce from the chicken salad.
Great service from the cashier and sandwich artists. But you are paying a lot, and getting less and less food.
The worker there is too busy flirting with the visibly uncomfortable female customers to actually get your order right, and then they dont issue a refund

The food was fine but very disappointed service. The server is very unprofessional. He has a weird accent and also can't understand what I'm ordering. I asked for BBQ chicken(which is one the menu) rather than telling me it's not available, he asked if I want grilled chicken. I didn't ask for 12" but he made it a 12" and refused to correct it as a 6". Very disappointed experience, probably won't visit again

Rude and aggressive personal. Probably not well trained and dirty food and place. They did not even wear gloves when making my sandwich, even though I asked for a vegetarian sandwich, they crossed contaminated it by preparing a chicken sandwich at the same time. Horrible experience… I will  never going there even by mistake 🤮🤢

formatted_address: 1611 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Champs Sports Grill

reviews.text: This review is being edited after I fought with Champs management for over a week trying to get someone to look into my situation.  I visited here on July 2nd. The following week I noticed an extra $18 added to my tab after I left a cash tip. I did not write in a tip on that receipt. The food and service was great but I dont put up with this. Spoke to Greg the following Monday. He took down my info and told him the info. Then called again that Friday to check in. He said he hadnt gotten around to it but would have someone look at it when he got help later that day. Never heard anything back. Then called the following week and spoke to maybe the owner and addressed the situation to him.  Not sure who he was and said Greg would be in later. Called later and was told he wasnt there. This had been 2 weeks after and not one call back to me. So I called my bank and told them and disputed the charge. I wanted to dispute the entire thing because an establishment who allows their employees to write in tips and does nothing about it doesn't deserve a damn dime from me. My wife's family might love this place and the food is great but the management team is as trash as penn states basketball team. They definitely need some ethics training and keep an eye on their staff.

"Served with a side Caesar or Fries..."  that you will pay through your nose for!  Our server was excellent (Kyle) but tacked on every possible charge...  1) note that the fries were $3.99 each when they should have been included, or at most $1.99 for the burger; 2) my girlfriend asked if she could have the chicken patty on another burger choice, he said yes he would ask, and then added $4.00 because as he put it "the kitchen made me do it; 3) $4.99 for coleslaw?  Seriously?  Not coming here again, unless it's only for drinks... which seem reasonably priced still.  We gave Kyle a $20 cash tip for his good service, but $110 for a burger, two sandwiches, and a few beers?  Good Lord!!!

We were pleasantly surprised with the tasty food at this place. I ordered their chicken tacos and they were out of the world. Their Mac & Cheese and fries were also very good. During weekdays they run a special $2 per taco upto 11 pm. Definitely worth the food and drinks.
Server was very nice, took time to explain the food menu and service was prompt.

Great sports bar! The beer selection us great, The Knuckle Ball is the best and biggest appetizer anywhere, the meat and potatoes is not what you think, its way better! Think tenders pot roast and Gnocchi! I highly reccomend! Fun Penn State Vibe!

We are from Nichols NY.  Went down to help our son move from State College to Philadelphia.  Decided to go have a drink and stopped here.  Bloody Mary was amazing!  Order a mozzarella cheese stick that was homade and huge!  We loved it!  Highly recommend this place! Thank you for the amazing drinks, food and service!

formatted_address: 287 Northland Center, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Fuji Jade Garden & My Thai

reviews.text:
Very cold inside the restaurant. Waiter did not seem happy and annoyed he had to be there to take our orders. Asked for a gluten free option for chicken hibachi, waiter said they would make it special in the kitchen. When the “gluten free” food was brought out, asked if the noodles had gluten free ingredients. Waiter did not know and had to ask another worker (who didn’t speak English) if they were gluten free (said he cooked without soy sauce) had to call someone to translate and find out. Noodles had flour in them and food had to be taken back and redone.
Another member of the party order the trio hibachi, but didn’t get the steak. Added 20% tip instead of 18% as indicated on menu for large groups. Never filled up the waters.

Absolutely DO NOT recommend eating here! The experience was awful from the minute we sat down. To start the Hibachi room was so cold, we couldn't even sit there comfortably. There wasnt anyone else in the room and they had all the fans running. When our cook finished cooking our meal, we asked if they could turn the fans off, because we were freezing...he asked our server who argued with him and wouldn't allow him to turn the fans off. Our food was cold minutes after hitting our plates. Then to top it off, our $120 had a $21 tip added to it without being asked or told. After asking the "boss" about it, he pulls out a menu that wasn't even given to us, and shows us that any parties with more then 5 people are charged 18%, but we were charged 20, nowhere in the facility did they have anything posted that they charged any extra amounts for large parties. The customer service was absolutely horrendous. Our server, the guy who seemed to run the show, and the rest of the staff were ignorant. Take your money and go to Ichiban!

My food was delicious. The crab Rangoon bites tasted fresh, delicate and great. Main dish also very tasty. Coconut soup, super satisfying. I did however get served a dirty looking cup for water. I politely asked for a new cup, and when they brought it, it also looked dirty. Other than that, all delicious.

Take your money elsewhere! Please don't waste your time here..I was looking to find a nice pan-asain restaurant to take my family to and have I maitai while visiting my family for my nephews birthday party today. I went to the restaurant with plenty of time to spare prior.The information on the website was completely inaccurate. They do not have a full service bar or a liquor license period. The menu item I wanted to order was not on the menu and the customer service I received was the worst I have ever experienced and I have worked every position you can think of in the food service industry . Where do I start? We walk in to an empty restaurant and the server stands at the door after seating us and stares at me the entire time I'm looking at their three menus, we had to share the main menu because he didn't give me one, I ask them about the dish I came for and the man looks at me like I grew a second head and says they don't serve that. I tell him I need a moment to think of something else and he stands close to me with his notepad pressing me while I'm looking. I ask him if I can have a MaiTai and he informs me that they do not have a liquor license. I order an appetizer and my family puts their order in. I wasn't allowed to get a kids sized portion for my 6 year old when the menu online also states there's a kids menu, weird right so no drinks,the dish I wanted isn't on the menu and they don't have a kids menu. I put in my order and other people start coming in. He delivers the food and never checks on us again. I had to grab my own to go boxes for the leftovers and I was waiting for the check for so long I was getting to the point where I was going to now be late to the party. I go to the register and ask for my check. The waiter comes over and clearly starts bad mouthing me in another language to the cashier and I still write in a decent tip which he's standing over watching me write in and snatches the paper from my hand. I have no idea what this guys problem was and I was polite even though I was clearly very upset.
That was the most expensive meal I have ever had at an Asian restaurant and the service ruined my day. Someone that acts that way should not work around other people or in the service industry period. I have went to full service hibachi restaurants and paid less and had great service. This experience was truly disheartening and I am hoping to stop anyone else from feeling the way I did when I was there today. I have never wrote a bad review about a restaurant and do not like to complain because I know how it feels but please do yourself a favor ,and just don't do it.

I haven't been in this building since Ni Hao was open, but I am so glad I went!
The service was great, and we received the food so quick!
Everything was delicious. The sushi roll was one of the best I've had in a while. It had crispy fish skin or something on top.
The appetizer item called monkey brain I believe? It was really good, I recommend it if you like avocado.
My boyfriend really liked his mei fun (not sure if I spelled it right) and I got some kind of chicken with vegetables and garlic sauce.
The sauce came on the side. It was really tasty with a slight spice to it.
Highly recommend this place, I will go again.

formatted_address: 1229 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: The Original Waffle Shop North

reviews.text: Best breakfast ever! We got the bacon cheddar omelette, pecan banana waffles and a chocolate chip pancakes, delicious! Gail provided great service. Line outside was long but moves fast and is super worth it.

The food and service were amazing. I had eggs, corned beef hash, and potatoes along with a blueberry waffle, and everything was cooked perfectly and full of flavor. My wife ordered the eggs Florentine, which she really enjoyed.

Overall, a great spot for a delicious and satisfying meal with friendly service. We’ll definitely be back.

First time just traveling through, Rosa knew how to please us. I got the Tex-Mex with home fries & fruit, he got the meat lovers, multi grain bread, home fries. Everything was super good, love the PA red potato home fries. He always inspects the men’s room this one was at 💯 clean! Ladies room also very clean.

Absolutely loved this place! The waffles were amazing,perfectly crisp on the outside and fluffy inside. And the Egg Florentine? Simply mouth-watering. Every bite was full of flavor and felt freshly made. What truly elevated the experience was the waitress,she was so warm, attentive, and genuinely made our visit even better. Great food, great service, and a place I can’t wait to return to!

Had an incredible brunch here. Burger was perfectly cooked and fries were nice and crispy. My wife’s omelet was very flavorful and the buttermilk pancakes were excellent. Homefries had a ton of flavor and didn’t taste like wet potatoes like some other places. Even though it was very busy the wait staff were kind. I absolutely adore this place and highly recommend it. Come early though as the lines can get crazy!

formatted_address: 1781 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Sheetz

reviews.text: A classic. Sheetz always comes through with quick, customizable, and consistently good. Perfect late-night fuel or road trip stop. Can’t go wrong.
Good place for gas and have a snack. Free air is also there. Automatic air filling machine is accurate and easy to use. Often visit this place.

Under PA law you are allowed to buy tobacco products over 21 while accompanied by someone under 21 which fall under a different law then alcohol regulations. The employee refused to sell me my zyns because I happened to be accompanied by my friend who is a few years younger than me. Totally unprofessional and haphazard application of laws that the employees are clearly not trained properly in. He also made it to seem like its a standard law/practice and ive been to many different states and this is the only time ive had this happen was in PA at state college. They just made an inconvenience for a customer at this location, so I literally went 0.5miles to another sheetz and literally bought what im entitled to purchase by reaching my legal age. The guy at the counter accomplished nothing by refusing a legal purchase.

Very disappointed with this sheetz!! I am young professional college graduate with a full time job and every time I go here to get a beer I am pulled aside and quized about my ID. I am almost 25 and this is straight up embarrassing because my white friends and girlfriend never get this treatment there, I spoke to the manager about this and she said it is unlikely this is racially charged but I think it is subconsciously because why is it only me who gets questioned and quized. I will not be returning to this sheetz again.

I went in to purchase beer and was given a hard time for my Driver’s License. I am 28 years old with a valid drivers license and the girl working the counter asked to verify my DOB and zip code. I told her my DOB and zip code and she said that my Zipcode was incorrect so she could not sell me anything. I explained that my current zip is different from the address on the Driver’s License as I have moved and have an updated address card. I asked her why she was giving me a hard time in the first place and her response was “because I can.” Horrible employees at this location therefore I will never go back to any sheetz ever again.

formatted_address: 283 Northland Center, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Subway

reviews.text: Why are we only having 1 person working at noon on a Monday? Waiting for a mobile order, DoorDash guy is waiting. Others are waiting. People in line walked out. Simply not enough help. Do better.
It was pretty cold inside. Also the oven or whatever was broken so I couldn't get the sub toasted. Other than that, a good experience.

I went to order a Meatball sub and asked to substitute the mozzarella cheese with American slices ... The older gentleman told me I couldn't change it it's already on the sandwich... then gave the cheese to a gentleman working that was eating in the lobby .. then proceeded to throw bacon on my sandwich.... I never once asked for bacon ... I told him I didn't want bacon and said your food is not visible due to a giant silver covering the window view. I told him I cannot see the sandwich. He then told me "that's not my problem" so I told him he was disrespectful and left without purchasing my food. Very rude service. I was the only customer in the store.

I left a review here a few weeks ago and the store literally deleted it. The owner’s son, who claims to be volunteering there, harassed me the entire time I was in the store, ALONE. Mind you, I am a 22 year old woman, alone in a store, being asked to hangout outside of work, and being told that he could keep me “loyal and genuine”. While I started to show discontent on my face, he literally said “don’t worry I won’t touch you”…. like what????
He also kept insinuating that he would give me free food, he put two jalapeños that I did NOT ask for and claimed they were “one for me one for him”. What if I was allergic???? After, he refused to put extra sauce on my sandwich because I asked for extra, he put regular and looked at me asking if it was enough, I was uncomfortable so I said sure. He says “but that’s regular amount?? so I said okay you can put more, to which he responded “No you already said it was enough”. Can you please stop playing tricks around people’s food?? He also asked me for my number about 6 times and didn’t take no for an answer. He’s a creep and I will continue reposting this. The fact that the store felt ok to delete a review because their son is a creep just shows that you should avoid this location.

Subway had been my goto convenience meal for years.  My favorite of all in the franchise is in Northland Shopping Center. A young lady works there who is an absolute gem! She is pleasant, personable, and perfect every time. I can count on getting a satisfying, nutritious sandwich, and l have NEVER been disappointed. I am always amazed with how proficient she is and she can actually make my order, including all the goodies l like to pile on,  from memory. I can always count on her making my visit to this store a pleasant experience.

formatted_address: 1100 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Domino's Pizza

reviews.text:
Honestly, this Domino’s is surprisingly good. We all know chain pizza can be a hit or miss, but this spot is consistently on point.
The pizza actually showed up hot, and they didn’t skimp on the toppings. That garlic seasoning they put on the crust is easily the best part—it’s super salty and buttery, which is exactly what you want when you're craving a cheap slice. It’s not "five-star Italian restaurant" quality, but for the price and the speed, it’s hard to beat.
The delivery was fast, too. The driver actually found the place without calling me ten times, and the food wasn't all slid to one side of the box. If you’re just looking for a quick, reliable meal while you’re hanging out or gaming, this is a solid choice.

This is just like most other Domino’s franchises I’ve been to recently. The pizza is good, but not my favorite. The garlic knots are good, but not great. The service was very matter of fact. Nothing to note one way or another. If you love Domino’s, then you’ll love this place. If you don’t, you won’t.

My favorite snacks is parmesan bread bites!

Added on Jul 15 2022:
So tasty！ I ordered the thin pizza and it is sooooo crispy and flavored. Attached my choice below for your information.
32-Piece Parmesan Bread Bites
Medium (12") Thin Pizza
Whole: Honey BBQ Sauce, Premium Chicken, Pepperoni, No Robust Inspired Tomato Sauce, Cheese.

This is my second time ordering pizza from this location for my son who is a student at Penn State.  Both orders have been fantastic.  My recent order was fully done using the Domino’s app which is a five star too.  I was able to order everything on the app without any issues and I absolutely love that you can see the progress in real time! The entire process from ordering to receiving the delivery was about 30 minutes.  The driver called my son to notify him he was at the dorm and he was very happy with the order!  I’m sure the pizza tasted better than these photos I was able to get from my son - try asking for a pic from a teenager 🤦🏻‍♂️. Overall very happy with the food, delivery and entire ordering process! I highly recommend this location.

We found a little green worm in a tomato on our pizza, and when we called to tell them what we found, the manager kept saying “we don’t have worms on our pizza” over and over and then he just hung up on us. He said it like 9 or 10 times and was so rude. He kept interrupting us to tell us about the fact that they had no worms on their pizza. 0/10 experience, and also so gross!

formatted_address: 287 Northland Center, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: My Thai

reviews.text: Very quaint atmosphere. Absolutely loved the menu. They even had cute packaging for the kids juice and water.  Highly recommend this restaurant. For Asian and Thai options. We had Chicken fried rice, Red Curry beef & shrimp, along with Red curry Chicken.  Including the Thai Iced coffee and tea.

Pad Thai was taken out of a buffet table mushy and gross.  No peanuts or green onions no lime just absolutely horrible.  I am very disappointed.  Was not fresh at all.  Pork was old and dry.  Worst I have ever had.

The food is great, but the service has been consistently rude toward us over several visits. We’ve always been polite and tip appropriately, yet staff interactions feel dismissive and unfriendly every time.

During our last visit, the server said almost nothing, pointed at a table, and seemed visibly irritated. At this point, it’s hard not to notice the contrast in how other customers are treated. We won’t be returning unfortunately.

Usually places with this much variety and that cover so many Asian cuisine cultures disappoint. Happy to say this is not the case here. The highlights of our two visits were the pad see yu, red curry and spicy basil.

Love this place for it’s variation! Always curious to know how they do that! They have Chinese, Thai, and many other items on the menu, even a few different menu to pick from! Plenty of parking and seating space for guest to be comfortable. The food is little expensive, but huge quantity.

formatted_address: 1430 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Dunkin'

reviews.text: Walking into this Dunkin Donuts is like entering a different dimension in which 1 second is 10 Dunkin seconds. I cannot believe how long it took for my SINGLE DRINK to be made. 32 MINUTES. FOR JUICE. I kid you not, it was 32 minutes I had to wait for one drink. And they didn’t have any baked goods. Please, watch paint dry, it’ll be less painful (and probably more tasty) than waiting at this Dunkin for your drink.

The last three times in a row I've been to this location I've had issues with my order. First time got a breakfast sandwich and it wasn't even luke warm it was down right cold. Got a replacement and it was BARELY even luke warm. The next 2 times they messed up my very simple order. The guy/kid who makes it gave me dirty looks Everytime as well. Wouldn't recommend.

This Dunkin perplexes me. While I love the atmosphere and the friendliness of the workers, the slow service here is so infuriating. The Dunkin in State College is 10x busier yet they are more organized and faster at times. Ordered only a drink, 10 minutes later I arrived at the location and it wasn’t ready, stood by the counter for 3 minutes and then they asked me what I was there for and they finally started by drink. Again, this Dunkin has one of the most pleasant workers and atmosphere I’ve ever seen but this service is infuriating, as 25% of my visits to this Dunkin are like this.

Spencer was probably the friendliest and happiest person I have ever seen at the drive through. It made my morning. It's really hard to find people in customer service that are kind and friendly. 5 stars just for this guy. Thanks for making my morning awesome and good job for having solid employees !

I went with my niece earlier to get the spider donut which Dunkin is supposed to have until November 6th. When I arrived at the window to pick up my mobile order, the employee working drive through informed me that they were no longer making spider donuts. I have worked at another popular fast food chain so I understand that if you aren’t getting shipments, you can’t make certain products. However if you don’t have the product available, it should be removed from your online menu so you can avoid people trying to order it and finding out it is unavailable. I am also confused on why they wouldn’t be getting shipments or making more of the spider donut when they are still supposed to have it on the menu for another 3 days.

formatted_address: 1521 Martin St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Arena Bar & Grill

reviews.text: Initially, there was some uncertainty regarding the operational status of the establishment due to a service delay. The venue presents a club-like atmosphere, with a bowling alley conveniently accessible via connecting doors. The value proposition for the quality of cuisine provided was exceptional, and the food itself was outstanding. I particularly savored the rodeo cheesesteak sub, served on a freshly baked bun prepared on-site. The fries, in my assessment, were among the finest I have experienced recently, being freshly cut and perfectly crisped. Our visit took place during the transitional period between lunch and dinner service.

We went for wing night and were pretty disappointed. There was one server for a large group and he took a long time. The wings weren't hot when they came out. The Parmesan wings were terrible, the bbq flavors were okay. We had to ask for our beer battered fries twice and got them 45 minutes after we ordered. They were the only hot food we had all night and were good, but were just basic fries. Cheap food but hit or miss, and the music was very loud.

Went there Nov 2024 and since the new menu..... downhill! The turkey bacon sandwich I got was so hard to eat! I told them fresh bread not toasted. Well I guess they don't know what toasted is... so blackened that it was hard to eat. I didn't really care at the time because I was starving but now I'm regretting because my mouth is sore from being scratched from the "toasted bread "..... so was my friend that ordered a sandwich..... and the fries are smashed and are like potato skins.

My husband took me out for my birthday and we decided we would try here!  The wings and cheese steak were amazing!  The service was perfect.  We enjoyed watching the line dancers. The atmosphere was relaxing.  We really enjoyed ourselves.
Sincerely could have done without the karaoke Friday night. It was too loud and singers were subpar to say the least. I did not patronize the establishment for the entertainment, quite the opposite.

formatted_address: 1609 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Rita's Italian Ice & Frozen Custard

reviews.text: They were kind enough to bring their flavors to our job and what a refreshing treat. I copped out and got the lemon but it was so good and reminded of those childhood trips to the waterfront. Excellent choice for a refreshing summer treat

The lady is quick to cut you off. I asked to sample two flavors and she rolled her eyes and gave me a disgusted look. She gave all my friends napkins with their icees but I had to ask for one. It felt racially motivated because I was the only black person there.
Just your classic Rita's! They got all the classics like ice and custard and gelati and more! Not as many flavors as other Rita's but that's alright, still around 9 flavors.

I asked for a blendini with vanilla custard and root beer ice. Before I could even ask for my toppings, they cut me off, charged me, and started serving the next person. They gave me my blendini after waiting approximately 20 minutes, which is fine I guess, even though they weren't busy. I asked for the toppings, and they refused, saying that blendinis dont come with toppings. Total waste of money and a drive all the way out here. Terrible service.
This is the only place I have found vanilla water ice which is my absolute favorite flavor. It was truly an amazing experience

formatted_address: 1450 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Hoss's Steak & Sea House

reviews.text:
Admit I hadn’t been into a Hoss’s Steak House for decades, but saw this one in State College and had to give it a try!
The visit brought back all the memories!  This place is a blast from the past.
Still looks the same but very clean and well kept.  Buffet provides so many options!  Really didn’t even need to order dinners but went in for the whole experience!  Soo much food.  Steak dinners were very good and the limitless options offered at the buffet provided such a great value.  The staff here is super attentive and friendly as well!

Excellent variety of soups every day; excellent temperature of soups. Salad bar is kept clean; items never run out. The same kind of pie is offered too many weeks; a more frequent change is needed. The music selections are pretty good, but the quality of the loudspeakers is poor; the sound is not clear, it's distorted. We dine here often and will continue to do so.

I have never left a restaurant without tipping until I ate here. Our waitress (don’t know her name because she never introduced herself) was disappointing. She didn’t offer refills, didn’t check to see how we were doing, and when it was time for the check, she just dropped it on the table without saying anything. The food wasn’t great. Will not be going back here.

As a Traveling Chef/Culinarian , it is a pleasure to have the opportunity to eat at this quintessential establishment.  This is a must if you are in the neighborhood.  The customer service is hands down the best that I have experienced in a long time. Food selection is amazing 👏 there is something for everyone. Thanks Hoss for the Hospitality and amazing food can't wait to return !!!

For being a Saturday during what should be peak hours, it wasn't really busy. Staff were either there when you didn't need it or couldn't be found when you needed them. One of my party members received a very bad crab that definitely should have not been served to anyone with how old it was, she got sick from it after one bite. The soup, salad, and nacho bar had some stuff that was long past it's prime and not fresh. All in all I left disappointed.

formatted_address: 1613 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Panera Bread

reviews.text: Never again will I choose Panera. While traveling for work I got a half salad and soup for takeout. They pack the salad so tightly into a small container that you can't even mix the dressing in without the lettuce going all over. And what's with the tiny container of dressing??? What do you get, like, 2 tablespoons? That's pathetic. And the baguette is just thrown in the bag uncovered. You can't even wrap it in something? I understand the need to maximize profits but you guys are just cheap and chintzy. Does it really cost THAT much to give a decent amount of dressing with a takeout order?!? Most of my salad ended up having NO dressing on it so I just threw it away. Cheap cheap CHEAP!! And you can see from the pic that the lettuce isn't even that fresh looking either. Never ever ever will I choose this chain again.

Had a piece of nectarine in my dressing that I accidentally poured in my Caesar salad and then I had nectarine in it. The salad was so bad too. I saw a review about a salad a month ago from someone so obviously whoever is making the salads isn’t doing a good job :(
Akela, Jae, and Berkeley were the kindest most helpful employees I have ever encountered at a Panera. They are fantastic at their jobs!

This branch is great. Staff are cooperative and kind. The place is specious and well organized. Service food is slow sometimes during rush hours but worth the wait annd can be managed by placing an order beforehand through easy to use Panera app. I would highly recommend this branch; and the spicy fiesta chxsdw and the grilled Chz. The cookie was decent too.

UPDATE - much better experience this time, so I'll add back a star. Service was quick, food was great.
= = = = =
(In all fairness, this was the Sunday lunch rush the day after Penn State homecoming.) The place was packed. As we entered our order in the kiosk, a staff member said it would be a 23 minute wait. (It was over 40 minutes.) We got the last open table left in the place. There was a crowd to fight through at the pickup counter. But my salad was great, when I finally did get it.

formatted_address: 1670 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Red Lobster

reviews.text: Whenever we visit State College, Red Lobster at North Atherton is a must! Lobster, snow crab legs, shrimp, calamari ...all fresh, exquisite, and delicious always; presentation and ambiance excellent...biscuits and salads are also excellent. 5 star all the way...

My husband and I live 2,500 miles away from family, so the holidays especially Christmas kind of suck. This year we went to Red lobster Christmas day, and holy crap they knocked it out of the park.  It was so much better than we had anticipated. I got the salmon lobster and grilled shrimp in a brown butter sauce, it was exquisite, and exceptionally delicious. My husband who is extremely picky was also very pleasantly satisfied, which is saying alot! I forgot to take a picture of our food because I was so excited, but 10 out of 10 would highly recommend. And since poor Dan had to work Christmas day we made sure to tip him 30%. Thanks bud!

I'm extremely disappointed with our recent dining experience at this restaurant. We visited to celebrate a birthday, but the service was subpar. The restaurant was empty, yet they refused to accommodate our request to replace a side dish due to dietary issues. The food was also poorly prepared - my husband's salmon was burnt, and the dishes arrived at different times, causing one family member to eat last. The manager's absence and lack of explanation only made things worse.

My wife and I stopped to eat after a long day of shopping.  We were immediately greeted when we came in and were promptly seated.  Our server Cashmere (Aniyah G) took our drink order and gave us plenty of time to look over the menu to order appetizers.  She then came back to take our dinner order.  She gave us periodic updates on our appetizers and entrees.  She also did an awesome job of making sure we were ok.  When the appetizers came out the calamari and stuffed mushrooms we were very pleased with the large portion sizes and the quality was very good.  For our entrée we both got the Ultimate feast and the presentation was beautiful and the taste was oh so good. I only wish i would have taken photos.  My compliments to the kitchen staff.  We have eatten and other Red Lobsters but none as good as one on N. Atherton in State College.  6221.  Cashmere was by far one of the best servers i have ever had the pleasure of dealing with.  You can definitely tell she enjoys her job and it show in her level of service.  I will definitely make the trip back to this Red Lobster and hooe to have Cashmere be my server again.  GREAT JOB TO ALL THE STAFF.

Red lobster has definitely changed for the better. Never used to like coming here too risky for how expensive things are but this experience has changed that for me. We took the risk and I’m glad. Many thanks to the new CEO! We dined in. Staff were really nice and our waitress was the best! The biscuits were nice and fresh, warm and soft. The boil bags were absolutely delicious!! I got the original Cajun flavor and it was perfect was not too spicy at all but enough flavor for me! I also tried a whole 2lb lobster for the first time and it was very good. LOTS of meat! The boil bag and 2lb lobster was enough for 2people. The lobster comes with 2 sides as well. I got the hush puppies and they were really good. The Sunset Passion Colada is delicious and Purple Haze by Dre + Snoop was also really good. Loved the sparkles in it and it wasn’t too sweet and I could taste all the flavors. Also tried the Lobster Punch and it was really good more on the sweeter side. We paid $150 for everything and it was totally worth it to me. Boil bags are not cheap to begin with and the lobster was on the pricey side but it was a good first time experience. Would definitely recommend and if they keep it up I’ll be coming back!

formatted_address: 310 W Aaron Dr, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill

reviews.text: This place is amazing. I love how the owner helps and works just as hard as his employees. I see he hires young kids which is great bc it has a vreat atmosphere. There is a worker named vinne who is one of the hardest workers ive seen in a long while.  The owner foesnt even know my family and walked pased one day whole we were eating and iffered to buy us ice cream. Ive never had bad food from there. We went tonight and it looked so busy and we only waited about 5 mins to 7 mins and we had our food and it was absolutely delicious. My family and i love coming here. The employees also go above and beyond. But the owner and Vinnie are literally superstars!!!

Great Dairy Queen experience. The staff was super-friendly and seemed genuinely happy to be working there. The service was very fast. Food was great as always, although the menu did not include everything we were used to (but we just moved from Texas, where you could get steak fingers that I guess you can't get outside of Texas).

I believe the owner was working when we were there . He was going around to tables asking how everyone was seemed to care about the experience. Should have more business owners like him , he went out of his way to show coupons for future visits will definitely return. 🥰
The food is just so good, I've never had an issue of accuracy. Sometimes the wait can be a little long but it's only because the food is so good it's hard to wait for haha.
Staff is friendly, service is fast, orders are correct, and food is great. Tables are always clean and seating is pretty comfortable. Really nice and well-kept place.

formatted_address: 211 Patriot Ln, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Moe's Southwest Grill

reviews.text:
Staff was friendly when I came in. They gave off pretty chill vibes and were attentive. I just wish the food was a little bit better for the price I paid. The food was okay. Maybe I just needed a bit more sour cream. 😅
They did have a very nice salsa bar that was well-stocked and the portion I got was nice and large.
Overall, it's a 4 stars out of 5 for me, but that's because of service and cleanliness, not quality of food.

One of the few places everyone in our family can find something they enjoy even with dietary restrictions. The workers are great and have even gotten to know our kids’ special requests 🙂 Took a star off the food only because occasionally the chicken will be a bit charred; otherwise great all around!

first time eating here and will be the last time. my order was completely cold, my tortilla was hard and not even wrapped the whole way in the foil, my chips were stale, the “protein bowl” was just not even half a bowl of JUST chicken and was cold. the lady i spoke to on the phone didn’t even know what the protein bowl was. i ordered on the app too.

Placing an order at 12:07 shouldn’t warrant a 12:41 pickup…. As I sit there and watch others who walk in 5-10 mins after I had arrived be waited on. What’s the point of ordering ahead ? That is all. Mind you it said estimated pickup was 12:22. Essentially an entire work lunch period taken when it shouldn’t have happened. I’ll go elsewhere.

My husband and I came for dinner around 8 pm. There were three younger girls who ignored us for about 5 minutes while we stood there. They seemed very annoyed and ready to get out of there, even though they had an hour to close. They rushed us so bad we didn't even get the food we wanted. We watched how they treated other customers after us, and it was awful. While we were eating they were sweeping under us and spraying disinfectant. Highly disappointed.

formatted_address: 1615 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: McDonald's

reviews.text:
Yesterday around 1:10 pm,
It seemed like our order was about to be taken — until the employee saw who was in the car(Asian), and suddenly the headset went completely silent.
After waiting 3–5 minutes while other lane orders went through, we drove up to the window, still unheard.
When I asked why she didn’t respond, she insisted she did — then went to her manager and gave a rather creative retelling.
Truly fascinating customer service dynamics… silence has never spoken louder.

I enjoy the free soda and tea refills, and the staff member at the cashier, Joan, is very, very nice and has helped place my orders when the kiosks don't work, which happens every now and then. I get a specialty sandwich made, and it is correct every time. Natalie, the staff member who almost always is the cashier in the first window of the drive thru, is EXCELLENT at keeping the line moving and placing my order correct. You can always tell when she is NOT working because the drive thru loan does not go as fact, and it's very obvious that other staff member isn't as efficient as Natalie. She is funny, down to earth, and always fun to see and talk to. Excellent customer service inside and in the dru thru. My specialty sandwich is hot and fresh.

What a joke! Kiosk had no paper, customers were waiting for an hour for a stupid Grinch box. Had to ask for a refund, which was fun because we didn't know our order number due to the no paper issue. They just throw all the orders on the counter and it's help yourself,  basically take whichever bag you want. Never, ever going back to that crap show.
The drive through person was very nice. However, when we ordered hot coffee, we got iced coffee. I guess it is a small mistake, but wish they confirm the orderes before finalizing them.

I do enjoy some MacDonalds in the morning when travelling.  It is about a mile off the highway, and the sign on the exit indicates that which is nice.

The place was busy, but they moved things along quickly, and the food was hot.

formatted_address: 231 Northland Center, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Brothers Pizza

reviews.text: My wife and I have started ordering food online from Brother's once a week over the winter. Before it was just pizza that we ordered now it has been their subs! They are better than any other place around that offers subs. Brother's also has slices of Sicilian style pizza, and it is very good. The rest of the menu is great we are working our way through it. Great food. Best pizza in town and subs that are wonderful.

We’re visiting from out of town. Hotel manager recommended it as a decent pizza place in  State College.
It turned out to be a horrible experience.
We ordered two large pizzas and waited. When ready, younger of the two guys that were taking orders and handing over the food, refused to give more paper plates.
I explained we’re ten and I only counted six disposable plates. But the guy refused to give more plates with his justification that we only ordered two large ones.
There is always a first time.

I go to this Brother's pizza about once a week. I always tip even though it is over the counter service. I ordered a meatball parm sandwich. The bun was so well done that it was black across whole top and sides of one end. Can't believe that they brought it out like that! The bun was so over baked, tried to eat the bun but ended up eating just the meatballs and cheese. I was so disappointed Don't know if I will be back.
I love eating here.  I only wish you had more detailed descriptions of your meals so you would know when ordering if there's anything you want to add/remove.
This is what they call a “well-done” pizza. Wish i could get my money back.

formatted_address: 1610 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Wendy's

reviews.text: 20 minutes for a combo.  Zero customers at this location.  Only me. Greasy floors, ladder partially blocking the doors. Nobody working on it. Order was wrong. Waited longer for a baked potato that felt like a mud ball. Shocking location. Sandwich was ok 👍.

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but this was honestly one of the worst experiences I’ve had at a Wendy’s. The drive-through employee seemed very unsure of what she was doing, and I nearly drove away without receiving the drinks that were part of my order. I had to pause and double-check before leaving, which should not be necessary at a fast-food drive-through.

Overall, the experience felt disorganized and poorly managed. The fries were particularly disappointing—they did not taste fresh and lacked the usual texture and flavor I expect from Wendy’s fries. They seemed either old or improperly prepared when compared to other Wendy’s locations I’ve visited.

The only positive part of the order was the Baconator, which was prepared correctly and tasted as expected. Unfortunately, that alone was not enough to make up for the rest of the experience.

I may consider giving this location another chance in the future, but this visit fell well below expectations and did not reflect the standard I normally associate with the Wendy’s brand.

In all my years living in Centre County,  I've never had a problem ordering at this Wendy's. The cashier was nice, but I can't say the same thing about the people preparing the food. I could hear them loud and clear, about them complaing of how I made my order, in a very condescending and rude way. They were saying it in Spanish, thinking no one could understand them. Well, I am Hispanic, so I understood everything they were saying. This is to say, I will never come back to this location.

Went inside to eat and felt like I was eating inside a prison or something. It had absolutely ZERO atmosphere, zero decorations, zero colors. Also you have to order on a screen which a bunch of fast food places have switched to and I MUCH prefer talking to a human instead of touching a screen.

WORST experience i have ever had. Closed dining room 30 minutes early and made us walk through the drive through. We then had to wait 30 minutes to be able to order, and someone went inside to let them know we were waiting outside and she shushed us. Claimed they were busy but she were one of the only people there.VERY rude staff, and took forever to get our food. Also we weren’t allowed to make multiple orders even though we were in a group of 5 people.

formatted_address: 102 Clinton Ave, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: The Greek

reviews.text: I think our server's name was Jamie. It was a hockey weekend at Penn State and all restaurants in the area were full. Despite the business of the Greek, Jamie served us as if we were her only table. and she was like that with each table she went to. Good Greek food. Cute Atmosphere and Amazing service!

The Greek is one of my favorite restaurants in State College and made me realize I love Greek food.

The Kalamari Skaras is the best kalamari I've ever had; it even comes with pitas which are perfect for dipping in the leftover olive oil.

My favorite entrée is the Traditional Platter which offers a generous portion of delicious pork, fries, pitas, and tzatziki.

Every time I come here, I expect (and receive) incredible service and food at a great cost.

The food here is incredible. Just the right amount of seasoning/flavor. I had the tomato bisque and chicken kabob and both were delicious. The dessert is just as good. The servers were friendly and quick. The only thing I didn’t love is that the seating feels similar to a cafeteria because the tables are close together. Overall though I highly recommend.
the food was so tasty and the service just as excellent. I went with a couple of vegetarians too and they had plenty to choose from! but don’t worry, the meat-eater (me) was also well-fed.

A hidden gem in Happy Valley! The Greek is tucked behind Waffle House and opens up into a huge restaurant that is completely Greek inspired in decor and delicious food. We had a variety and nothing disappointed. My favorite was the dip sampler and the stuffed grape leaves but the gyro was also very good. Gabi was our waitress and she was very knowledgeable about the menu and very attentive. They have a range of food options at all price points but you could easily have a very affordable nice night out. There is lots of seating and a very affordable drink menu (a bottle of wine for $14) to choose from. A great option for sit down dining or take out.

formatted_address: 1625 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: CC Peppers

reviews.text: My first time there. Not gonna lie, seemed a bit sketchy walking towards the back where you order. However, the staff for the most part were nice and the food was decent. The wings while pricey were actually good for being a breaded, fried and sauced. The chicken Cheese steak and cheese steak were also good. My only recomend is maybe a bit more meat for the price... a sit in, dive type of vibe with no frills is where good food usually is.

Great subs, great fries, good value for the price. Clean restaurant and friendly staff. Check out their daily specials for a good value meal+drink combo, they have a different one every day.

My personal favorite sub is the meatball sub, it's excellent.

These guys also definitely bleed Blue and White! 🤍💙 Go PSU!!
I graduated in 89 and this is always my favorite stop!! Love the coast to coast and the very friendly folks who worked there. I even got a jar of mustard!!

The taco salads are the best you can get, the shell is very crispy.

The interior could use a refresh, things look a bit out dated and the kitchen looks well used. Let's be real though, you're there to eat not to look at the restaurant.
If you haven't tried this place, then you are missing out!.. consistent, delicious every time!

formatted_address: 1221 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Penang Asian Fusion Cuisine

reviews.text: The food is SOO good, I always feel like i’m getting better food (in both quantity and quality) than I was expecting. Not super expensive either. Wish more people ate here, they deserve the business.

The food is literally “okay.”  The service is “okay.” The space is “okay.” The prices are “okay.”

I rarely write an “okay” review unless my experience was really poor. Now, you are wondering why a 3 and not a 2. I think they can improve.

Their coconut pudding is excellent!

Really solid tasty food. Been here a few times and everything I tried was great. Wish they served nasi lemak considering the restaurants name! Will definitely be coming here more often to try more of their food.

Pineapple Fried Rice was good. Vegetable Belacan tasted good but had a tad too much stem compared to leaves. Curry Beef Stew Noodles was spicy, creamy (from coconut milk), and nostalgic. Each portion above can feed two. Roti Canai was small but tasty as an appetizer.

It's good food! (Pictured is their General Tso Chicken). I don't know how authentic it is, but there were a lot of Chinese people in there and they seemed to be enjoying themselves. The food quality was pretty good, some of the best Chinese I've had. The service wasn't that great though... I didn't get any drink refills and had to ask the server to come over anytime we needed anything, such as to go boxes and the check. I'd go back though.

formatted_address: 295 Northland Center, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Hibachi at MY THIA

formatted_address: 315 W Aaron Dr, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Suzie Wong's Egg Roll & More

reviews.text: Love it. Went in bought a bag of pork egg rolls, best on the east coast.
Suzie Wong's Egg Rolls are awesome

formatted_address: 1215 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Marzoni’s Brick Oven & Brewing Co.

reviews.text:
How often can you find a resturant has exceptional decore, waite staff and very,very skilled cooks who can treat your taste buds to excellent tasting Pizza, Stromboli and hamburgers and fresh not fishy smelling water to wash it down.
No need to go to 3 different resturants and drag yourself and family to ger perfectly cooked foid.
In my opinion One-Stop  at Marzoni's Brick Oven is the money saver.

Try the Tangerine Creme Ale!!  Cool little brewery near hotels and campus. Service was delightful and they offer beer and wine flights. Their gyro pizza was very good as was the seafood pasta. The crab Rangoon pizza was good? But rather sweet. If the sauce were on the side so you could control the sweetness, it would be much better.  Oh, the devil eggs…
Very friendly staff, with a nice variety of food options. Great draft beer selection and the oven roasted pizza was very good. Loaded fries with spicy ranch was the best I ever had.

The worst cheesesteak I have had in this town. It takes some real moxie to make a sub less filling that sheetz, cooked worse and charge more for it to boot. About the only redeeming thing this place has going on is the beer; fresh and tasty but it can’t compensate for the poor service and abysmal food

More cheese than meat on the sub, hardly any meat on there to speak of. Pictures attached. Will not be back.

Do better

I had an great meal at Marzoni’s recently! On the recommendation of my fantastic bartender/server, Joyce, I decided to try the Crab Pizza. It was absolutely delicious perfectly seasoned and easily one of the best unique pizzas I’ve had in a long time.
Joyce was the cherry on top of the experience. She was attentive, friendly, and her recommendation was spot on. It’s rare to find service that is both professional and genuinely welcoming. If you’re heading to Marzoni’s, definitely ask for Joyce and don’t sleep on that crab pizza!

formatted_address: 1212 N Atherton St #105, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: GuDong Hot Pot Delivery

reviews.text: A little expensive, but worth every penny! The owner is an absolute sweetheart and the food is DELICIOUS! I only wish i would have gotten a pot for everybody instead of just two, I know for next time!

It is pretty good sharing with family and friends！They gave Hot Pot for Free！
It is amazing！
We bought 15 hot pot packages when we spent our Christmas Holiday！
After skiing， having hot pot is amazing！

I've wanted to try a hot pot dinner forever and finally got the chance today. Our set came with the pot, fuel and spoons which was great. The pork/chive dumplings were AMAZING and I highly recommend them. Our entire meal was very interesting and we enjoyed every minute of it. I just wish there were instructions for first timers in the box since we had no idea what we were doing and much if the food was a mystery to us. A quick call to the restaurant cleared up most of our confusion though.
Fantastic food! My favorite broths were the original and spicy broths and the meat tasted amazingly fresh. Looking forward to coming back here each time I'm in the area!

I ordered takeout totaling around $120 from DoorDash today. Unfortunately, more than half of the items I received didn't appear fresh, especially the box of lamb. The color seemed off, and it had an unpleasant smell. It seems they are not serving fresh food maybe they over prepared during regular semester. I originally reached out to the owner through WeChat to request just the refund for this particular box only but no one responded me back. We are frequent customers, and it seems that their food quality has went down a lot.

formatted_address: 1100 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Fire & Fig Grill

reviews.text: I thought the prices were fine, surprising to see people talking about that in the reviews. Considering everything is saffron infused it is well worth it. I enjoyed the eggplant appetizer. My main recommendation would be to improve the bread, nothing wrong with it but I have a feeling it wouldn’t be hard to swap it for something higher quality. The food was very good, we are excited to come back and try new stuff.
We ordered all the platters including almost everything on the menu. Food is good, but definitely overpriced. Management and service training also need more improvement.

Warm atmosphere. Limited menu currently, but everything we had was delicious. I ate almost half of it before remembering to take pictures. We had the 3 dips - all three were great but the kashk-e bademjan in particular blew us away! Also had the zereshk polo with chicken entree, and the chicken fell right off the bone. The boogh is a sour yogurt drink with mint that paired nicely with the food and was a big full glass. Plenty of food to take home, too, which I'm excited to eat tomorrow :)

A clean place for a Persian cuisine. However, Persian kebabs should’ve been cooked more and had a sharper taste of saffron (these are missing in this restaurant yet)!
Their menu of kabobs is still limited (so some of their images on Maps are not proper representation of what they currently sell).
I hope they cook their kabobs more and provide bigger portions of meat, specially for chicken kabobs.

I’ve been here twice, and unfortunately both experiences were disappointing.
The first time I ordered koobideh with rice. The rice was undercooked, but I didn’t complain and just let it go.
The second time I came with a friend. We ordered a sultani (koobideh and chicken kebab) and also zereshk polo with chicken. The portion of the Zereshk polo was extremely small, not even a full chicken leg, just a very small piece of chicken. The sauce had almost no flavor at all. There wasn’t even a hint of salt, lemon, or pepper. It basically tasted like diluted tomato paste.
The chicken itself was completely bland.
I’ve had the koobideh here twice. The first time it was cooked but didn’t really taste like proper koobideh, it lacked the flavor you expect from seasoned meat and fat. The second time, the koobideh was actually undercooked and still red inside. I showed the waitress the inside of the meat, but nothing really changed. The chicken kebab was also bland and slightly undercooked.
The prices are also very high. We paid at least $64 including tip, which is a lot considering the food quality and just for 2 orders.
What was most disappointing was the service. Sara(the manager) just said excuses. At the end they said that if something is wrong we should say it earlier, even though I had already shown the waiter that the koobideh was undercooked.
Overall, very disappointing food, portions, and service for the price.

Sara also put us in a very awkward situation regarding the tip. A $13 tip had already been automatically added to the bill, and since the food was not good, we didn’t feel it was appropriate to leave a tip. Even though they said we could take the full $13 back, they asked us about it several times in a way that made us feel uncomfortable and pressured. In the end, because the situation felt so awkward, we only took back $6.

formatted_address: 1669 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: 700 Degree Pizza

reviews.text: I discovered this place via Too Good To Go and the value is insane. The pizza will feed me for several days (which I really value as a broke student) and the quality is superb. The ingredients are really fresh and the crust is perfect. Not cracker-thin or dough so thick it takes up most of the pizza (like most pizza chains). Will definitely be coming back.

One of the best pizza spots I’ve tried in a long time. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients—from the rich sauce to the perfectly melted cheese. The crust had the ideal crunch and chew. Staff was attentive and the place was clean and cozy. A must-visit for pizza lovers.
Fresh out of the oven, tasted great.  Owner is friendly and helpful.

I ordered this Pizza off the app To Good To Go
so we could try out their pizza. It was delicious and I definitely recommend it.

I ordered a pizza with the app that they recommended selecting to have a cheese pizza with pepperoni all over and pesto on half and also mozzarella sticks with marinara. I got a pizza that was half pepperoni and half cheese no pesto and mozzarella sticks with ranch? Pretty shitty. The pizza was also way greasy and had little to no sauce.

formatted_address: 1631 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: College Buffet

reviews.text:
The buffet needs a makeover.

Food is subpar. The place looks very old and outdated. Food tastes okayish. I was there around 2pm, It was not very busy. Food selection is not much. All the chicken I ate , everything was very sweet, not sure why pepper chicken was drenched in sugar. I am pretty sure I am not going there again. I have plenty of options for $13.

They have a new chef and new dishes they haven't had before, I've been coming here to satisfy my Chinese buffet cravings for 5 years now since I moved to State College from California, with the new chef and new items I love, I come to College Buffet even more now. I like the addition of of Siu Mai, pork buns,Salt and pepper frog legs, salt and pepper shrimp, along with the main reason I used to come was the salmon but with all of the new dishes I like I have even more reason to coming to College Buffet.  The Staff is also very attentive and pleasant,  they always remember what drinks I like and I don't even have to ask them because they automatically get it for me while I browse the Buffet. It has improved alot in the past couple of months.
Having sampled some of the best buffets on the planet, this is a 3/5. My favorite buffets in Miami are a cut above. But if you wish an average meal, then come here. They can improve across the board.

I went here on December and the food was honestly shitty. The best thing there was some sort of cheese oyster and it was almost $20 per person with tax. Most food was lukewarm and I would much rather just have fast food instead. The staff were ok though likely because me and the person I went with were both Asian.

Worst buffet experience ever. Today was our second time going here. 1st time we went almost 2 years ago, my kid was only 7 months old, he cried little bit as it is inherent for a kid like him but the stuff seemed really annoyed by my kid’s crying. Today we went there again, one of the stuffs asked us to sit where other guests were also sitting in other tables. When we asked for a high chair for our kid, another stuff came, seemed quite annoyed and told us to sit somewhere else which was kind of isolated from other guests’ tables. The stuff said, you can’t place high chair here, others can’t walk. But I could easily see there was enough space for walking even after you place a high chair and we try lot of different restaurants now and then and never had any issues with placing a high chair. They didn’t bother taking away the used plates from our table until we finished and it was a pile up of plates. The food is not fresh, does not taste so good, they were not refilling and some of the stuff’s behavior is very rude as I felt.

formatted_address: 1850 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Chipotle Mexican Grill

reviews.text: I would like to take a moment and say thank you to Chipotle (State College) for a terrible dinning experience on 02/27/26 at your N Atherton location. At least seven employees present. one working the front line 6 others standing around, dancing, checking their phones all the while the poor guy working the line (8 people deep) was doing everything he could to keep up while the others screwed around. The restaurant was trashed. None of the table’s were wiped down, garbage overflowing onto the floor, garbage all around the condiment area, the back where they serve food from was a complete mess as was the area where they prep food. It was BAD. not to mention, they were out of a lot of their ingredients. We watched at least 20 people come in and walk right back out. When I called corporate to let them know they just said ok, we’ll look into it and offered me a free drink.I don’t want a free drink. I want you to DO BETTER!. I asked to have the manager contact me and was told they don’t do that.

Ordered 3 bowls, with extra rice, extra cheese, beans, corn salsa, one with guacamole. 2 with lettuce. Got 3 bowls, no cheese, didn’t get guacamole on my bowl, and lettuce on all 3. Received extra nothing. Not to mention ordered chips and queso, received queso, no chips. I was told sorry, we’re out. This Chipotle gives the smallest portions, figured ordering extra would make up for it, it did not. Tried to goto the one downtown, but that place is so packed, and an absolute mess all day everyday, it’s really not worth it. Hopefully one of the 2 they’re currently building will be better managed. Terrible way to spend $40, and drive 20 min home to find out how incompetent one can be.

I asked for a burrito and they started to make a bowl.  I didn’t notice until a couple of seconds later. When I pointed out that I had asked for a burrito they seemed extremely confused. The way that they responded made it seem like they were blaming me for this mistake. Not to mention this is how they wrapped my burrito… overall typically not good service at this location, wouldn’t recommend.

When I asked for salt on the side, I was told that Chipotle is no longer allowed to give salt to customers. They were very rude about it which seemed kind of odd to me. Then the guy said he personally made the chips that morning and he put tons of salt on them. When I sat down my chips hardly had any salt at all, so I walked up and politely showed him and said would you mind if I have some salt? Another guy in line working said no you can’t. And when I asked again, he looked back at a woman who I assumed was the manager, and she rolled her eyes at him. So finally, I pulled out a $10 bill and said can I please just buy some salt this is ridiculous that you won’t give it to me. And the guy behind the counter said I’m not sure if we’re allowed to sell it to you. Finally, the manager gave him some salt and they charged me $1.50 for salt that should’ve already been on the chips in the first place. It was shocking how rude they were. And I have no idea why. Anyway, I would never go back to this chipotle but I do love the food in general.

This was one of the worst Chipotle Bowl I ever had. The beef was mainly gristle. I had about 10 pieces of gristle. The brown rice was hard. The chips were stale. The chips had been sitting for hours. The tortilla chips tasted old, and they were hard to bite. I threw the entire bag away. I am completely disappointed in the food I was served. I have no interest in spending my money on poor quality food.

formatted_address: 1870 N Atherton St, State College, PA 16803, USA
name: Panda Express

reviews.text:
I walked in to them making fresh orange chicken, however, the first bowl is my portion, verses my friends portion. They had plenty of orange chicken, so I'm not sure why my portion was so small. My server, Abigail S, watched me taking the pictures, and did not ask if everything was ok with my order.

The rice, even though it was dried out, had good flavor. The orange chicken, even though I watched them make it, didn't seem fresh. 🤔
This Panda Express does it right! Their service is quick and professional, and their food is top-notch. 🐼

So I was so hungry my sugar was literally dropping and the team here at this Panda Express whipped me and my co-workers up an amazing meal and then somehow, stupidly, I threw away the receipt for a lunch that is reimbursable. The manager on duty, Drake, stopped when he was doing once the restaurant slowed and the place was immaculate and immediately researched how to reprint my receipt. Whether or not he is successful at that task  he is successful at maintaining this Panda Express

I’ve never had a problem with this location before, but the new female cashier’s attitude lately creates a consistently uncomfortable experience. Nothing overtly rude — just an unnecessary negative vibe at the counter.

I really like Panda Express. Since moving to State College, PA, this franchise has provided disappointing experiences multiple times. If I lived in a bigger city, I would go to another restaurant. On multiple occasions, the store never has the mushroom chicken prepared to go. The store has express in its title, and we always have to wait for food preparation. Change the name to "Panda Waiting All The Time."

formatted_address: 1610 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: The Original Waffle Shop West

reviews.text: Went here with family for the hockey game at Beaver in 2026. I thought the food was very good, the chocolate chip pancakes were great, and the cinnamon roll was amazing, it was really delicious. I also got the steak and eggs. The eggs were good, the steak was ok. Overall I would recommend, can't got wrong!

Went for a birthday breakfast. And the waitress (Haley I believe) brought out a cinnamon roll w/ a candle. Very kind & brought a big smile on his face

Service is always quick. Plus they are great at keeping your coffee filled up

I mean, the food is alright. If there was absolutely no other breakfast places within a hundred miles of here, the I guess it would be the best.

Luckily, there are better places.

The Naked Egg serves a lot of the same kinds of food, but so drastically better. A night and day comparison to here.

Cafe Luna (which is a bit of a drive) is also far better. They serve something called a cheese boat, which is just really great.

Duck Donuts is easily the best donut place in town. (Albeit even Dunkin is better than the waffle shop)

Sheetz is good.

The only reason to eat at the waffle shop is if literally all the other restaurants are closed, or if you live in an echo chambre.

It is not as good as people claim.

It's not even good.

Mediocre at best.

TLDR: Literally no reason to go here; go anywhere else.
Had an excellent Eggs Florentine today! Andrew was a superb server! Always a great experience!

If your server goes by the name Sofia, leave, RUN if you can. She was hostile and short with us during every interaction. My husband begged to go to waffle shop for his birthday and that totally soured the mood. When it came time to pay she gave us the check and HOVERED over us while writing the tip and signing.
