Common courtesy would be to drop the bill off and walk away. The whole vibe was off, I don’t think we stayed more than 30-40 mins and barely ate the food. You can see how terrible the waiter was from the comically huge amount of food placed in what seems to be a cup sized to go box and YES that is two whole pancakes stacked under the potatoes and omelet. Not surprised to see that I’m not the only one who had a bad interaction with Sofia.

Food was fine and nothing special as it’s a breakfast spot, ordered the typical pancakes and eggs.

formatted_address: 1301 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: HiWay Pizza Pub

reviews.text:
I recently moved to State College and this place quickly became my favorite pizzeria in the area.

During my first visit, I ordered a Chicago pizza and it was way better than any pizza I've had in Chicago. This is now my go-to takeout choice.

I've tried all the other pizza types (Neapolitan, Sicilian, Detroit, Stuffed) and love them all too. I can't think of another pizzeria that offers all these pizza types.

I always enjoy ordering takeout from here. The online ordering and parking are incredibly convenient and the staff has always been very attentive and kind.

It was an average meal. Service took a long time, we had to ask for someone to come to the table. I had a calzone which comes with the sauce poured in the middle of the plate; a first for me. When I took half home with me I had to ask for sauce which was an extra charge. Ask for the sauce in a container if you feel you'll be taking some home. The calzone was pretty good. My friend got the chicken cheesesteak with fries and said it was good. The beer they had was flat and not very cold. I had tiramisu for dessert and it was quite good...but not $8 good. Bottom line its a good place to go for very casual Italian food with easy parking but the prices are not in line with the type of atmosphere in my opinion and be sure to question prices and surcharges or you'll be nickled and dimed to death.

Service is  ultra slow today. Place is too packed.

I came in for seconds tonight. Mr. White pizza. After my last Google review the parking lot is full. Inside, outside packed. Nice manifestation.

Excellent food. Excellent service. I enjoyed the Butcher pizza. Thank you animal Spirits and Gary for creating it. Met the lovely grand daughter of the owners. Highly recommended eatery when you are in State College, PA. Enjoy the Penn State football games and delicious eats here.

Went here with some coworkers while at State College. Atmosphere was your normal college sports town bar.  Service was good (nothing out of the ordinary). My salad was good portion nowadays (balsamic was good), and the pasta bowl was slightly smaller than average portion size.  My coworkers liked their pizza and said it was good crust.
My twin brother and I couldn't decide on the flaky  crust, traditional Sicilian, Detroit style, so we bought'em all!

formatted_address: 1400 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Fatema's Kitchen

reviews.text: I’ve been hearing great things about Fatema’s Kitchen since they opened. Finally got the chance to try it out. The before and after photo pretty much says how much I loved their food. Every single bite is fresh, fragrant, and fulfilling. It almost tastes like home to me, even though I grew up in northeast Asia. My stomach is full, my spirit is lifted, my soul is revived. This place is truly a hidden gem.

This was our first time ordering from Fatema’s Kitchen, and the food was absolutely delicious. Mahiche was probably the best I’ve had in the U.S. - tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Rice was fluffy, buttery, and a perfect complement to the dish.
For $21, the Tahchin portion was quite small, mostly rice with very little chicken. It also had a rosewater-like flavor that I personally didn’t enjoy.

The dishes here are SO TASTY! Great food, great service, great people. Small menu but really good favor!

Uploaded the menu here so others can also see. Forgot to take photos cuz the food was too good and ate too fast

The food here is absolutely amazing. I had the saffron lentil rice and the eggplant dip, while my husband had the chicken kebab. All items were freshly prepared, they were highly aromatic, and the taste was amazing. The environment and ambience of the place is very peaceful, which almost adds to the experience of having food here.

If you are in State College, definitely try out Fatema’s Kitchen!

formatted_address: 100 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Tadashi Japanese Restaurant

reviews.text: Love the sushi here!! I got the beef udon here and they give a generous amount of beef. Broth was really good and noodles were the perfect texture. Appetizers were delicious as well, I liked the calamari the best!

I love the vegan food here, especially the tofu bowl and the vegan rolls. The flavors are amazing, and everything tastes fresh and well prepared. The environment is welcoming and comfortable. This was also the place where I had my first sushi—freshly made and absolutely delicious. Highly recommend, especially for vegan options. Being right in front of my department, this is always my go-to spot for food.

The food here is great but we had a served who picked who she is going to serve on time and who should wait longer regardless of arrival time. A difficult server made for a forgettable experience.The spicy tuna salad had a bit too much rice and we were surprised that tea pot was not available.

Tadashi is the real deal—bold flavors, beautifully plated dishes, and a lively, high-energy atmosphere. We went primetime Saturday night around 8PM and had to wait about 30 minutes. The place was packed, wall-to-wall, with a serious buzz in the air. Service was slightly slow but still efficient and friendly. If you’re looking for calm and quiet, this isn’t it. But if you want fire food and a vibe, this place hits.

Flaming Beef Roll
An absolute showpiece. Served still flaming, the thin slices of beef are seared on the outside and wrapped around a warm, creamy roll with avocado and tempura crunch.

Spicy Tuna & Salmon Roll with Tobiko
This one’s a stunner. Inside, spicy tuna and salmon bring the heat; outside, it’s topped with four kinds of tobiko that add color, texture, and just the right pop. Fresh, vibrant, and perfectly balanced—equal parts kick and finesse.

Cucumber with Sesame Sauce
Surprisingly addictive. Crisp spiral-cut cucumber in a sesame-soy blend with a hit of spice, sesame seeds, and seasoning. Cool, refreshing, and full of umami—makes a great palate cleanser or light bite between heavier dishes.

Spring Rolls
Crispy on the outside, hot and savory inside. The wrapper is fried just right—never greasy—and the sweet chili dipping sauce adds a sweet and tangy contrast that works every time. Classic and done well.

Salted Edamame
Classic, fresh, and exactly what you want. Lightly salted, steamed to keep that clean snap, and served warm. Perfect for nibbling while you wait or to reset your taste buds between dishes.

Fried Calamari
Hot, crispy, and packed with flavor. The batter’s seasoned just enough to bring out the peppery notes, and the squid inside is tender—not rubbery. One of the best versions of this dish I’ve had in a long time.

Tadashi is fire across the board. If you’re going on a weekend night, expect a wait and bring your outside voice. But for great sushi, solid portions, and standout flavors, it’s absolutely worth it. We’ll be back—next time, maybe on a quieter night.

I ordered mentaiko udon but got tobiko with a strong kimchi-cheese personality instead. As a mentaiko lover, I felt personally betrayed — wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Japanese cuisine

formatted_address: 125 S Atherton St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Trophy Room

reviews.text: I stayed at the hotel for work this spring, ate w/ colleagues at The Trophy Room for breakfast. These potatoes were amazing & reminded me of a recipe NY daughter was trying. I mentioned it to the server & he so kindly gave me the restaurant's recipe. Tender on the inside, crisp on the edges & outside skin. Amazing! So happy they shared- we had them today- only difference is we made some w/ recipes parmesan & others w/ feta.
You always want to ask for Jay, he's the best chef in there by far. Ask for Lilly, by far the best of the bartenders.
I only review things that are the best that I ever had or the worst. The food and service here is phenomenal. I’d wager some of the most underrated in State College. Try the quesadilla or pear salad.
Food was great!! Service was super friendly!!
Wings and kale Cesar were incredible. Good atmosphere and friendly wait staff.  Selection of draft beer was great.

formatted_address: 320 W Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: POKE & NOODLE BOWL

reviews.text: We were looking for a tofu dish and we found a delicious one. Fresh ingredients and plenty to eat. I'll definitely go back and order this again.

I would have given 5 stars for the food but they did not have Thai basil or cilantro. The pho broth was delicious and the Bánh mì was good. Tried the regular cold cut and one with grilled chicken. Spring rolls (Gỏi cuốn) were good and wrapped tight. Everything is ordered from your table on a smart pad. Read carefully because I ordered extra peanut sauce because I didn’t realize the sauce came with the spring rolls so it was an extra $1.50. I recommend this place.
Had their build-your-own poke bowl. Great portion, amazing taste, all for a pretty economical price (only $11.50). Would totally go for it again soon.

Authentic mochi from Japan! Best mochi I've tried in America! Not too sweet and great flavor. You can tell it's homemade, it doesn't have the uniform factory shape. Tried the coconut and mango. Can't wait to try green tea and strawberry

Ordered the Chicken Pho, Chicken Bahn Mi, and Chicken Spring Roll, and coffee milk tea for take-out. I can only speak on the Chicken dishes so far, but all of my food was wonderful! The woman at the counter preparing the food was also very kind.

The food was wonderful and at a very reasonable price. Each menu item also has an ingredient list for those who may not be familar with certain dishes. Will gladly come again!

formatted_address: Kern Graduate Building, 110 Kern Bldg, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Panera Bread

reviews.text:
I come here 5 days a week, using the my panera app I feel the variety and quality of food here aswell as the comfort of the location makes it well worth while! I average around 10.50 a meal order an entre and drink with sipclub.

This panera does frequently have problems with fast orders, they typically take 20-30 minutes but I have had some days that make it take even longer.

For me though, that is not an issue at all! They offer 2$ credit whenever this happens, since I come here for 2 hours at a time, I always enjoy my food and it’s permanently discounted. Just be cautious ordering if you don’t have much time, or order 10 or so minutes before you plan on coming.

Someone wrote kind messages on the bags one time and that was really nice :D

Nice environment, nice staff, especially Maneva. He's always warm and kind to you, greets you with a smile and ensures you get your things on time and makes you feel better by making you feel welcome. Always appreciate his efforts!

Also, the location is super close to Pattee, so you can always get your morning coffee without being late for class. The staff's polite and keep the place clean.

Be prepared to wait a L O N G time for your food. I've stopped going to this Panera location because I got fed up with placing an advanced order in the app for a particular time and then showing up to find that my order is NEVER ready on time. People at a university have busy schedules and tons of meetings to go to, and this Panera location was actually having a negative impact on my job. I either have to make the decision to get a refund and then not eat and get dizzy with a terrible headache while teaching (I have hypoglycemia), or be late for my next class or meeting. That's a terrible choice a professional should never have to make if a food establishment is run competently. My guess is that the employees at this location just simply do not care because they have a captive audience with limited food options.

Placed order at 7:24pm. I am still waiting on my order 30 mins later. Multiple ppl working not sure why it is taking so long. Other than ppl who ordered AFTER me are getting their orders BEFORE me. I am loosing faith in the Panera chain. Highly disappointed since I have 1 hr to drive home. If I would have known.

It is actually absurd how slow this place is. It is not possible to eat lunch here unless you plan on hanging around for an hour waiting for your food.

They also seem to make a lot of errors with orders. I’m a vegetarian, and they have put meat in my food multiple times, even when I have ordered off the vegetarian menu or specified no meat.

formatted_address: 312 W Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Lupitas Authentic Mexican Food

reviews.text:
Okay this is actually the best Mexican restaurant in State College. Super authentic food and delicious flavours.
If you are an Indian you will love this as this is very similar to home food taste!
Staff is very kind and they have different sauces at the sauce bar.
Vegetarian options available.

Honestly, I'm sure for the college kids, this is a great place to drop in quickly and get a meal. However, for me who was having dinner with a friend and we decided on Mexican, it was highly underwhelming. You place your order at the counter and pay, then go sit down to have them bring it to you. The soft drink system has a handwritten sign for a dollar per refill, but you've already paid. Semi confusing. The meals were brought out on paper plates. Like, great value brand. All the condiments are self serve in this crammed thing, where the sauces all drop into the others as your filling the smallest condiment cups on earth. I asked for chips and salsa and got chips - no salsa. I paid for a quality meal but was disappointed.

Where do I begin ... in short, you will not be disappointed if you are looking for something that feels authentic! Loved their selection of sauces, the meat was spiced perfectly, and the masa / tortillas were delicious. We took the food back to the hotel and it was just a good as eating in the restaurant.

I’ve loved Lupita’s since they first opened years ago! Consistently delicious food, good portions, great prices. They are family-owned and it shows - always friendly and part of the community. We are moving and I will miss their tacos so much!!! I know I will make a special stop at Lupita’s whenever I’m in town ❤️ thanks for all the yummy food and smiles!!

When I need something tasty, filling and full of flavor, I walk myself down to Lupita’s. My go-to order is either the carnitas king quesadilla or carnitas tacos. It wouldn't be true joy if you didn't consume your plate full of happiness with horchata or a crisp Diet Coke.

Lupita’s is the best Mexican restaurant in downtown State College - so good I wrote a blog about it for The Daily Collegian. If you eat anywhere, eat here.

formatted_address: 224 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Chill Out Hookah Lounge

reviews.text:
A truly authentic place with delicious made-to-order homemade comfort food and exceptional service matching the ultimate dining experience!

As the Penn State’s international student of an European and Western / Central Asian background, I go there for food and have teas and coffees you cannot find anywhere in town. It is BYOB-friendly too.

Although I am a non-smoker, this hookah eatery’s vent system is so well designed it effectively protects me from exposure let alone any smoke odor!

I grew up in the area; many years ago I used to frequent the Hookah lounge that previously was established in this space with my friends.  Formally known as Chronic Town, I am here to say that Chill Out Hookah Lounge has improved upon quality and service tremendously.  The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable; the staff were friendly and helpful. They allowed me to smell the different Shisha Tobacco blends before deciding on which one I wanted to smoke. They gave me and my friend free water to sip on as well.  Most importantly, the hookah experience was fantastic.  The units they have are all very nicely taken care of and of high quality.  We purchased ice for our hookah and we got a freeze hose along with it.  The staff routinely replaced our coals, brought us a fresh cold hose every so often and we didn’t have to ask.  It’s BYOB, there are games to play, multiple TVs to watch and they have a pretty extensive menu to order food from.  I had a great experience, thank you for the great service!
Excellent food and service!! Everything was delicious. Definitely will be returning and highly recommend checking out.

Me and my fiancée were here on vacation, we stopped here and it was such an amazing vibe. The employee was very friendly and offered us the top flavors, let us smell them. It was dead when we went so it was very relaxing. We didn’t get food here, but while we were leaving the employee came over and gave us juice on the house. We loved this place so much we came back again a few hours later to do another session. We tried two new flavors mixed together, which was fantastic might I add. Then when we left again for the night, the employee gave us some free food to take back with us. I wish I lived closer to here, this would 100% be a regular hangout spot.
Very fun place to go still. Theme change but now is a bit more open inside.

formatted_address: Mateer, 201 Mateer Building, University Park, PA 16802, USA
name: Cafe Laura

reviews.text: I reserved a dinner here. Entree is good quality. Appetizers are good try. Service has room for improvement. I understand that. It's student training.

This is unquestionably the best dining option in state college, especially if you are thinking in terms of value and quality. There’s no competition.  I had a shrimp appetizer with perfectly cooked shrimp; fully cooked yet still tender, without a hint of chewiness. If you cook you know that there is a very small window between under and over cooked shrimp, and these nailed it.
My salad was fresh and well balanced. In particular, the walnuts on the salad were fresh and tasty. Nuts are often taken for granted and walnuts in particular can quickly taste a little rancid or stale. These were fresh and nutty and balanced the nicely crumbled blue cheese and fresh, crisp apple slices among the lettuce. Just the right balance.
For dinner I had a strip steak, cooked medium. It was local PSU farmed beef, so well raised and fresh.  It was perfectly seasoned as it was cooked, with herb butter topping. So savory and delicious. It literally made my mouth tingle. I believe the steak was sous vide cooked and then seared. I normally dislike this style of cooking because it changes the texture of the meat to the extent that it feels unnaturally soft in the mouth. In this case, the searing added texture back to the meat, which saved it.  I was very pleased.  The steak was accompanied by mashed potatoes that were remarkably flavorful and rich. They tasted Ike they might have been made with some chicken stock, yet the taste of the fresh potatoes was not buried. The vegetable was broccoli rabe, which can be tough and bitter, or over cooked, but this was neither. It was fresh, flavorful and cooked perfectly. The stalk was still a bit crunchy while the florets were not mushy and still retained their texture. The steak was served atop both of the sides, allowing the herb butter topping season them both as it melted.
For desert I had their version of traditional grilled sticky buns with Berkeley Creamery vanilla, which was nice but unremarkable.  I accompanied it with surprisingly good coffee.
My wife had pea soup, the same salad and salmon with the same sides. She said the salmon was similarly perfectly cooked.
What made this an exemplary dining experience was the fact that every course of the meal was done well and was as good or better than I’ve enjoyed in restaurants charging 3 times the price. Literally. Our combined check was less than $100, which is simply amazing for the quality. Amazing and wonderful. Take all of this and realize that the meal was prepared and presented by students and it’s simply astounding!  Bring a bottle of your favorite wine (even the wine glasses were of high quality) and enjoy a wonderful evening!
Only opens for few hours, but extremely good food and service, with perfect pricing. Menu changes every day, and I love the surprises.

This was my first visit to the Cafe. I was more than a little disappointed in the quality of my food as well as the service. I ordered calamari ($8) as an appetizer, which was very good, however, my entree (veal Marsala ($22), was chewy and bland. Our bread was served cold and the oil that accompanied it had an over abundance of rosemary. When my appetizer was served, the waiter served it from the other end of the table and reached across the person beside me saying “Pardon my reach.”
When the floor manager addressed our dining table, his introduction began with, “How are you guys doing tonight?” We were a table of mature women, not “guys!” In addition, our server couldn’t remember who ordered what and seemed to forget about us when it was time to pay our bill. Finally, I would NOT have left an 18% tip!
Great place for lunch , pub like atmosphere, great bar food

formatted_address: 208 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Big Dean's Hot Chicken

reviews.text: The quality of food is wonderful. I think one of the best in state college. It is very much comparable to Dave's. The toilets were not clean, it was less lit in general, and seating is not comfortable. There is no issue with the food! Overall, for the price, I think they are doing a phenomenal job. Good luck Big D's fam. I hope to see you grow in PA, and beyond.

I unfortunately did not have a good experience at Big Deans, and I have a laundry list with it. Let’s start with manner and human decency. Since we came in at 8:40, we all got looked at as if we had ten  heads. The anger was written all over their faces. After waiting for the food for roughly 15 minutes, we were essentially pushed out since they really needed to close as soon as possible, for whatever reason. Now moving forward to the food, I’m not sure if you’ve cleaned your fryer recently, but it tasted like the oil was three months old. After having one tender, I felt sick to my stomach, feeling like a pit had entered my stomach. I am truly disappointed and disgusted by the way we were treated, and their lack of food quality. Don’t waste your time going here, unless you’re seeking a “good” attitude.

The chicken is over cooked which makes it tough. Nothing worse than biting into a tough piece of chicken that immediately makes you want to spit it out. Fries.. meh. Nobody likes crinkle cut, change to waffle or curly. Cheese sauce should come on the side. Sauces are good but the first bite of the chicken I had was so tough I almost didn’t go back in for another bite. I was brave enough to go back in and on my 3rd tender I was met again with a tough chewy tender and I proceeded to spit and throw the rest away.

This was our first visit, and we will definitely return! We were not greeted upon arrival, so we opted to order from self-serve kiosks. We had to get the lone employee's attention to request cups for fountain drinks. The location was clean and well-maintained, but the music was uncomfortably loud. The food was served very hot and fresh, and our order was mostly accurate (they switched my plain fries with my husband's cheese fries). The chicken was markedly moist and easily identifiable as real meat. The breading was light and flavorful on the tenders I ordered, and it was not excessively greasy. The bbq sauce served with the tenders was very good. My husband had a buffalo chicken sandwich that was evenly sauced and tasty. Overall, this was an enjoyable visit, and we look forward to trying additional menu items.

Big Dean’s Hot Chicken is my favorite restaurant in state college, largely due to supervisor Joel. Every time I visit and he’s working, a smile crosses my face. He’s so approachable and always quick to help when I need anything, his service is impeccable. Thank you Big Dean’s for employing such kind staff, my experience is always amazing. The only thing better than the chicken at this restaurant is the employees and service. 10/10 chicken, 10/10 service!

formatted_address: 225 W Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Susie's Tacos

reviews.text: Absolutely delicious tacos.  The 3 for  $12 with a pop is the perfect lunch. My taste buds craved more, but the stomach was happy.  I just discovered this gem and will now make it a regular stop.
Excellent burritos and tacos, probably the best in town. Way more authentic too. Don’t be fooled by the bagely exterior, these folks know what they are doing.
Amazing street tacos and Taylor swift music. FYI, it is inside Bagel Crust.
Service was great. food was blah save your time and money go someplace else.
Always quick and helpful, quality food...my go-to breakfast sandwich place

formatted_address: 225 W Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Bagel Crust

reviews.text:
✨ Local Gem (new fave bagel spot)✨

Such a great experience! Sweet, helpful staff, smoothies made with fresh fruit, and delicious bagels

Now that I make bagels at home, I have come to appreciate a good bagel more. These were fluffy with a great crunch outer shell (ideal bagel texture)!

What we got:
⭐️ Everything with sausage, egg and cheese
⭐️ Everything with bacon, egg and cheese
⭐️ Everything with butter
⭐️ Asiago cheese with cream cheese
⭐️ Mango smoothie with banana and orange juice (a little watery)

We visited during move-in week and the line was understandably long (to the door). We were able to order within 10 minutes and the food came out less than 10 min later!

Ratings with my family were 9/10 bagels (compared to the 6/10 they gave Irving’s). We would have had better pictures but everyone was so excited to eat

Will be back for move out ✨

Wonderful local bagel, coffee,  and tacos restaurant has just what you need to get the day started, no matter how rough the morning.

Try the everything bagel, and the omelet

Susana was super helpful and understanding with my food allergies, custom orders, and many questions.

She didn't balk at my request for a "room temperature " latte, nor the almond milk, nor the stevia. Or the request for more stevia.

There is an option to build a custom omelet: eggs, bacon, tomatoes, onion, spinach, and fresh avocado slices. Served with potatoes and a bagel of your choice.

Se habla español, también.

It’s a very well known breakfast place in the town. The skinny lady sandwich is a good choice for vegetarians. The staff members were friendly and helpful. But there might be a crowd during the mornings of a weekend.

Nothing like a bagel sandwich shop tucked into downtown State College.
Even though the macaroni salad was from a grocery chain, the bagel sandwich made up for it. So good! Ignore the 3 yr old reviews from the darker days of covid and hit this place up for lunch!
My sandwich was good and prepared on time. I ordered carry out online so I barely interacted with the staff but they seemed friendly.

formatted_address: 313 W Foster Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Fuego Grill

reviews.text: Such an authentic food truck. The service is so great and they are such friendly and personable people. I have tried many of their menu items, the Birria Tacos have been my favorite so far, my goal is to try everything on the menu. I recommend if you are looking for an authentic experience and a bite that will leave you wanting more!

Everything I have tried from this place has been amazing. Best birria and churros I have had in my life. I’ve gotten to know the staff and they are all so sweet. The best hidden gem in state college!!!!!!!

Amazing food, loved it. Have already visited them 3 times in last 2 days to try all of their menu. Do get their Chicken Quesadilla and Chicken Burrito and do not forget to ask for their green hot sauce with it

The food is sooooo good! Everything was fresh and flavorful. I stopped eating to make this review because everyone needed to hear about this place IMMEDIATELY!!!Not to mention the ladies working were so sweet. 1000/10. im visiting from out of town and wish i could take this place with me!

Delicious food and friendly service. We had the Fuego bowls, empanada, and churros. Everything was excellent and affordable. We had to wait a little for our food but that's a small price to pay for food that is made fresh. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 313 W Foster Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Coffee Hemp & Tea

reviews.text: I wish I could give this place 20 stars!!! Best coffee I've ever had; they have such a unique and phenomenal drink menu and the food is awesome, too! I had the strawberry cheesecake coffee. They really went above and beyond to create a warm and welcoming atmosphere, including a phone charger available for patrons, books to read, jigsaw puzzles to work on, and fantastic customer service! You have to stop in and see the most adorable decorative crochet coffee cup plushies. Climate controlled and indoor and outdoor seating. Super reasonable prices. Definitely a gem you can't afford to pass up!

I always look for such cozy and homely place to drink tea or coffee. They have both inside and outside seating arrangement. Loved talking and watching the owner making tea and coffee for us. Those who are from Bangladesh or India, should come here for desi cha!! This month old tea and coffee shop is also an awesome place for buying dried stevia leaves and many more harbs.

This morning I finally tried this place after seeing it pop up behind my apartment and I wish I had discovered it weeks ago. The flavor options are so unique AND delicious. The care with which my coffee was made was such an awesome way to start my day. I got the strawberry shortcake ice coffee and it was delicious. The coffee was so good and the homemade syrups were just the cherry on top. Everyone needs to know about this place!!

This is my new favorite spot in State College. The drinks and pastries are delicious. We were helped by a lovely employee who not only provided great recommendations but made us feel warm and welcome on our first visit! I encourage everyone to drop in and try the passion fruit tea!

My new favorite coffee shop in town! With an expansive menu sure to please coffee and tea drinkers of every stripe, extremely pleasant and friendly service, and a downright cozy location and atmosphere, everything about CH&T is great. Make sure you try their rotating special drinks, which bring a lot of fun and flair to the menu!

formatted_address: 109 S Fraser St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Benny Leone's Pizza

reviews.text:
(Updated review) downgrading a couple stars after a few more visits here. The flavor is just not there. Sauce has no flavor and barely there, and the cheese isn’t doing much for it, strong Parmesan or cheddar flavor? I don’t know, all I know is since it initially opened, it hasn’t been nearly as good. Would rather do one of the other local pizza shops that at least have some flavor.

(Initial review)What an awesome spot downtown! There are plenty of pizza shops in the area, but this one is it! Huge slices with the perfect crunch in each bite. No floppy, soggy pizza here. Super flavorful and awesome for an easy slice on the go. The guys working in the shop are friendly and welcoming, and you can tell they’re having fun and take pride in what they do. Will definitely be our go to pizza shop from now on!

Some of the biggest slices and pies I've seen in a while, ideal for college students in the area. No frills limited items menu, works well and tastes great. Better value for money than other popular pizza places in the area. Polite patient staff.
The pizza slice are huge. I tried the mushroom garlic and cheese pizza and both were bomb. Very delicious open till 1am perfect for late night snack.

Humongous slices of great pizza, could barely finish my piece. Great value for your money. Very busy around night and difficult to find seating but great atmosphere. Nice area with lots of restaurants, stores, and parking garages nearby. No bathroom, but hand sanitizer is provided though. Slices are around $6, but are a full meal by itself.
Biggest piece of pizza you can find in centre county. Super small store, but that's the point! Be prepared for a big box if you get a big box. Not much seating, so it's best for pick-up.

formatted_address: 132 W College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Snap Custom Pizza

reviews.text: Fresh made pizza! The place was pretty busy, but they were efficient taking and making orders quickly. We really enjoyed our pizza and would visit again!

I bought a pepperoni pizza added a tip and I received a pizza that was luke warm. It was super floppy and extremely greasy. It was almost like when a pizza that is frozen is heated up in a microwave. Ive had frozen pizzas from target that were better than what I had received. The taste was also very bland. I certainly won’t be going back.
Pretty good pizzas for a pretty good price. Hard to find seats during the semester when the students are here. The staff members are friendly.

With the crispy crust, flavorful sauce, and fresh toppings, every bite is satisfying. The service is quick and friendly, making it a great spot for a casual meal. Whether you’re grabbing a slice or ordering a whole pizza, this place consistently delivers delicious, high-quality stuff.

Excellent pizza in State College.  It's prepared immediately after ordering with fresh ingredients.  I had the margharita which was tasty, with just the right amount of olive oil and garlic.  Not overwhelming or greasy.  Only minor issue was that I would've liked the crust to be a bit more crunchy.  Service was super friendly and efficient  in a clean environment.  Definitely recommend.

formatted_address: 129 S Fraser St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Juana's Venezuelan Cuisine

reviews.text: Why isn’t this place open later than 3pm? It’s amazing. The food is perfect - we had a bowl, a criollo, and tried two of the pastelitos. All delicious. I am so full I need a nap.

Service is always friendly and patient, food always hits, portions are great, and has a nice cozy vibe inside. I got the Reina Pepiada veggie plate (Chicken salad with avocado), Arepas, & Tamarindo drink, all really nice and refreshing on a warmer day.

Everything is good though, I love that their dishes are fresh and flavorful without being greasy. Highly recommend!!

Beautiful and cozy place, the women were very welcoming & made me feel at home.

The food was delicious, I definitely recommend this spot.

Stopped in for lunch on Saturday between We Are weekend events. Have always wanted to try but hours are a bit inconvenient for us.

The arepas are delicious. They’re way bigger than we’ve had at other restaurants before. Wife and I split two Pabellon arepas, one pork and one chicken (they didn’t have the beef today). The combo of the stewed meat, queso fresco, and black beans was fantastic, and I loved finding the sweet plantain chunks in it. Like I said, HUGE. They also came out piping hot and almost impossible to try to pick up as a sandwich. Probably why there’s a knife and fork provided with each.

One daughter inhaled the Catira arepa, which is their chicken and cheddar cheese. Other daughter similarly inhaled the Cachapa with chicken, which is kinda like a chicken and cheese quesadilla. They thoroughly enjoyed them!

Definitely recommend. It is a small place, only a couple tables. We were the only customers while we were there, but it’s also the offseason. I presume they do a strong takeout business.

What a gem of a place!!! Love the atmosphere and the food. The lady at the counter was patient and friendly and helped me selecting my food. It was my first time having Venezuelan food and enjoyed it. Will be back again.

formatted_address: 127 W Beaver Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Penn Pide Halal Brothers

reviews.text: We ordered the lamb pide and chicken pide, unfortunately, both were very disappointing. The flavors were bland, and the texture just wasn’t right. Honestly, it was the worst pide I’ve ever had. On top of that, the restaurant was extremely hot and humid inside, which made the whole experience uncomfortable. Not sure if the AC was working or if they even have one. Would not recommend.

Great mom and pop shop serving authentic Mediterranean food. The The baklava was so delicious and warm. The “pizza” is light and tasty as well, it won’t weight you down because there’s no cheese. It looks wide but you can finish it no problem I bet. I want to get their grape leaves next. But yeah come on over to get your Fill of culture

AWESOME!!!! Easily the best Middle Eastern food in State College. Lamb is wonderful, so is the chicken, and their Pide's are off the hook... Really nice guys in there as well. Thanks for making awesome food 😁.
Good halal option at Campus. Need to improve with customer friendliness. Seating is uncomfortable in summer without AC and kitchen heat. The food tastes very nice. Worth the trip!

Well, it's been a few times now that I have been to this place for some desi food. Tried their lamb over rice, shrimp over rice, biryani and gyro over pita (last night) which is completely amazing. I recommend trying their biryani and lamb over rice, true to the spices and taste and the serving size is great.
In my opinion, price to quantity and quality both are 8.5/10 considering all other options in State College!

formatted_address: 128 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Allen Street Pizza

reviews.text: Tried this place because my family recommended it — big mistake. I ordered the Chicken Tikka Pizza, and what I got was plain grilled chicken with green peppers and onions. No tikka, no masala, no flavor — just false advertising. When I called, they said, “That’s how we make it.” Really? Since when does “chicken tikka” mean “whatever’s lying around”? Total joke. Save your money — this place sells names, not flavors.

I was at State college with my family for a couple of weeks, and Allen street pizza was our go-to for lunch, sometimes brunch or dinner. Hardly did a day pass without us eating from there. The staffs are warm and welcoming. The food tastes really good and the restaurant is neat👌
Best pizza place! The nicest people and gave us free food at the end!! Food is delicious.
HREAT PIZZA GREAT WORKERS!!! AWESOME OWNER
Incredible restaurant. Immediately felt like family. The funnel fries were incredible. Can even get a good rhythm going with the music

formatted_address: 124 S Allen St, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sauly Boy's

reviews.text: Overall for a burger place, Sauly Boys offers a very tasty burger (similar to a five guys) with their unique special sauce. The burger was perfectly cooked and nice and soft.  Their special sauce tasted like a mix of ketchup and mayo with a bit of pickle juice mixture.  It was good.  The fries are great too and none were overcooked.  We also had a chicken sandwich which was good too. The strawberry milk shake was well made too and tasted great. Pricing was a bit high, but you are paying for the freshness of the meal and quality.

Came here for dinner one night while downtown. This place has a surprisingly good gluten free burger! I got a classic grilled cheese and it was delicious. My girlfriend got a burger with gluten free bun and she loved it. When ordering, they did have to check and make sure there were will gluten-free buns in the kitchen, so just a heads up!

Great burger, I wish the meat was little more, and the burger was slightly bigger! The service was fast, and plenty of seating space. I liked the taste of sauce and big lettuce on it. The fires were crispy. Overall great experience indeed.
The price was reasonable for the meal set that came with fries and a drink. This place gives you the option to change to a plant based patty for 2 dollars extra. The food was delicious.

Great little place to visit in State College.  Greeting was very warm and friendly.  First time here but they welcomed us like old friends.  Everyone enjoyed their meal and we loved the special sauce.  We had grilled chicken sandwich, chicken tenders, burgers and fries.  Fries were absolutely perfect.  Our family would definitely return when in the area.

formatted_address: 128 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Chick 2

reviews.text: Holy goated restaurant. Not once have I come in and gotten anything below 5-star quality. Boss man is always ready to hook us up with amazing food for a goated price. The absolute lifeblood of college avenue. My absolute king.
Food was fire, service was great, and the price was goated. $7-10  for a descent size portion is a really good deal. Some places charge way to much

Best food I’ve ever eaten, absolutely delicious every time I go. Everything on the menu is amazing and always tasty. The chef is the goat. If you’re thinking about coming here, just do it. You won’t regret it at all.

This amazing place is open from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM. The owner is cooking some of the most amazing dishes in the most unassuming location. He's a chef, the spicy tofu is one of the best plates you will ever eat. Be nice, listen 👂 to the owner, eat it the way he tells you and enjoy. Order at least $10 of food and enjoy.

This is the unmatched chicken and rice champion in State College. The only store I frequent weekly. Freshly cooked chicken and 3 complimentary, homemade sauces for 8$. Whole foods, not sugar-y. If you want great, quality meals downtown, you will not believe your eyes.

formatted_address: 134 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Dagu Rice Noodle 大鼓米线

reviews.text: On two visits I had the pickled cabbage fish soup and beef rice noodles. Both were delicious, served hot and with a great presentation. The hostess was personable and attentive! I can't wait to return.
Great food! Especially during the winter, the rice noodle soup is so good!

First of all, let it be known that they give cans of soda for 5-Star reviews, so be aware that a lot of these reviews might be for that promotion.
That being said, I enjoyed the food. The presentation and portion size are all great.
It should also be said that the restaurant is relatively small and not designed to take groups. The place closes at 8:30, and the whole time I was there, the only music played was from Taylor Swift.

Love the tomato rice noodle! Idk why many ppl think the service is bad. i come here 3 times a week with friends and everytime the server is very friendly. That being said, u do have to order through qr code. But their food is very good so i dont think that is a problem.

What kind of place is this even? How did it get such high ratings? First off, the waitstaff's attitude is absolutely terrible—itWhat kind of place is this even? How's the snootiest service I've ever seen did it get such high ratings? First off, in State College. The rice noodles had barely any the servers' attitudes are absolutely terrible—it's meat in them, and that QR code thing on the snootiest service I've ever seen in the table was just weird. It ended up charging State College. The rice noodles had barely any meat our table for tips twice, which was super confusing in them, and that weird QR code thing on. Definitely not going back there again. the table got our table charged twice for tips. Super confusing stuff. Definitely not going back there again.

formatted_address: 482 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Playa Bowls

reviews.text: every time my boyfriend and I come in here The staff is so judgmental and rude. I noticed that when we do decide to tip, they give our bowls a big filling, but whenever we do not tip, they give us 90% granola and only 10% of the base. Usually, I don't say anything, but today I did nicely. and they all just stared at me like I was crazy and gave me judgmental rude looks. when we ordered, the girl didn't even speak to us and as soon as we paid, she just walked away without saying anything. there was at least eight girls working, and only one other person in the store  and only one of the girls responded to me and scooped some more of the base into a bowl and gave it to me. Unfortunate because their food is so good. But the staff is all a bunch of college mean girls.

The girls working behind the counter were very attentive to our questions and us wanting to sample different things. They explained all of their options in detail and made it very easy to make a choice. The bulls were absolutely amazing!

Heard about this place back in VA, but was in PA for business and was needing something post workout!! Can’t recall the young lady’s name that was sooo patient with all my questions… but i decided on the Green bowl with a few modifications!! Absolutely delicious, 2nd time I tired the 1/2 Açaí and green… was a little too sweet for me, but tasty nonetheless!

Cute little place with delicious, refreshing bowls. I love getting these when I want something light but filling for lunch. I've had many different bowls that were all amazing and if you don't like any off the menu you can always make a custom bowl!

first time trying any açaí bowl and I loved it!

The employee at the register was super helpful and patient, and answered all my questions! I even got to sample the açaí and pitaya bases. Açaí is definitely on the sweeter side while pitaya is less sweet. I’m a huge fan of their açaí base!
The decorations inside are so cute! They have plenty of seating and some fun board games too! There’s outdoor seating available as well. The bowls were ready quickly. They are still being very careful with covid guidelines.
They will also have poke bowls during the school year! I’m looking forward to coming back here soon 😋

formatted_address: 480 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Big Chicken

reviews.text:
Tried Big Chicken and got the 5 tenders combo with fries, two sauces, and a regular fountain drink — total came to $19.06. The tenders were crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and tasted fresh. The sauces added a lot of variety, and it didn’t feel like basic fast-food chicken.

Fries were solid and the portion size felt fair overall. The restaurant itself was clean, modern, and had a relaxed atmosphere, which made it a nice place to sit down and eat instead of just grabbing food and leaving.

Price is a little higher and drinks are a bit small compared to typical fast food, but the quality and experience make it feel more like fast-casual. Definitely worth trying if you’re in State College and want something different from the usual fast food environment overall 4/5

I understand that they just opened, but they’ll be closed in five or take 5 months. They don’t accept their own gift cards and the food is astonishingly mid tier. It’s like option C when there’s a Canes right down the road. It’s really over priced, decorated like they’re not ready to stay long term and they’re not really ready for operation yet. Save your time and eat at any other place with chicken. It’ll be cheaper, taste better, and they’ll be there in a few months when you want to go back.

Despite what people say it's small. It's hard to get around people but it's totally worth it. They were out of Mac and it was a shame but I made do and it was awesome. The fries don't get soggy and the buns are big and soft. Absolute game changer in the chicken space in town and honestly for the price range there's nothing like it here. Every star. I hope Big Chicken stays around.

I was really looking forward to this place, and I rarely write reviews these days, but I need to warn you. The chicken was dry and flavorless. Could have been redeemed by the sauce, but the “Shaq attack” chicken I ordered which was supposed to have bbq sauce had none.

The other cup of sauce I was given with my order was half full.

My drink was fine, but my friend asked for a water and was given a tiny cup and made to use the water fountain, which one week in, does not have enough water pressure to fill the cup of water.

If you want good Nashville hot chicken walk a few more blocks down, we have an authentic Nashville chicken small business here already that cook on demand instead of batching/reheating chicken

The silver lining was the staff. They were friendly, knowledgeable, and generally just fine to interact with.

I can’t recommend you go here.

I was excited to try this place....​it was fine, a bit of a letdown.

The sandwich was big, but the chicken was a bit dry. The fries were okay, though they could have been crispier.

The meal didn't include a drink, and nobody let me know that beforehand. I had to place a separate order, which was a bit obnoxios. At a place like this, a drink being included is the expectation.

​I probably won't be back.

formatted_address: 454 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Pho Mi Now

reviews.text:
I usually get it for dinner but have gotten it for brunch and lunch before. Even since it has been added I have been eating it for 6 days in a row. It’s very filling especially with the delicious broth with the plethora of meats after a long study session for finals. I have been getting the Pho Super Bowl which includes this huge bone with delicious meat, brisket, beef balls, and sliced beef, I highly recommend!!

There really aren’t a lot of pho options at state college, so you gotta try it here. I constantly bring my friends with me to try it and they love it too! It’s a great meal anytime of the day. It’s also convenient for takeout as everything is separated and as the weather gets colder I use the broth cup as a hand warmer. Try it out sometime!
One of the best places in town to get pho! And it’s always a great place to hang out with friends and enjoy yummy snacks and boba.

This is my first time ever trying Pho and it was delicious!! The way the meat just melted in my mouth with a burst umami flavors was so exciting! Highly recommend anyone if you’re interested in getting something flavorful and cheap
Absolutely AMAZING Pho!!!! 10 out of 10 recommend!!!!! We’re coming back Pho sure!!

Food is perfect! And the strawberry teas as well
Great place to sit and eat while in state college

formatted_address: 454 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Teadori

reviews.text: I tried the strawberry matcha. It was delicious, though the strawberry layer wasn’t as visible as in the pictures. The place is nice, and I’ll definitely come back to try it again and explore other flavors.

Teadori is a fun mix of tea shop, a quick bite to eat and great place to chill with friends. The owner and his mom run this place well. Kind, welcoming, authentic. The Pho was outstanding. We really appreciated the time to sit and play games after lunch. A perfect spot to meet your Penn State student for lunch!

The pho and the curry were both absolutely delicious — rich in flavor, well-seasoned, and clearly made with care. The broth in particular was excellent, and the curry had great depth and balance.

However, the prices are simply too high for what you get. In my opinion, the dishes would be reasonably priced at about half of their current cost. Because of that, despite enjoying the food, I don’t think I will be coming back.
Pho is great!! The cheese foam tea and chicken katsu have the exact same taste in Taiwan. So gooood 🤩🤩 staff are friendly too! Thank you ❤️❤️❤️

This place is great! I stopped here for takeout while visiting my bf. The boba is really good, the Chocolate Milk Tea being the best one out of the three we ordered. The Beef Pho is super fresh, amazing flavor, and was a great portion size! The perfect food spot for an introvert, you order on a tablet, and staff places your items in the pick up area! Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 421 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Cafe Alina

reviews.text:
We were just passing through State College and read that this little hidden gem had the best Indian/Pakistan food in area. Parking was a nightmare but once we got into the restaurant we were greeted warmly
The food was absolutely amazing! The best I have eaten in a long time! I had the lamb kabob bowl (I requested not spicy) it was prepared exactly to my liking, My husband had the chicken changa and he said it was excellent also. I highly recommend this restaurant if you have a craving for fresh never frozen Indian food

As always, the food was great and vibes were immaculate. The owner is very thoughtful and you can tell by this that a lot of passion goes into the food. It’s food, vibes and late night open hours make this a perfect place for students

A Wonderful Taste of Home!

The staff at Cafe Alina are incredibly friendly and always make you feel welcome. The food is consistently delicious and high-quality, and the prices are very reasonable. For us, it's the only place in State College where we can get a true taste of home—the Indian dishes are wonderfully authentic and taste just like they were made back home. We are so grateful to have this gem in town. Highly recommended!
We were traveling to New York for the holidays and needed to stop by for lunch so found this gem . Owner is so warm accommodating. Food is really delicious. We left with happy tummy happy heart .

Good quality food that tasted like home cooked. We had Biryani, Butter Paneer, Naan and Chai. Everything tasted delicious.
The only shortcoming we found was the smell. The table was cleaned with the most stinkiest rag that I was about to puke 🤢🤢🤢 We had to change our table. Bathroom was smelly, too.

formatted_address: 434 E College Ave, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Mosul Grill

reviews.text:
Great food and portion size. We ordered Lamb Pide and Lamb Shish Wrap. Delicious. We had to wait about 30 minutes but you can order in advance. Keep in mind that prices were adjusted and do not match those listed. Planning to come back, order in advance and try the Lamb chop (it looks awesome)
Update: I came back and tried Lamb over rice, delicious and tender! faster service.

Great food, the best middle eastern food in State College for me! I loved every dish and it truly felt authentic. The hummus and the falafel were one of the best I had in a long time (highly recommend both! And If you like eggplants, babaganoush too it's great). Together with the two sauces, the owner brought us fresh made flatbread for dipping. Everything was fresh made, honestly a 10 out of 10 experience.
The portions are very big but I'm not sad about bringing the food home to eat it again! Thank you for your food. We'll be back again!

This is the best middle eastern food in state college and it isn't even a little bit close.

Everything was made fresh and came out hot. Amazing flavours. We got a chicken leg plate and a lamb shish plate, both were phenomenal. Also got falafel, babaganoush, and a hummus starter which came with fresh made bread (10/10)

Everything we ordered was amazing, and I doubt we just got lucky with our order. Probably everything on the menu is great.

Support local businesses!!!

This was a great chance found by accident when I wasn’t looking. Was on my way to a restaurant that was closed when I ran into a group that recommended this place for me. So I paid a visit and it was a great pleasure. Although, wasn’t a typical restaurant atmosphere, where you sit on a table while someone serves you, instead you order at the counter and be called when your food is ready.
Honestly, I understand estimated the quantity, so I ordered something else on the side. Then, OMG when the food was ready, I was surprised by the size of it.
The lamb chops were super tender and flavorful. Along the rice and soup. The quality of food is very fresh and delicious. You can tell it’s homemade with love and care.
While I’m in the area, will definitely revisit again and experience another plate or two.
The area is a downtown, so parking is somewhat hard but above all, it’s worth it.

What a gem! Great menu and generous portions, even by Central PA standards. Brought friends and had dolma, chicken kebab, and both spinach and eggplant pide. Good lord, what a jam — I hope to come back 1,000 times.

formatted_address: 417 E Calder Way, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Penn State Halal Guys

reviews.text: The food is delicious! The rice is seasoned perfectly. I love the lamb & chicken combo. The lamb is always so tender. The white sauce & hot sauce together is bomb. This is enough to feed 2 people depending on how hungry you are. Very decently priced. $12 for this plate! It is down Calder way sort of like an ally and back in a little shopping area. Highly recommend!

A Pakistani guy was selling authentic halal food - really tasty and reasonably priced. Lots of options (chicken or lamb), with rice and fries. I was in State College for a day, tried it for dinner, and I’d definitely recommend it.

So from the perspective of a Lebanese woman: Life changing Halal truck for Middle Easterners in State college!! I’m from Detroit with family in Dearborn and I haven’t found any food out here that can compare to the amazing dishes I eat back home and make myself. UNTIL NOW! This is the best Halal Truck EVER!! The one on Pugh street is a scammin sham compared to these guys!! They’re tucked in a space on Calder by Cafe Alina and I assure you, you will not regret it. The lamb melts in your mouth, the chicken is so savory, fish is phenomenal, the white sauce is ON POINT, and they make their own homemade hot sauce!! And they’re so nice!! I found this place about a week and a half ago and have been there about seven times since 😂 Please check them out!!
Seriously. Better than penn kabob, penn pide, totally blows pita cabana out the water, and makes the other trucks look like a joke. I know my Arab food 🤪
Really great halal cart gyro. Feels and tastes just like I’m in NYC.
Food was fantastic. Service was great. The chicken and lamb combo is one of the best things I've eaten in State College. Absolutely will be a repeat customer.

formatted_address: 421 E Beaver Ave G1B, State College, PA 16801, USA
name: Sowers Harvest Café

reviews.text: I really like this place. The coffee is excellent, and their breakfast and lunch options are great too. The staff is always cheerful and the place is usually packed, which adds to the energy. The only challenge is finding a seat because it gets so busy.

We had an excellent lunch at Sowers Harvest. If you’re looking for a fresh and healthier alternative, this is the spot. Our sandwiches were great and we will be back to try other menu items in the future. Cute and cozy aesthetic with a friendly staff.

Their signature mocha was rich, creamy, and the perfect amount of sweetness. The whipped cream on top was cold. It had the perfect balance of hot and cold. It came with the cutest little spoon. I also had the avocado toast, it appeared to just have avocado, and feta, and salt. It was simple and delicious.

One of the best hidden gems in State College.  Amazing customer service is matched with their equally amazing food.  You've gotta try the pretzels of course but my personal favorite is the Chipotle chicken bacon ranch panini.
The cutest little cafe!! Indoor and outdoor seating! The Fruit French Toast is amazing! Love the seasonal drinks - peppermint hot chocolate and the cocoa dusted mint latte!!

name: Bistrozine

reviews.text:
Tried desserts at Bistrozine and was really impressed. We ordered two chocolate-based desserts, and both were well executed and nicely presented.

One of them was a warm chocolate lava–style cake served with matcha ice cream and whipped cream. The cake was rich and dense without being overly sweet, and the pistachio ice cream added a nice contrast with its subtle nutty flavor. It felt balanced rather than heavy, which I appreciated.

The second dessert was a layered chocolate mousse cake. It had distinct layers — a chocolate base with smooth mousse and a lighter cream layer on top. The texture was soft and airy, and again, not overly sweet. You could tell it was made with care rather than just being sugar-heavy.

Presentation was clean and elegant, portions were just right, and everything tasted fresh. Overall, a great spot if you enjoy well-made, classic desserts with good balance and attention to detail. Definitely worth trying if you’re in the mood for chocolate done right.
Ramen (pork and chicken tonkotsu), shrimp drunken noodles, and the pineapple/green tea smoothie were all delicious! Great menu. Every item we’ve tried here has been tasty.

Get the hot rose milk tea and bulgogi kimchi tots for sure. Loved the crispy duck roll too! Didn't get a chance to try the desserts but they all look stunning. This modern asian fusion place is State College's best kept secret!

Nice spot for lunch or dinner. Food is a little eclectic, but could be described as Asian fusion. Pork buns were good, but you need to use the dipping sauce. Crispy duck rolls were amazing! Kimchi fried rice was fine, not much kimchi. Drinks were interesting and delicious

I don’t think I can express how much I love this place. Beautiful presentation, extremely fresh, lots of balanced flavors. I always feel homesick for my country’s food, and I normally just get some Americanized version of Asian food. But this place was so balanced, perfect, and authentic. The flavors were very clean and not muddied. The teas were fantastic and not overly sweet. The staff got our food out in 10 minutes and was very kind and quick.

Atmosphere was clean and modern. Sad part is that this place is tucked away behind Jimmy John’s and Big bowl so I bet people don’t see this perfect place.
